Evaluation 8.25 / 10 graded blind as submission X

Strong two-tone 'Low / Water' where the lower half of 'Water' is rust beneath the waterline, a line-drawn riverbed with receipt, staggered supporting stories and a dark offer table. The motif is clear and the craft is clean.

Strengths

  • Clear single display motif echoed in the artwork
  • role=alert errors and role=status success; reading mode persists
  • No sub-12px text

Weaknesses

  • Cover story is visually undersized relative to the issue title
  • The email field in the dark band is just an underline, easy to miss on mobile
  • Archive placed after the subscription
Evidence the grader checked
  • X-fold.png
  • email invalid -> role=alert 'Check the address. It should look like name@example.com.'
  • reload: html.reading-mode, localStorage margin-reading-mode=on

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

haiku-5.5/12-frontend-editorial/RESPONSE.md

Margin, Issue 14 landing page: notes

Files: index.html, styles.css, app.js. No frameworks, packages, remote fonts, images, or network requests. Everything is HTML, CSS, inline SVG, and one small script.

Art direction

The page is set like the opening spread of a print quarterly rather than a web template. The palette is newsprint (#f2ede2), ink (#1d1b18), and one rust accent (#9b4a1f), used only for the waterline, story numbers, and error states. Type comes from local stacks: a serif (Charter, then Georgia) for display and reading, and a sans (Helvetica, then Arial) for labels, bylines, and navigation, which is how print usually separates running text from metadata.

The one display motif is the waterline. The issue title, "Low Water", is filled with ink above a knocked-out hairline and rust below, so the title is itself cut by a tide line. On load the line drops from 58% to 74% of the title height, which reads as water receding. The same rust line runs through the cover art, and nothing else in the page repeats the effect.

The cover art is inline SVG and decorative: twenty-four wave lines compressed toward the bed of a riverbed, a vertical margin rule (a nod to the name), a rotated ledger slip for the "receipts", a bottle cap, and a dashed street plan. These are the objects named in the cover-story summary.

Composition is deliberately asymmetric. On wide screens the title spans eight of twelve columns and the art fills the remaining four, top-aligned with the title. The cover story indents its body to start at the fourth column. The three supporting stories stagger: the lead runs wide on the left, the second drops 7rem below the first on the right, and the third steps in from the left. The subscription offer is the only inverted block. It is laid out as a rate card with rules rather than boxes. There are no pills, no hero gradients, no dashboard mockups, and no testimonials.

Responsive choices

  • Reading order is the DOM order. Masthead, issue title, deck, art, cover story, stories, subscription, archive, footer. No CSS reordering is used, so a screen reader or a 390 px phone reads the page in the same order as the source.
  • 390 px is the base case. The layout is a single column first, and the 12-column grid begins at 900 px. The title is fluid (clamp(4.75rem, 28vw, 15.5rem)), so "Water" fills most of the column at 390 px without wrapping.
  • Art on small screens is 78% of the column and pushed to the right, which keeps the asymmetry instead of centring a full-width image.
  • Masthead is two rows below 760 px (brand and reading toggle, then navigation) and one row above it.
  • Offer and form use a fixed label column for the offer rows. The email field and button share a row that wraps the button under the input on narrow screens.
  • Measure and gutters use rem and clamp(). Body text is about 17 px and never sets a fixed pixel size, so browser zoom and system text size scale everything. Widths are relative (percentages, min(), clamp()), so no large block has a fixed width that could overflow a narrow screen.

Reading mode

The "Reading mode" control is a button with aria-pressed, and it shows a filled track when on. Turning it on sets a class on <html> that raises body text to about 21 px, increases leading to 1.75, narrows the measure to 34em, darkens secondary text, and dims the cover art to 40%. The choice is kept in localStorage (with a fallback if storage is blocked) and announced through a polite live region.

Subscription and email field

  • The offer states the three facts from the brief: print + digital, ¥2,400 per issue, cancel anytime. Nothing else about pricing is implied.
  • The email field has a real <label>, type="email", autocomplete="email", and required. The form uses novalidate so the messages are the page's own.
  • Validation runs when the field loses focus with a value in it, and again on every keystroke while an error is showing, so the message clears as soon as the address is valid. After the first submit, an empty field is checked too.
  • Errors are announced through role="alert", linked with aria-describedby, and mark the input with aria-invalid="true". On a failed submit, focus moves to the field.
  • Success is announced through role="status". The message says plainly that the preview sends no email, so nothing has been submitted.
  • The submit handler calls preventDefault() and makes no request. Wiring up a real endpoint means replacing the body of the submit listener in app.js.

Accessibility

  • A skip link leads to main. The page has header, a labelled nav, main, and footer landmarks, and a single h1 with a clear h2 and h3 hierarchy. The stories are in an ordered list.
  • The SVG art is aria-hidden="true" and focusable="false". The story numbers are hidden from assistive technology because they are decoration.
  • Contrast was computed, not estimated: ink on paper is 14.7:1, secondary ink is 7.7:1, rust on paper is 5.3:1, and on the inverted block the secondary text is 9.8:1 and the accent 8.4:1. All exceed WCAG AA for body text. The hairline rules are decorative and are not relied on to convey information.
  • Focus is shown with a 3 px rust outline, and both the buttons and links have visible states.
  • Motion is limited to the waterline drop, the reading-toggle knob, the nav underline, and smooth scrolling. All of it is turned off when the user prefers reduced motion.
  • The language is set to English. The viewport meta tag does not disable zooming.

Known limits

  • The archive entries are plain text. No issue pages exist yet, so there are no links to point at.
  • The cover story and supporting stories show only the summaries from COPY.md. There are no article pages.
  • Charter and Helvetica are only available on some systems. The fallbacks (Georgia, Arial) change the texture slightly but keep the layout.
  • Browsers without background-clip: text show the title in solid ink. The waterline is lost there, and the title stays readable.

Margin — Issue 14 copy

The River Keeps Its Receipts — Imani Vale

Along a drought-exposed riverbed, shop ledgers, bottle caps, and vanished street plans surface together. A field essay about civic memory and what infrastructure tries to forget.

Night Bus Atlas — Tomás Iriarte

The unofficial geography drawn by cleaners, nurses, bakers, and drivers while a city's daytime map is asleep.

Concrete Orchards — Meera Das

Residents tend fruit trees in the unfinished floors of a financial district, negotiating shade, ownership, and the patience of roots.

A Language for Empty Pools — Hana Mori

Photographs and short notes from public baths retired after the last swimmer, where tile patterns keep directing bodies that no longer arrive.

Archive: Issue 13 — After the Last Train; Issue 12 — Borrowed Ground; Issue 11 — The Weather Indoors.

haiku-5.5/12-frontend-editorial/TASK.md

Task 12 — Frontend design: editorial landing page

Build a distinctive responsive landing page for Margin, an independent quarterly journal about overlooked places. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: contemporary print editorial translated thoughtfully to the web. Use typography, rules, whitespace, asymmetric composition, and one strong display motif. It should feel authored rather than like a SaaS template. Avoid generic hero gradients, floating dashboard mockups, pill overload, and fake testimonials.

Content requirements:

  • Current issue: Low Water, Issue 14, Autumn 2026.
  • Cover story: “The River Keeps Its Receipts” by Imani Vale.
  • Supporting stories: “Night Bus Atlas,” “Concrete Orchards,” and “A Language for Empty Pools,” using the summaries in COPY.md.
  • A compact archive strip for Issues 11–13.
  • A clear subscription offer: print + digital, ¥2,400 per issue, cancel anytime.
  • A functional reading-mode control and a functional email field with inline validation/success feedback; no actual submission.
  • Strong mobile composition at 390 px and sensible reading order.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Decorative artwork must be CSS or inline SVG and accessible. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the art direction, responsive choices, and accessibility. Work only in this directory.

haiku-5.5/12-frontend-editorial/app.js

(() => {
  'use strict';

  const READING_KEY = 'margin-reading-mode';
  const EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/;

  const root = document.documentElement;
  const readingToggle = document.getElementById('reading-toggle');
  const announcer = document.getElementById('announcer');
  const form = document.getElementById('subscribe-form');
  const email = document.getElementById('email');
  const errorText = document.getElementById('email-error');
  const successText = document.getElementById('email-success');

  let submitted = false;

  function readStoredMode() {
    try {
      return window.localStorage.getItem(READING_KEY) === 'on';
    } catch (error) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function storeMode(on) {
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(READING_KEY, on ? 'on' : 'off');
    } catch (error) {
      // Storage is blocked; the choice then lasts only for this page view.
    }
  }

  function applyReadingMode(on) {
    root.classList.toggle('reading-mode', on);
    readingToggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
  }

  readingToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const on = !root.classList.contains('reading-mode');
    applyReadingMode(on);
    storeMode(on);
    announcer.textContent = on ? 'Reading mode on.' : 'Reading mode off.';
  });

  applyReadingMode(readStoredMode());

  function validate(value) {
    const address = value.trim();

    if (address === '') {
      return 'Enter an email address to subscribe.';
    }

    if (address.length > 254 || !EMAIL_PATTERN.test(address)) {
      return 'Check the address. It should look like name@example.com.';
    }

    return '';
  }

  function showError(message) {
    email.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    errorText.textContent = message;
    errorText.hidden = false;
    successText.hidden = true;
  }

  function clearError() {
    email.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
    errorText.textContent = '';
    errorText.hidden = true;
  }

  function check() {
    const message = validate(email.value);

    if (message) {
      showError(message);
      return false;
    }

    clearError();
    return true;
  }

  email.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    if (submitted || email.value.trim() !== '') {
      check();
    }
  });

  email.addEventListener('input', () => {
    successText.hidden = true;

    if (submitted || !errorText.hidden) {
      check();
    }
  });

  form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
    // Nothing is sent: the form is a preview, so the default submission is cancelled.
    event.preventDefault();
    submitted = true;

    if (!check()) {
      email.focus();
      return;
    }

    successText.textContent = 'Thank you. That address looks right. This preview does not send email, so nothing has been submitted.';
    successText.hidden = false;
  });
})();

              <p class="story__summary">Residents tend fruit trees in the unfinished floors of a financial district, negotiating shade, ownership, and the patience of roots.</p>
            </li>
            <li class="story story--third">
              <p class="story__num" aria-hidden="true">04</p>
              <h3 class="story__title">A Language for Empty Pools</h3>
              <p class="story__byline">by Hana Mori</p>
              <p class="story__summary">Photographs and short notes from public baths retired after the last swimmer, where tile patterns keep directing bodies that no longer arrive.</p>
            </li>
          </ol>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="subscribe" id="subscribe" aria-labelledby="subscribe-title">
        <div class="wrap subscribe__inner">
          <div class="subscribe__intro">
            <p class="label">Subscribe</p>
            <h2 class="section-title" id="subscribe-title">Print and digital, every issue.</h2>
            <p class="subscribe__note">Margin is quarterly: four issues a year, in print and on screen.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="subscribe__offer">
            <dl class="offer">
              <div class="offer__row">
                <dt>Format</dt>
                <dd>Print + digital</dd>
              </div>
              <div class="offer__row">
                <dt>Price</dt>
                <dd><span class="offer__price">¥2,400</span> <span class="offer__unit">per issue</span></dd>
              </div>
              <div class="offer__row">
                <dt>Terms</dt>
                <dd>Cancel anytime</dd>
              </div>
            </dl>

            <form class="subscribe-form" id="subscribe-form" novalidate>
              <div class="field">
                <label class="field__label" for="email">Email address</label>
                <div class="field__row">
                  <input class="field__input" id="email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" spellcheck="false" required aria-describedby="email-error">
                  <button class="button" type="submit">Subscribe</button>
                </div>
                <p class="field__error" id="email-error" role="alert" hidden></p>
                <p class="field__success" id="email-success" role="status" hidden></p>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="archive" id="archive" aria-labelledby="archive-title">
        <div class="wrap archive__inner">
          <h2 class="label" id="archive-title">Archive</h2>
          <ul class="archive__list">
            <li>
              <span class="archive__issue">Issue 13</span>
              <span class="archive__title">After the Last Train</span>
            </li>
            <li>
              <span class="archive__issue">Issue 12</span>
              <span class="archive__title">Borrowed Ground</span>
            </li>
            <li>
              <span class="archive__issue">Issue 11</span>
              <span class="archive__title">The Weather Indoors</span>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>

    <footer class="colophon">
      <div class="wrap colophon__inner">
        <p class="wordmark">Margin</p>
        <p>An independent quarterly journal about overlooked places. Issue 14, Low Water, Autumn 2026.</p>
        <p><a href="#top">Back to top</a></p>
      </div>
    </footer>

    <p class="visually-hidden" id="announcer" role="status"></p>
  </body>
</html>

haiku-5.5/12-frontend-editorial/styles.css

/* Margin, Issue 14: Low Water */

@property --tide {
  syntax: "<percentage>";
  inherits: false;
  initial-value: 74%;
}

:root {
  --paper: #f2ede2;
  --ink: #1d1b18;
  --ink-soft: #4d4940;
  --rule: #8c8576;
  --accent: #9b4a1f;
  --measure: 36rem;
  --gutter: clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
  --body-size: 1.0625rem;
  --body-leading: 1.6;
  --lede-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.2vw, 1.5rem);
  --font-serif: Charter, "Bitstream Charter", "Sitka Text", Cambria, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --font-sans: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, "Liberation Sans", sans-serif;
  color-scheme: light;
}

/* Reading mode: larger text, looser leading, narrower measure, quieter art. */
.reading-mode {
  --body-size: 1.3125rem;
  --body-leading: 1.75;
  --lede-size: 1.6rem;
  --measure: 34em;
  --ink-soft: #2e2b25;
  --rule: #6d675b;
}

*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  text-size-adjust: 100%;
  background: var(--paper);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
  }
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: var(--body-size);
  line-height: var(--body-leading);
  font-kerning: normal;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

h1,
h2,
h3,
p,
ol,
ul,
dl,
dd {
  margin: 0;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.visually-hidden {
  position: absolute !important;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  margin: -1px;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  top: -4rem;
  left: var(--gutter);
  z-index: 10;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.skip-link:focus {
  top: 0.75rem;
}

.wrap {
  width: calc(100% - (2 * var(--gutter)));
  max-width: 76rem;
  margin-inline: auto;
}

/* Shared small-caps labels and the display wordmark. */
.kicker,
.label,
.byline,
.story__byline,
.story__num,
.nav-list,
.reading-toggle,
.field__label,
.button,
.offer dt,
.archive__issue {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
}

.kicker,
.label,
.offer dt,
.archive__issue {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.wordmark {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 2.75rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* Masthead */
.masthead {
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink);
}

.masthead__inner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  grid-template-areas:
    "brand toggle"
    "nav nav";
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.9rem 1rem;
  padding-block: 1.1rem 0.9rem;
}

.masthead__brand {
  grid-area: brand;
}

.masthead__nav {
  grid-area: nav;
  padding-top: 0.7rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.reading-toggle {
  grid-area: toggle;
  justify-self: end;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem 0.4rem 0.6rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.reading-toggle__track {
  position: relative;
  width: 2.25rem;
  height: 1.125rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  transition: background-color 0.2s;
}

.reading-toggle__knob {
  position: absolute;
  top: 2px;
  left: 2px;
  width: 0.75rem;
  height: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--ink);
  transition: transform 0.2s, background-color 0.2s;
}

.reading-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] .reading-toggle__track {
  background: var(--ink);
}

.reading-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] .reading-toggle__knob {
  background: var(--paper);
  transform: translateX(1.125rem);
}

.nav-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem 1.4rem;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.nav-list a {
  color: var(--ink);
  text-decoration: none;
  padding-block: 0.2rem;
  background-image: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor);
  background-position: 0 100%;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: 0 1px;
  transition: background-size 0.2s;
}

.nav-list a:hover {
  background-size: 100% 1px;
}

@media (min-width: 760px) {
  .masthead__inner {
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
    grid-template-areas: "brand nav toggle";
  }

  .masthead__nav {
    padding-top: 0;
    border-top: 0;
  }

  .nav-list {
    justify-content: center;
  }
}

/* Cover */
.cover {
  padding-block: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2rem) clamp(3rem, 7vw, 6rem);
}

.cover__meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.4rem 1.5rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
}

.cover__grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2rem;
  margin-top: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 3rem);
}

/* One display motif: the title is cut by a waterline that drops into place. */
.display {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: clamp(4.75rem, 28vw, 15.5rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 0.82;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

@supports ((-webkit-background-clip: text) or (background-clip: text)) {
  .display--tide {
    --tide: 74%;
    color: transparent;
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    background-clip: text;
    background-image: linear-gradient(
      to bottom,
      var(--ink) 0 calc(var(--tide) - 0.5%),
      var(--paper) calc(var(--tide) - 0.5%) calc(var(--tide) + 0.5%),
      var(--accent) calc(var(--tide) + 0.5%) 100%
    );
  }
}

@supports (syntax: "<percentage>") {
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    .display--tide {
      animation: tide-recede 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both;
    }
  }
}

@keyframes tide-recede {
  from {
    --tide: 58%;
  }

  to {
    --tide: 74%;
  }
}

.cover__deck {
  max-width: var(--measure);
  font-size: var(--lede-size);
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.cover__art {
  justify-self: end;
  width: min(78%, 20rem);
}

.strata {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.strata__line,
.strata__text,
.strata__plan {
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.25;
}

.strata__text {
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.strata__plan {
  stroke-dasharray: 6 4;
}

.strata__tide {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--accent);
  stroke-width: 3.5;
}

.strata__margin {
  stroke: var(--accent);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.strata__slip,
.strata__cap {
  fill: var(--paper);
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.25;
}

.strata__crimp {
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1;
  stroke-dasharray: 1.5 2.5;
}

.cover-story {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem 2rem;
  margin-top: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
  padding-top: 1.25rem;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--ink);
}

.cover-story h2 {
  font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 5vw, 3.6rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.02;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.cover-story .byline {
  margin-top: 0.85rem;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.cover-story .lede {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  max-width: var(--measure);
  font-size: var(--lede-size);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .cover__grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr));
    column-gap: 1.5rem;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .display {
    grid-column: 1 / span 8;
  }

  .cover__deck {
    grid-column: 1 / span 5;
    align-self: end;
  }

  .cover__art {
    grid-column: 9 / span 4;
    grid-row: 1 / span 2;
    justify-self: stretch;
    width: auto;
  }

  .cover-story {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr));
    column-gap: 1.5rem;
  }

  .cover-story > .label {
    grid-column: 1 / span 3;
  }

  .cover-story__body {
    grid-column: 4 / span 7;
  }
}

/* Stories */
.stories {
  padding-block: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ink);
}

.stories .label {
  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
}

.section-title {
  font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 3.6rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.02;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.story-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2.75rem;
  margin-top: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem);
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.story {
  padding-top: 1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ink);
}

.story__num {
  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.story__title {
  margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
  font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 3.4vw, 2.3rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.08;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.story__byline {
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.story__summary {
  max-width: var(--measure);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .story-list {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr));
    column-gap: 1.5rem;
    row-gap: 3.5rem;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .story--lead {
    grid-column: 1 / span 6;
  }

  .story--lead .story__title {
    font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 5vw, 4rem);
  }

  .story--second {
    grid-column: 8 / span 5;
    margin-top: 7rem;
  }

  .story--third {
    grid-column: 3 / span 7;
  }
}

/* Subscribe: the one inverted block. Variables are swapped so children inherit the dark palette. */
.subscribe {
  --paper: #1d1b18;
  --ink: #f2ede2;
  --ink-soft: #cbc3b0;
  --rule: #6e685c;
  --accent: #e8a878;
  padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6rem);

  color: var(--ink);
}

.subscribe__inner {

  gap: 3rem;
}

.subscribe__note {
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  max-width: var(--measure);
  font-size: var(--lede-size);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.offer {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
}

.offer__row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 6.5rem 1fr;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-block: 0.9rem;

.offer dt {
  color: var(--ink-soft);

  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.offer__unit {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.subscribe-form {
  margin-top: 2rem;
}

.field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.field__label {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.field__row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 0.75rem 1rem;
}

.field__input {
  flex: 1 1 14rem;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.1rem 0.6rem;
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  color-scheme: dark;
}

.field__input[aria-invalid="true"] {
  border-bottom-color: var(--accent);
}

.button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 0;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.button:hover {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.field__error,
.field__success {
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.field__error {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.field__success {
  padding-left: 0.75rem;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .subscribe__inner {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr));
    column-gap: 1.5rem;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .subscribe__intro {
    grid-column: 1 / span 6;
  }

  .subscribe__offer {
    grid-column: 8 / span 5;
  }
}

/* Archive strip */
.archive {
  padding-block: 2rem 2.25rem;
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink);
}

.archive__inner {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.archive__list {
  display: grid;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.archive__list li {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.2rem;
  padding-block: 0.75rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ink);
}

.archive__issue {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.archive__title {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-style: italic;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .archive__inner {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr));
    column-gap: 1.5rem;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .archive__inner > .label {
    grid-column: 1 / span 3;
    padding-top: 0.75rem;
  }

  .archive__list {
    grid-column: 4 / -1;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    column-gap: 1.5rem;
  }
}

/* Footer */
.colophon {
  padding-block: 2.5rem 3rem;
}

.colophon__inner {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.colophon .wordmark {
  font-size: 1.75rem;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.colophon a {
  color: var(--ink);
}

.reading-mode .cover__art {
  opacity: 0.4;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .nav-list a,
  .reading-toggle__track,
  .reading-toggle__knob {
    transition: none;
  }
}

Evaluation 8 / 10 graded blind as submission J

Compact, typographically strong page: Didone 'Low / Water' split by a clay low-water ruler line that meets a vertical gauge in the margin, plus italic numerals and a concise offer. The desktop composition leaves a large empty right side.

Strengths

  • One clear display motif (waterline plus staff gauge), carried through to the subscribe rule
  • Reading mode goes dark, one column, labelled 'Exit reading', persisted
  • Good mobile type size (median 16.8px) and order

Weaknesses

  • At 1440 content sits in a ~960px left column with about 35% blank on the right
  • Shortest RESPONSE.md (19 lines)
  • Email field is a bare underline
Evidence the grader checked
  • J-fold.png desktop
  • email invalid -> 'That address looks incomplete. Use the form name@domain.com.' role=status
  • reload: html.is-reading bg rgb(28,23,19)

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

Screenshots Open the live page

grok-4.7/12-frontend-editorial/RESPONSE.md

Margin, Issue 14

Art direction

The page is set like a contemporary quarterly, not a product site. The ground is warm uncoated paper and the text is near-black ink. Didot carries the issue title, the story titles, the price, and the archive numerals. Iowan Old Style carries the essays. A monospaced face is reserved for the masthead line, bylines, indexes, and the two controls, so the survey notes stay distinct from the reading text.

The one motif is a river staff gauge, for an issue called Low Water. On a wide screen a vertical tick staff runs in the left margin. A clay low-water line crosses the gap between “Low” and “Water” and meets that staff. The same clay rule returns once, above the subscription. Everything else is black hairlines, plus a newspaper double rule under the masthead and again at the close. There is no gradient hero, no cards, no pills, and no invented testimony. The pull phrase beside the cover essay is taken from the supplied standfirst and is marked as coming from that essay.

Responsive choices

The layout is mobile-first and follows the DOM order: masthead, contents links, issue title, cover essay, the three stories, the archive, the subscription, then the colophon. At 390px that sequence is a single column. The title stays large, the waterline bleeds to the left edge and stops at the text measure, and the archive is three compact rows. From 720px the archive becomes one ruled strip. From 860px the cover phrase sits beside the headline, Night Bus Atlas keeps a large index beside its text, and the other two stories share a row. From 960px a sticky spine holds the vertical wordmark, the gauge, and “Issue 14.”

Reading mode leaves that spread. It hides the spine, sets one column about 42rem wide, enlarges the body, and switches to a dark paper ground so the control is obvious. Type is local only: Didot and Iowan, with Bodoni, Georgia, and Times behind them.

Accessibility

The heading outline is one h1, “Low Water,” then h2s for the cover essay, the three stories, the archive, and the subscription. The gauge is decorative. The spine is hidden from assistive technology because it repeats the masthead, and the waterline is hidden as well. A short visually hidden sentence still describes the line, so the metaphor is available as text and does not interrupt the title.

Reading mode is a button with aria-pressed, a label that changes to “Exit reading,” and a polite live region. The email field has a visible label, a standing hint, aria-describedby, and aria-invalid. An incomplete address produces a written error and a heavier underline. A well-formed address produces a written confirmation that nothing was sent. The form never navigates and never transmits. Focus is a two-pixel ink outline, a skip link moves to the main content, and the controls are at least 44px tall. Text, including the clay label and the dark reading ground, stays above WCAG AA. Reduced motion turns off smooth scrolling, and forced colors keep the control borders.

grok-4.7/12-frontend-editorial/COPY.md

Margin — Issue 14 copy

The River Keeps Its Receipts — Imani Vale

Along a drought-exposed riverbed, shop ledgers, bottle caps, and vanished street plans surface together. A field essay about civic memory and what infrastructure tries to forget.

Night Bus Atlas — Tomás Iriarte

The unofficial geography drawn by cleaners, nurses, bakers, and drivers while a city's daytime map is asleep.

Concrete Orchards — Meera Das

Residents tend fruit trees in the unfinished floors of a financial district, negotiating shade, ownership, and the patience of roots.

A Language for Empty Pools — Hana Mori

Photographs and short notes from public baths retired after the last swimmer, where tile patterns keep directing bodies that no longer arrive.

Archive: Issue 13 — After the Last Train; Issue 12 — Borrowed Ground; Issue 11 — The Weather Indoors.

grok-4.7/12-frontend-editorial/TASK.md

Task 12 — Frontend design: editorial landing page

Build a distinctive responsive landing page for Margin, an independent quarterly journal about overlooked places. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: contemporary print editorial translated thoughtfully to the web. Use typography, rules, whitespace, asymmetric composition, and one strong display motif. It should feel authored rather than like a SaaS template. Avoid generic hero gradients, floating dashboard mockups, pill overload, and fake testimonials.

Content requirements:

  • Current issue: Low Water, Issue 14, Autumn 2026.
  • Cover story: “The River Keeps Its Receipts” by Imani Vale.
  • Supporting stories: “Night Bus Atlas,” “Concrete Orchards,” and “A Language for Empty Pools,” using the summaries in COPY.md.
  • A compact archive strip for Issues 11–13.
  • A clear subscription offer: print + digital, ¥2,400 per issue, cancel anytime.
  • A functional reading-mode control and a functional email field with inline validation/success feedback; no actual submission.
  • Strong mobile composition at 390 px and sensible reading order.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Decorative artwork must be CSS or inline SVG and accessible. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the art direction, responsive choices, and accessibility. Work only in this directory.

(function () {
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var storageKey = "margin-reading-mode";

  function storedReading() {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(storageKey) === "on";
    } catch (err) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  if (storedReading()) root.classList.add("is-reading");

  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
    } else {
      fn();
    }
  }

  function remember(on) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, on ? "on" : "off");
    } catch (err) {
      /* Private or file contexts may block storage; the control still works. */
    }
  }

  function emailProblem(value) {
    var v = value.trim();
    var incomplete = "That address looks incomplete. Use the form name@domain.com.";
    var at;
    var local;
    var domain;
    var labels;
    var i;
    var label;
    var localOk = /^[a-z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+$/i;
    var labelOk = /^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$/i;

    if (!v) return "Enter an email address to subscribe.";
    if (v.length > 254 || /\s/.test(v)) return incomplete;

    at = v.indexOf("@");
    if (at < 1 || at !== v.lastIndexOf("@")) return incomplete;

    local = v.slice(0, at);
    domain = v.slice(at + 1);
    if (local.length > 64 || !localOk.test(local)) return incomplete;
    if (local.charAt(0) === "." || local.charAt(local.length - 1) === "." || local.indexOf("..") !== -1) {
      return incomplete;
    }

    labels = domain.split(".");
    if (labels.length < 2) return incomplete;
    for (i = 0; i < labels.length; i += 1) {
      label = labels[i];
      if (!labelOk.test(label)) return incomplete;
    }
    if (labels[labels.length - 1].length < 2) return incomplete;

    return "";
  }

  ready(function () {
    var toggle = document.querySelector(".reading-toggle");
    var status = document.getElementById("reading-status");
    var form = document.getElementById("subscribe-form");
    var email = document.getElementById("email");
    var feedback = document.getElementById("email-feedback");

    function setReading(on, announce) {
      root.classList.toggle("is-reading", on);
      if (toggle) {
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on ? "true" : "false");
        toggle.textContent = on ? "Exit reading" : "Reading mode";
      }
      remember(on);
      if (announce && status) {
        status.textContent = "";
        window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
          status.textContent = on ? "Reading mode on." : "Reading mode off.";
        });
      }
    }

    function setFeedback(message, state) {
      feedback.dataset.state = state || "";
      if (feedback.textContent === message) {
        feedback.textContent = "";
        window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
          feedback.textContent = message;
        });
        return;
      }
      feedback.textContent = message;
    }

    function clearFeedback() {
      feedback.dataset.state = "";
      feedback.textContent = "";
    }

    setReading(root.classList.contains("is-reading"), false);

    if (toggle) {
      toggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
        setReading(!root.classList.contains("is-reading"), true);
      });
    }

    if (!form || !email || !feedback) return;

    email.addEventListener("input", function () {
      var problem = emailProblem(email.value);
      if (feedback.dataset.state === "success") {
        clearFeedback();
        email.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");
        return;
      }
      if (feedback.dataset.state === "error" && !problem) {
        email.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");
        clearFeedback();
      }
    });

    email.addEventListener("blur", function () {
      var problem = emailProblem(email.value);
      if (!email.value.trim() || !problem) return;
      email.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
      setFeedback(problem, "error");
    });

    form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
      var problem;
      var value;
      event.preventDefault();
      value = email.value.trim();
      problem = emailProblem(value);
      if (problem) {
        email.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
        setFeedback(problem, "error");
        email.focus();
        return;
      }
      email.value = value;
      email.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "false");
      setFeedback("Confirmed for " + value + ". Nothing was sent from this page.", "success");
    });
  });
})();

grok-4.7/12-frontend-editorial/styles.css

:root {
  --paper: #f6f1e8;
  --ink: #161513;
  --muted: #4a453e;
  --clay: #9d3b28;
  --danger: #8d2f24;
  --display: "Didot", "Bodoni 72", "Bodoni MT", "Times New Roman", serif;
  --text: "Iowan Old Style", Palatino, "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, "Courier New", monospace;
  --pad: 1.25rem;
  --measure: 62ch;
  color-scheme: light;
}

html.is-reading {
  --paper: #1c1713;
  --ink: #f4ecdf;
  --muted: #e4d8c8;
  --clay: #f0b5a3;
  --danger: #ffb4a8;
  color-scheme: dark;
}

*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--text);
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  font-variant-numeric: oldstyle-nums;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

h1,
h2,
h3,
p {
  margin: 0;
}

ul,
ol {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

button,
input {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  border-radius: 0;
}

svg {
  display: block;
}

::selection {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ink);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.visually-hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  clip-path: inset(50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.skip {
  position: absolute;
  left: var(--pad);
  top: 0.5rem;
  z-index: 30;
  transform: translateY(-160%);
  padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.skip:focus {
  transform: none;
}

.sheet {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

.sheet__body {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0 var(--pad) 3.25rem;
}

.spine {
  display: none;
}

.kicker,
.byline,
.waterline__label,
.price__unit,
.pull__from,
.contents-nav,
.reading-toggle,
.submit,
.mast__line,
.foot__folio,
.archive__no .visually-hidden {
  font-variant-numeric: lining-nums;
}

.kicker {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  line-height: 1.3;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.double-rule {
  height: 0.55rem;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--ink);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
}

.mast {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 5;
  margin-inline: calc(-1 * var(--pad));
  padding: 0.95rem var(--pad) 0;
  background: var(--paper);
}

.mast__row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.wordmark {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 1.7rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  line-height: 1;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.mast__line {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem 0.55rem;
  margin-top: 0.45rem;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;

.double-rule {

Evaluation 7.75 / 10 graded blind as submission U

Classic letterspaced 'MARGIN' masthead between rules, a split 'THE RIVER / Keeps Its / Receipts' headline, a contour cover card, an issue spec row, a staggered contents list, archive cards and an offer. It is well composed, but the email form is a separate 'Notify me' letter.

Strengths

  • Coherent print typography and grid
  • Reading mode persists; validation messages present
  • Archive scroller on mobile is intentional

Weaknesses

  • Email capture is 'A letter when each issue surfaces / Notify me', not tied to the subscription
  • Sepia reading mode drops 30 small text nodes to ~4.4:1
  • No error shown on blur, only on submit
Evidence the grader checked
  • U/index.html form#letter-form 'Notify me'
  • contrast.js alt: 30 fails at 4.42:1
  • email valid -> 'Noted. The next letter surfaces with Issue 15, Winter 2026.'

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

kimi-k3/12-frontend-editorial/RESPONSE.md

RESPONSE — Margin, Issue 14: Low Water

Art direction

The page translates a contemporary print quarterly to the web rather than imitating a product site. The language is serials furniture: a double-ruled masthead with a wire-style wordmark, kickers and bylines in uppercase monospace, a drop cap on the cover lede, page references (pp. 14–41), and a facts strip (issue / season / theme / length / price) set like a colophon.

The single display motif is the receding waterline, carried through the whole page in three registers:

  1. The cover artwork is an inline SVG "contour survey" of a drying riverbed — nested hand-drawn rings where the outermost line is dashed rust and annotated "former waterline, est. 1989," and the innermost ring is the teal "water today," echoing the cover story about a river that surfaces what the city tried to forget.
  2. A full-width river gauge divider (pure CSS repeating gradients as staff-gauge ticks) separates the cover from the contents, labelled "waterline ↓ 2.4 m below normal."
  3. The archive strip reuses small contour glyphs, one per back issue, each slightly distorted so no two "bodies of water" are alike.

The palette is uncoated paper (#f4efe2), ink (#221e16), a low-water teal, and an exposed-bed rust used sparingly for annotation and error states. There are no gradients-as-decoration, no cards with shadows, no pills, and no testimonials — the subscription offer is stated plainly, the way a small press would state it. All type is the reader's own system serif and monospace; the colophon says so, and it is true: the page makes zero network requests.

Responsive choices

The composition is a 12-column grid used asymmetrically: cover text spans seven columns while the framed artwork hangs in columns 9–12 and drops below the headline axis; the three supporting stories are staggered across the grid with vertical offsets (02 left, 03 pushed right and down, 04 re-centred), so the eye moves the way it does across a spread. At 60 rem the grid relaxes — artwork moves under the cover text, stories widen. At the 390 px target the page becomes a single serial column in reading order (masthead → cover → facts → gauge → contents → archive → subscribe → colophon), the issue-facts strip reflows to two columns, and the archive becomes a horizontal scroll-snap strip so it stays a "strip" instead of stacking into a wall. Type uses clamp() throughout so the wordmark and headline scale continuously rather than jumping at breakpoints.

Accessibility

  • Semantic landmarks (header, nav, main, section with aria-labelledby, footer) and a logical heading order: one h1 wordmark, section h2s, story h3s — so the reading order is intact without CSS.
  • Skip link to #main; visible :focus-visible outline in rust.
  • The cover SVG is role="img" with <title> and <desc> describing what the contours mean; decorative archive glyphs and story numerals are aria-hidden.
  • The reading-mode toggle is a real <button> with aria-pressed and a state readout, persisted via localStorage. Reading mode softens the paper/ink contrast, lengthens line-height and measure, and dims the artwork — a calmer page for sustained reading.
  • The email field is a labelled input with novalidate so validation stays inline: errors set aria-invalid, point at the feedback paragraph via aria-describedby, are announced through aria-live="polite", and move focus to the field; success is announced the same way. The form never submits anywhere.
  • Color is never the only signal (error text plus border plus message); prefers-reduced-motion disables the smooth-scroll and theme transition.

Margin — Issue 14 copy

The River Keeps Its Receipts — Imani Vale

Along a drought-exposed riverbed, shop ledgers, bottle caps, and vanished street plans surface together. A field essay about civic memory and what infrastructure tries to forget.

Night Bus Atlas — Tomás Iriarte

The unofficial geography drawn by cleaners, nurses, bakers, and drivers while a city's daytime map is asleep.

Concrete Orchards — Meera Das

Residents tend fruit trees in the unfinished floors of a financial district, negotiating shade, ownership, and the patience of roots.

A Language for Empty Pools — Hana Mori

Photographs and short notes from public baths retired after the last swimmer, where tile patterns keep directing bodies that no longer arrive.

Archive: Issue 13 — After the Last Train; Issue 12 — Borrowed Ground; Issue 11 — The Weather Indoors.

kimi-k3/12-frontend-editorial/TASK.md

Task 12 — Frontend design: editorial landing page

Build a distinctive responsive landing page for Margin, an independent quarterly journal about overlooked places. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: contemporary print editorial translated thoughtfully to the web. Use typography, rules, whitespace, asymmetric composition, and one strong display motif. It should feel authored rather than like a SaaS template. Avoid generic hero gradients, floating dashboard mockups, pill overload, and fake testimonials.

Content requirements:

  • Current issue: Low Water, Issue 14, Autumn 2026.
  • Cover story: “The River Keeps Its Receipts” by Imani Vale.
  • Supporting stories: “Night Bus Atlas,” “Concrete Orchards,” and “A Language for Empty Pools,” using the summaries in COPY.md.
  • A compact archive strip for Issues 11–13.
  • A clear subscription offer: print + digital, ¥2,400 per issue, cancel anytime.
  • A functional reading-mode control and a functional email field with inline validation/success feedback; no actual submission.
  • Strong mobile composition at 390 px and sensible reading order.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Decorative artwork must be CSS or inline SVG and accessible. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the art direction, responsive choices, and accessibility. Work only in this directory.

kimi-k3/12-frontend-editorial/app.js

/* Margin — Issue 14: Low Water
   Two small interactive instruments:
   1. a reading-mode toggle (persisted, no reload)
   2. a letter-signup field with inline validation (nothing is sent anywhere)
*/

(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ---------- 1. Reading mode ---------- */

  var STORAGE_KEY = "margin-reading-mode";
  var toggle = document.getElementById("reading-toggle");
  var toggleState = document.getElementById("reading-toggle-state");

  function applyReadingMode(on) {
    document.body.classList.toggle("reading", on);
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(on));
    toggleState.textContent = on ? "on" : "off";
  }

  function savedPreference() {
    try {
      return window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) === "on";
    } catch (err) {
      return false; // storage unavailable; default to off
    }
  }

  if (toggle && toggleState) {
    applyReadingMode(savedPreference());

    toggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var on = !document.body.classList.contains("reading");
      applyReadingMode(on);
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, on ? "on" : "off");
      } catch (err) {
        /* persistence is a nicety, not a requirement */
      }
    });
  }

  /* ---------- 2. Letter signup with inline validation ---------- */

  var form = document.getElementById("letter-form");
  var input = document.getElementById("email");
  var feedback = document.getElementById("email-feedback");

  if (!form || !input || !feedback) return;

  var EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/;

  function setFeedback(message, kind) {
    feedback.textContent = message;
    feedback.classList.remove("is-error", "is-success");
    if (kind) feedback.classList.add(kind);
  }

  function clearError() {
    input.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");
    if (feedback.classList.contains("is-error")) setFeedback("", null);
  }

  input.addEventListener("input", clearError);

  form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
    event.preventDefault(); // nothing is ever submitted anywhere

    var value = input.value.trim();

    if (value === "") {
      input.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
      setFeedback("An address, please — the letter needs somewhere to go.", "is-error");
      input.focus();
      return;
    }

    if (!EMAIL_PATTERN.test(value)) {
      input.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
      setFeedback("That doesn’t read like an email address. Check for a typo?", "is-error");
      input.focus();
      return;
    }

    input.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");
    setFeedback("Noted. The next letter surfaces with Issue 15, Winter 2026.", "is-success");
    form.reset();
  });
})();

    <ul>
      <li><a href="#issue">Issue 14</a></li>
      <li><a href="#stories">Contents</a></li>
      <li><a href="#archive">Archive</a></li>
      <li><a href="#subscribe">Subscribe</a></li>
    </ul>
    <button class="reading-toggle" id="reading-toggle" type="button" aria-pressed="false">
      Reading mode <span class="reading-toggle__state" id="reading-toggle-state">off</span>
    </button>
  </nav>
</header>

<main id="main">

  <!-- ============ COVER STORY ============ -->
  <section class="cover" id="issue" aria-labelledby="cover-title">
    <div class="cover__text">
      <p class="kicker"><span>Issue 14</span><span>Low Water</span><span>Autumn 2026</span></p>

      <h2 class="cover__headline" id="cover-title">
        <span class="cover__line cover__line--small">The River</span>
        <span class="cover__line">Keeps Its</span>
        <span class="cover__line cover__line--italic">Receipts</span>
      </h2>

      <p class="byline">A field essay by <strong>Imani Vale</strong></p>

      <p class="lede">Along a drought-exposed riverbed, shop ledgers, bottle caps, and
      vanished street plans surface together. A field essay about civic memory and
      what infrastructure tries to forget.</p>

      <p class="cover__meta">pp. 14–41 · 27 min read · Photographs by the author</p>
    </div>

    <figure class="cover__art">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 360 310" role="img" aria-labelledby="cover-art-title cover-art-desc" focusable="false">
        <title id="cover-art-title">Contour survey of a drying riverbed</title>
        <desc id="cover-art-desc">Hand-drawn contour lines nested inside one another like the rings of a
        drained reservoir. The outermost line is dashed and labelled as the former waterline; the
        innermost solid ring marks where the water stands today.</desc>

        <!-- former waterline -->
        <path class="contour contour--former" d="M40,58 C96,22 214,16 288,54 C338,80 348,152 314,208 C282,264 178,290 100,260 C30,233 8,152 24,102 C30,80 24,72 40,58 Z"/>
        <path class="contour" d="M70,80 C116,52 206,46 264,74 C308,96 318,152 290,198 C262,242 180,262 118,240 C60,220 42,154 54,112 C60,92 58,90 70,80 Z"/>
        <path class="contour" d="M98,100 C136,78 202,74 244,94 C278,110 288,152 266,188 C246,222 180,238 132,222 C88,207 72,156 82,122 C88,106 88,106 98,100 Z"/>
        <path class="contour" d="M126,120 C156,104 202,100 230,114 C254,126 262,154 246,178 C230,202 184,214 150,202 C116,190 104,156 112,134 C116,124 118,124 126,120 Z"/>
        <path class="contour contour--today" d="M152,138 C172,128 202,126 220,136 C236,144 240,160 230,174 C218,190 186,196 164,188 C142,180 134,160 140,148 C144,141 145,141 152,138 Z"/>

        <!-- lowest point -->
        <circle class="contour__point" cx="186" cy="162" r="3"/>

        <!-- annotations -->
        <text class="svg-label" x="44" y="46">former waterline, est. 1989</text>
        <text class="svg-label" x="196" y="216">water today</text>
        <text class="svg-label svg-label--mono" x="196" y="152">&#8722;2.4 m</text>
      </svg>
      <figcaption>Cover: contour survey of the lower riverbed, drawn at the lowest
      water in four decades.</figcaption>
    </figure>

    <dl class="issue-facts">
      <div><dt>Issue</dt><dd>No. 14</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Season</dt><dd>Autumn 2026</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Theme</dt><dd>Low Water</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Length</dt><dd>128 pages</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Price</dt><dd>&yen;2,400</dd></div>
    </dl>
  </section>

  <!-- gauge divider: a river gauge rendered in CSS -->
  <div class="gauge" role="separator" aria-label="Waterline divider">
    <span class="gauge__label">waterline &darr; 2.4 m below normal</span>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ ALSO IN THIS ISSUE ============ -->
  <section class="stories" id="stories" aria-labelledby="stories-title">
    <header class="section-head">
      <h2 id="stories-title">Also in this issue</h2>
      <p>Three more reports from the margins</p>
    </header>

    <ol class="story-list">
      <li class="story">
        <p class="story__index" aria-hidden="true">02</p>
        <div class="story__body">
          <h3>Night Bus Atlas</h3>
          <p class="byline">Tom&aacute;s Iriarte</p>
          <p>The unofficial geography drawn by cleaners, nurses, bakers, and drivers
          while a city&rsquo;s daytime map is asleep.</p>
          <p class="story__pages">pp. 44–59 · Reportage</p>
        </div>
      </li>

      <li class="story story--offset">
        <p class="story__index" aria-hidden="true">03</p>
        <div class="story__body">
          <h3>Concrete Orchards</h3>
          <p class="byline">Meera Das</p>
          <p>Residents tend fruit trees in the unfinished floors of a financial
          district, negotiating shade, ownership, and the patience of roots.</p>
          <p class="story__pages">pp. 62–77 · Essay</p>
        </div>
      </li>

      <li class="story">
        <p class="story__index" aria-hidden="true">04</p>
        <div class="story__body">
          <h3>A Language for Empty Pools</h3>
          <p class="byline">Hana Mori</p>
          <p>Photographs and short notes from public baths retired after the last
          swimmer, where tile patterns keep directing bodies that no longer arrive.</p>
          <p class="story__pages">pp. 80–95 · Photo notes</p>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ol>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ ARCHIVE ============ -->
  <section class="archive" id="archive" aria-labelledby="archive-title">
    <header class="section-head">

  </section>

  <!-- ============ SUBSCRIBE ============ -->
  <section class="subscribe" id="subscribe" aria-labelledby="subscribe-title">
    <div class="subscribe__offer">
      <p class="kicker"><span>Subscribe</span></p>
      <h2 id="subscribe-title">Print + digital,<br><span class="subscribe__price">&yen;2,400</span> per issue</h2>
      <p class="subscribe__terms">Four issues a year, posted worldwide. Digital edition
      included, DRM-free. <strong>Cancel anytime</strong> — we keep the receipts, not you.</p>
      <ul class="subscribe__includes">
        <li>128-page print edition, uncoated stock</li>

    <div class="subscribe__form-wrap">

      <p>One email per quarter. Nothing else, ever.</p>

        <label for="email">Email address</label>
        <div class="field-row">
          <input type="email" id="email" name="email" autocomplete="email"
                 placeholder="you@somewhere.org" required
                 aria-describedby="email-feedback">

</main>

<footer class="colophon">
  <p><strong>Margin</strong> is published four times a year from a room above a
  closed lido. Issue 14, <em>Low Water</em>, Autumn 2026.</p>
  <p>Set in the reader&rsquo;s own serif and monospace. No trackers, no webfonts,
  no third-party requests.</p>
  <p class="colophon__fine">&copy; 2026 Margin. Printed, eventually, when the water returns.</p>

kimi-k3/12-frontend-editorial/styles.css

/* ============================================================
   Margin — Issue 14: Low Water
   Editorial print language translated to the web:
   rules, serials, asymmetric grid, one display motif
   (the receding-water contour line).
   ============================================================ */

:root {
  --paper:        #f4efe2;
  --paper-deep:   #eae3cf;
  --ink:          #221e16;
  --ink-soft:     #5d5744;
  --river:        #1e5b54;   /* low-water teal */
  --rust:         #a8441f;   /* exposed-bed rust */
  --rule:         #221e16;
  --serif: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  --measure: 68ch;
}

/* Reading mode: quieter paper, softer ink, longer lines, fewer distractions */
body.reading {
  --paper:      #e7ddc4;
  --paper-deep: #ddd2b2;
  --ink:        #2c2620;
  --ink-soft:   #6a6350;
  --river:      #27514b;
  --rust:       #8f4a2e;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  transition: background-color .3s ease, color .3s ease;
}

body.reading {
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

::selection { background: var(--river); color: var(--paper); }

/* ---------- skip link ---------- */
.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  left: -9999px;
  top: 0;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  padding: .5rem 1rem;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .8rem;
  z-index: 10;
}
.skip-link:focus { left: 0; }

/* ---------- focus ---------- */
:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--rust);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* ============================================================
   Masthead
   ============================================================ */

.masthead {
  max-width: 72rem;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem 0;
}

.masthead__row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--rule);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: .45rem 0;
}

.masthead__kicker {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .68rem;
  letter-spacing: .14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.masthead__kicker--right { text-align: right; }

.wordmark {
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  padding: 1rem 0 1.1rem;
  font-size: clamp(3.4rem, 13vw, 9rem);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  line-height: 1;
}
/* rules running out to the page edges from the wordmark */
.wordmark::before,
.wordmark::after {
  content: "";
  flex: 1 1 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  height: .3em;
  border-width: 0;
  border-top-width: 3px;
  border-bottom-width: 1px;
  padding: 2px 0;
}
.wordmark span { white-space: nowrap; }

.masthead__nav {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .75rem 2rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--rule);
  padding: .55rem 0;
}
.masthead__nav ul {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .25rem 1.75rem;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.masthead__nav a {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .78rem;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
}
.masthead__nav a:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--rust); color: var(--rust); }

.reading-toggle {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .72rem;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: .45rem .8rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.reading-toggle:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
.reading-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
.reading-toggle__state { color: var(--rust); }
.reading-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] .reading-toggle__state { color: var(--paper-deep); }

/* ============================================================
   Shared editorial furniture
   ============================================================ */

main {
  max-width: 72rem;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 1.5rem;
}

.kicker {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .35rem 1.4rem;
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .72rem;
  letter-spacing: .18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--river);
}
.kicker span + span::before {
  content: "·";
  margin-right: 1.4rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.byline {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .8rem;
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin: 0 0 .75rem;
}
.byline strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }

.section-head {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .25rem 2rem;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--rule);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: .6rem 0;
  margin-bottom: 2.25rem;
}
.section-head h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.section-head p {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .72rem;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

/* ============================================================
   Cover story — asymmetric 12-column composition
   ============================================================ */

.cover {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
  column-gap: 2rem;
  padding: 3rem 0 2.5rem;
}

.cover__text { grid-column: 1 / 8; }

.cover__headline {
  margin: 0 0 1.4rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: .98;
  font-size: clamp(2.9rem, 7.5vw, 5.6rem);
  letter-spacing: -.01em;
}
.cover__line { display: block; }
/* hanging indent: second line steps in, third steps out — print-style axis */
.cover__line--small {
  font-size: .42em;
  letter-spacing: .3em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--river);
  margin-bottom: .35em;
}
.cover__line--italic {
  font-style: italic;
  margin-left: 1.1em;
  color: var(--rust);
}

.lede {
  max-width: 34rem;
  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
  font-size: 1.22rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
}
body.reading .lede { font-size: 1.28rem; }
/* drop cap */
.lede::first-letter {
  float: left;
  font-size: 3.4em;
  line-height: .82;
  padding: .06em .12em 0 0;
  color: var(--river);
}

.cover__meta {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .72rem;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding-top: .6rem;
  max-width: 34rem;
}

/* cover artwork */
.cover__art {
  grid-column: 9 / 13;
  grid-row: 1;
  align-self: start;
  margin: 3.5rem 0 0;
  padding: 1rem 1rem .85rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: var(--paper-deep);
}
body.reading .cover__art { opacity: .45; }
.cover__art svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
.cover__art figcaption {
  margin-top: .7rem;
  padding-top: .5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: .78rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-style: italic;
}

/* the display motif: receding-water contours */
.contour {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--ink);
  stroke-width: 1.4;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}
.contour--former {
  stroke: var(--rust);
  stroke-dasharray: 7 6;
  stroke-width: 1.2;
}
.contour--today { stroke: var(--river); stroke-width: 2; }
.contour__point { fill: var(--river); }
.svg-label {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  fill: var(--ink-soft);
}
.svg-label--mono { fill: var(--river); }

/* issue facts: an editorial colophon strip */
.issue-facts {
  grid-column: 1 / 13;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
  gap: 0;
  margin: 3rem 0 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--rule);
}
.issue-facts > div {
  padding: .65rem 1rem .65rem 0;
}
.issue-facts > div + div {
  border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding-left: 1rem;
}
.issue-facts dt {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .62rem;
  letter-spacing: .16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin-bottom: .15rem;
}
.issue-facts dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; }

/* ============================================================
   River-gauge divider
   ============================================================ */

.gauge {
  position: relative;
  height: 34px;
  margin: 1rem 0 3.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  /* tick marks, alternating long and short like a staff gauge */
  background-image:
    repeating-linear-gradient(to right,
      var(--ink) 0 1px, transparent 1px 24px),
    repeating-linear-gradient(to right,
      var(--ink) 0 1px, transparent 1px 120px);
  background-size: 100% 8px, 100% 16px;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: bottom left, bottom left;
}
.gauge__label {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 100%;
  margin-bottom: .35rem;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .68rem;
  letter-spacing: .14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--rust);
}

/* ============================================================
   Stories — staggered, rule-separated
   ============================================================ */

.stories { padding-bottom: 3.5rem; }

.story-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
  column-gap: 2rem;
}

.story {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: 1.1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding-top: 1.1rem;
}
.story:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1 / 6; }
.story:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 7 / 13; margin-top: 4.5rem; }
.story:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 3 / 9;  margin-top: 3rem; }

.story__index {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 2.6rem;
  line-height: 1;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--river);
}
.story__body h3 {
  margin: 0 0 .4rem;
  font-size: 1.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.1;
}
.story__body p { margin: 0 0 .8rem; max-width: 30rem; }
.story__pages {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .68rem;
  letter-spacing: .14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding-top: .5rem;
  max-width: 16rem !important;
}

/* ============================================================
   Archive strip
   ============================================================ */

.archive { padding-bottom: 3.5rem; }

.archive__strip {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: var(--paper-deep);
}
.archive__item {
  padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem 1.6rem;
}
.archive__item + .archive__item { border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); }

.archive__glyph {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  margin-bottom: .9rem;
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--river);
  stroke-width: 1.6;
}
.archive__no {
  margin: 0 0 .25rem;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .68rem;
  letter-spacing: .18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--rust);
}
.archive__item h3 {
  margin: 0 0 .3rem;
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.15;
}
.archive__season {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .7rem;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

/* ============================================================
   Subscribe
   ============================================================ */

.subscribe {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 7fr 5fr;
  gap: 3rem;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 2.75rem 0 3.5rem;
}

.subscribe h2 {
  margin: 0 0 1.1rem;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.2rem);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.05;
}
.subscribe__price { font-style: italic; color: var(--river); }
.subscribe__terms { max-width: 30rem; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; font-size: 1.08rem; }

.subscribe__includes {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  max-width: 30rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
}
.subscribe__includes li {
  padding: .45rem 0 .45rem 1.6rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  position: relative;
}
.subscribe__includes li::before {
  content: "§";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  color: var(--rust);
}

.subscribe__form-wrap {
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: var(--paper-deep);
  padding: 1.6rem 1.6rem 1.4rem;
  align-self: start;
  margin-top: 3.2rem;
}
.subscribe__form-title {
  margin: 0 0 .4rem;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-style: italic;
}
.subscribe__form-wrap > p { margin: 0 0 1.1rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .92rem; }

#letter-form label {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .68rem;
  letter-spacing: .16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: .45rem;
}
.field-row { display: flex; gap: .6rem; }
.field-row input {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  font: inherit;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .9rem;
  padding: .55rem .7rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 0;
}
.field-row input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--rust); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--rust); }
.field-row button {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .78rem;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: .55rem 1.1rem;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.field-row button:hover { background: var(--river); border-color: var(--river); }

.field-feedback {
  min-height: 1.4em;
  margin: .55rem 0 0;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .78rem;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
}
.field-feedback.is-error { color: var(--rust); }
.field-feedback.is-success { color: var(--river); }

/* ============================================================
   Colophon
   ============================================================ */

.colophon {
  max-width: 72rem;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem 2.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: .85rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}
.colophon p { margin: .5rem 0 0; max-width: var(--measure); }
.colophon__fine {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: .68rem;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ============================================================
   Responsive
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 60rem) {
  .cover__text { grid-column: 1 / 13; }
  .cover__art {
    grid-column: 3 / 13;
    grid-row: auto;
    margin-top: 2rem;
  }
  .story:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1 / 8; }
  .story:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 6 / 13; margin-top: 3rem; }
  .story:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 2 / 10; margin-top: 3rem; }
  .subscribe { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2.5rem; }
  .subscribe__form-wrap { margin-top: 0; }
}

/* 390px target: single column, stacked serial order */
@media (max-width: 40rem) {
  body { font-size: 1rem; }

  .masthead { padding: 1rem 1.1rem 0; }
  main { padding: 0 1.1rem; }
  .colophon { padding: 1rem 1.1rem 2rem; }

  .masthead__kicker--right { display: none; }
  .wordmark { padding: .75rem 0 .85rem; }
  .wordmark::before { display: none; }
  .masthead__nav { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; }

  .cover { padding-top: 2.25rem; display: block; }
  .cover__line--italic { margin-left: .55em; }
  .lede::first-letter { font-size: 3em; }
  .cover__art { margin-top: 2.25rem; }

  .issue-facts { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); margin-top: 2.25rem; }
  .issue-facts > div:nth-child(odd) { border-left: none; padding-left: 0; }
  .issue-facts > div:nth-child(n + 3) { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }

  .gauge { margin-bottom: 2.75rem; }

  .story-list { display: block; }
  .story { margin-top: 0 !important; margin-bottom: 2.25rem; }
  .story__index { font-size: 2.1rem; }
  .story__body h3 { font-size: 1.45rem; }

  /* archive becomes a swipeable strip */
  .archive__strip {
    display: flex;
    overflow-x: auto;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
  }
  .archive__item {
    flex: 0 0 78%;
    scroll-snap-align: start;
  }
  .archive__item + .archive__item {
    border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }

  .subscribe { padding-top: 2.25rem; }
  .field-row { flex-direction: column; }
  .field-row button { align-self: flex-start; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
  body { transition: none; }
}

Evaluation 7.75 / 10 graded blind as submission H

Print-like page with a letterspaced masthead, a large 'Low Water' with a small contour graph, a contents table with dotted leaders, staggered dispatches and an offer table. It has good craft with some awkward details.

Strengths

  • Contents with leader lines and staggered dispatch list feel authored
  • Live validation as you type ('Looks like a complete address — reserve it.') plus a status region for the reading mode
  • Reading mode persists on <html>

Weaknesses

  • Odd oversized red mono '“FROM THE ESSAY”' pull-quote attribution
  • The left red margin rule stops partway down the page
  • Email input is a faint underline with only a 1px box-shadow on focus
Evidence the grader checked
  • H-sfull.png: red margin line ends near the contents
  • email typed valid -> 'Looks like a complete address — reserve it.' aria-invalid=false
  • styles.css:717 .input:focus { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 }

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0
