glm-5.3/12-frontend-editorial/RESPONSE.md

RESPONSE.md — Margin, Issue 14 “Low Water”

Art direction

The design translates the grammar of a printed journal — masthead, contents page with dot leaders, cover story with a drop cap, back-numbers strip, colophon footer — to a single scrolling page, rather than dressing up a landing-page template.

One display motif: the gauge. The whole issue is about a river in drought, so the page is built around measured lines. The hero is an inline SVG of a riverbed cross-section: seven contour lines sag toward a dashed low-water mark in oxide red, with a depth axis in −2 m steps and little finds (bottle caps, survey crosses, the dashed outline of a vanished street plan) scattered on the exposed bed. The same idea returns as the section dividers — a short ruled tag over a hatched ruler — and once more as a rust ledger line pinned to the far left of very wide viewports, like the red margin of a notebook. A huge pale “14” sits behind the subscription block the way a folio number bleeds off a page.

Typography. System serif (Georgia/Iowan/Palatino stack) for voice, system monospace for everything that is “apparatus” — kickers, bylines, archive numbers, prices, buttons. No web fonts, no network. Type scale is led by clamp(), and the two most print-like details are the justified, hyphenated cover lede with a river-green drop cap, and the italic pull quote hung off the right edge of the story.

Composition. Asymmetric, not gridded-into-sameness: the cover story uses a 12-column grid where the headline starts at column 1, the lede indents to column 3, and the pull quote hangs alone at columns 10–12; the three supporting entries step down the page with increasing indents, like entries slipping downstream; the subscription section pairs a wide argument (with a definition-list price table) against a hairline-ruled form. Rules do the work that boxes usually do: 4 pt double rules at the masthead and footer, single hairlines between stories, dotted leaders in the contents.

Color. A warm paper ground (#F6F1E7), near-black ink, one river green for accents, one oxide red for the low-water mark and out-of-print statuses. No gradients.

Responsive choices

  • Mobile-first single column (390 px verified in headless Chrome: scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390, no horizontal overflow). Reading order at 390 px is the intended narrative order — masthead, issue title, contents, cover story, three dispatches, archive, subscription, footer — confirmed programmatically by checking that anchor positions are monotonically increasing.
  • 720 px: the masthead becomes a spread (wordmark left, tagline right), stories become a three-part row (number / heading / summary) with dot-leader alignment, and the archive becomes a three-column strip.
  • 880 px: the hero splits into type and drawing; the cover story adopts its asymmetric 12-column composition; the subscription section splits with a hairline-ruled form column; stories take their stepped indents.
  • 1180 px+: the rust ledger line appears in the left margin, only once there is room to spare.
  • Spacing is driven by --gap: clamp(4.5rem … 8rem), so section rhythm scales with viewport instead of jumping.
  • Reading mode (the toggle in the masthead) raises the base size from 17 px to 20 px, loosens leading from 1.65 to 1.9, widens the measure, dims the drawing, and caps paragraph widths — and the choice persists in localStorage (with a safe fallback if storage is unavailable). Text remains the same size in both modes relative to each other, only the apparatus (mono labels) is untouched.

Accessibility

  • Semantics first: one h1, logical h2/h3 outline; nav around the contents; real form, label, and button elements; dl for the price terms.
  • The hero SVG is accessible: role="img" with a <title> and a long <desc> describing the contours, the gauge, and the finds, so screen-reader users get the same image the sighted reader does. focusable="false" keeps it out of the tab order.
  • Reading-mode control is a real button with aria-pressed state and a visually hidden role="status" region that announces the change; the label text also updates (“Reading mode · on”).
  • Form feedback is inline and announced: the feedback paragraph is role="status" aria-live="polite"; invalid states set aria-invalid on the field and are announced politely; the input has autocomplete="email" and inputmode="email"; success locks the form and changes the button to “Reserved”. Nothing is submitted anywhere — validation and success are entirely local.
  • Keyboard: a skip link to #main, visible :focus-visible outlines, and in-page anchors with scroll-margin-top. Smooth scrolling is disabled automatically under prefers-reduced-motion.
  • Motion: reveals are opt-in via a .js class and use IntersectionObserver with a timeout fallback; everything is shown immediately if the user prefers reduced motion or if the observer never fires. Decorative artwork is static (no animation).
  • Contrast: ink on paper is well above 7:1; the muted mono labels (#5B5346 on #F6F1E7) sit at ≈5.4:1; the rust accents are used only for large or bold marks; both toggle states keep at least 4.5:1.
  • Print: artwork, the toggle, and the form drop out; text prints at full opacity.

Verification

app.js passes node --check. The page was exercised in headless Chrome with a temporary harness: no horizontal overflow at 390 px, monotonic reading order, reading mode on/off state changes, empty/invalid submissions produce inline errors, a valid address produces the success message with the address echoed and the form locked, and all nine reveal targets become visible via the fallback timer. The harness and all screenshot files were removed afterward — the directory contains only index.html, styles.css, app.js, RESPONSE.md, plus the given TASK.md and COPY.md.

Margin — Issue 14 copy

The River Keeps Its Receipts — Imani Vale

Along a drought-exposed riverbed, shop ledgers, bottle caps, and vanished street plans surface together. A field essay about civic memory and what infrastructure tries to forget.

Night Bus Atlas — Tomás Iriarte

The unofficial geography drawn by cleaners, nurses, bakers, and drivers while a city's daytime map is asleep.

Concrete Orchards — Meera Das

Residents tend fruit trees in the unfinished floors of a financial district, negotiating shade, ownership, and the patience of roots.

A Language for Empty Pools — Hana Mori

Photographs and short notes from public baths retired after the last swimmer, where tile patterns keep directing bodies that no longer arrive.

Archive: Issue 13 — After the Last Train; Issue 12 — Borrowed Ground; Issue 11 — The Weather Indoors.

glm-5.3/12-frontend-editorial/TASK.md

Task 12 — Frontend design: editorial landing page

Build a distinctive responsive landing page for Margin, an independent quarterly journal about overlooked places. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: contemporary print editorial translated thoughtfully to the web. Use typography, rules, whitespace, asymmetric composition, and one strong display motif. It should feel authored rather than like a SaaS template. Avoid generic hero gradients, floating dashboard mockups, pill overload, and fake testimonials.

Content requirements:

  • Current issue: Low Water, Issue 14, Autumn 2026.
  • Cover story: “The River Keeps Its Receipts” by Imani Vale.
  • Supporting stories: “Night Bus Atlas,” “Concrete Orchards,” and “A Language for Empty Pools,” using the summaries in COPY.md.
  • A compact archive strip for Issues 11–13.
  • A clear subscription offer: print + digital, ¥2,400 per issue, cancel anytime.
  • A functional reading-mode control and a functional email field with inline validation/success feedback; no actual submission.
  • Strong mobile composition at 390 px and sensible reading order.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Decorative artwork must be CSS or inline SVG and accessible. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the art direction, responsive choices, and accessibility. Work only in this directory.

glm-5.3/12-frontend-editorial/app.js

/* Margin — Issue 14 · Low Water
   Reading-mode control, gentle reveals, and a local-only
   reservation form. No network requests anywhere. */

(function () {
  "use strict";

  var root = document.documentElement;
  root.classList.add("js");

  var STORAGE_KEY = "margin.reading-mode";
  var prefersReduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  function safeGet(key) {
    try {
      return window.localStorage.getItem(key);
    } catch (err) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function safeSet(key, value) {
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(key, value);
    } catch (err) {
      /* Storage unavailable — the toggle still works for this visit. */
    }
  }

  /* ---- Reading mode ---- */

  var modeToggle = document.getElementById("reading-toggle");
  var modeStatus = document.getElementById("mode-status");

  function applyReadingMode(on) {
    root.classList.toggle("reading-mode", on);
    if (modeToggle) {
      modeToggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on ? "true" : "false");
      var label = modeToggle.querySelector(".mode-label");
      if (label) {
        label.textContent = on ? "Reading mode \u00B7 on" : "Reading mode";
      }
    }
    if (modeStatus) {
      modeStatus.textContent = on
        ? "Reading mode on. Type is larger and spacing is calmer."
        : "Reading mode off. Standard layout restored.";
    }
  }

  if (safeGet(STORAGE_KEY) === "on") {
    applyReadingMode(true);
  }

  if (modeToggle) {
    modeToggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var on = !root.classList.contains("reading-mode");
      applyReadingMode(on);
      safeSet(STORAGE_KEY, on ? "on" : "off");
    });
  }

  /* ---- Gentle reveals ---- */

  var revealItems = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".reveal"));

  if (prefersReduced || !("IntersectionObserver" in window)) {
    revealItems.forEach(function (el) {
      el.classList.add("is-in");
    });
  } else {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(
      function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add("is-in");
            io.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.08, rootMargin: "0px 0px -24px 0px" }
    );
    revealItems.forEach(function (el) {
      io.observe(el);
    });

    /* Safety net: if an observer never reports (headless, print,
       embedded views), fade everything in after a beat. */
    window.setTimeout(function () {
      revealItems.forEach(function (el) {
        el.classList.add("is-in");
      });
    }, 2500);
  }

  /* ---- Reservation form (inline validation, nothing is submitted) ---- */

  var form = document.getElementById("reserve-form");
  var emailInput = document.getElementById("email");
  var feedback = document.getElementById("form-feedback");
  var submitBtn = document.getElementById("reserve-submit");
  var EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+[.][^\s@]{2,}$/;

  if (!form || !emailInput || !feedback) {
    return;
  }

  function showMessage(state, text) {
    feedback.className = "form-feedback" + (state ? " " + state : "");
    feedback.textContent = text;
    emailInput.setAttribute("aria-invalid", state === "error" ? "true" : "false");
  }

  function validateValue(value) {
    if (value === "") {
      showMessage("error", "Add an email address so we know where to write.");
      return false;
    }
    if (!EMAIL.test(value)) {
      showMessage("error", "That address looks unfinished \u2014 check the part after the @.");
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    var value = emailInput.value.trim();
    if (!validateValue(value)) {
      emailInput.focus();
      return;
    }
    showMessage(
      "ok",
      "Reserved \u2014 Issue 14 will ship to " + value + ". Nothing was sent from this page, and you can cancel anytime."
    );
    emailInput.readOnly = true;
    if (submitBtn) {
      submitBtn.disabled = true;
      submitBtn.textContent = "Reserved";
    }
  });

  emailInput.addEventListener("input", function () {
    if (emailInput.readOnly) {
      return;
    }
    if (feedback.classList.contains("error")) {
      var value = emailInput.value.trim();
      if (EMAIL.test(value)) {
        showMessage("", "Looks like a complete address \u2014 reserve it.");
      } else if (value === "") {
        showMessage("", "");
      }
    }
  });

  emailInput.addEventListener("blur", function () {
    if (emailInput.readOnly) {
      return;
    }
    var value = emailInput.value.trim();
    if (value !== "") {
      validateValue(value);
    }
  });
})();

          <span class="entry-no" aria-hidden="true">02</span>
          <div class="entry-head">
            <h3>Night Bus Atlas</h3>
            <p class="byline">By Tom&#225;s Iriarte &#183; Mapping</p>
          </div>
          <p class="entry-summary">The unofficial geography drawn by cleaners, nurses, bakers, and drivers while a city&#8217;s daytime map is asleep.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="entry" id="orchards">
          <span class="entry-no" aria-hidden="true">03</span>
          <div class="entry-head">
            <h3>Concrete Orchards</h3>
            <p class="byline">By Meera Das &#183; Field report</p>
          </div>
          <p class="entry-summary">Residents tend fruit trees in the unfinished floors of a financial district, negotiating shade, ownership, and the patience of roots.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="entry" id="pools">
          <span class="entry-no" aria-hidden="true">04</span>
          <div class="entry-head">
            <h3>A Language for Empty Pools</h3>
            <p class="byline">By Hana Mori &#183; Photography &amp; notes</p>
          </div>
          <p class="entry-summary">Photographs and short notes from public baths retired after the last swimmer, where tile patterns keep directing bodies that no longer arrive.</p>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </section>

    <section class="archive-sec section wrap reveal" aria-labelledby="archive-title">
      <div class="gauge" aria-hidden="true"><span class="gauge-tag">Archive &#183; Issues 11&#8211;13</span></div>
      <h2 id="archive-title" class="sec-title">Back numbers</h2>
      <ul class="archive">
        <li>
          <p class="arc-no">No. 13</p>
          <p class="arc-title">After the Last Train</p>
          <p class="arc-meta">Summer 2026 &#183; <span class="st st-ok">Available</span></p>
        </li>
        <li>
          <p class="arc-no">No. 12</p>
          <p class="arc-title">Borrowed Ground</p>
          <p class="arc-meta">Spring 2026 &#183; <span class="st st-low">Last copies</span></p>
        </li>
        <li>
          <p class="arc-no">No. 11</p>
          <p class="arc-title">The Weather Indoors</p>
          <p class="arc-meta">Winter 2025 &#183; <span class="st st-out">Out of print</span></p>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </section>

    <section class="subscribe section wrap reveal" id="subscribe" aria-labelledby="sub-title">
      <div class="gauge" aria-hidden="true"><span class="gauge-tag">05 &#183; Subscribe</span></div>
      <span class="ghost" aria-hidden="true">14</span>
      <div class="sub-grid">
        <div class="sub-copy">
          <h2 id="sub-title">Two formats.<br>One slow read.</h2>
          <p class="sub-para">Every quarter, Margin arrives as a printed edition with a digital companion &#8212; the same four stories, set carefully. No ads, no infinite scroll, no algorithm.</p>
          <dl class="terms">
            <div><dt>Formats</dt><dd>Print + digital</dd></div>
            <div><dt>Price</dt><dd>&#165;2,400 per issue</dd></div>
            <div><dt>Delivery</dt><dd>Ships worldwide</dd></div>
            <div><dt>Commitment</dt><dd>Cancel anytime</dd></div>
          </dl>
        </div>
        <form class="sub-form" id="reserve-form" novalidate>
          <h3 class="form-title">Reserve Issue 14</h3>
          <label class="field-label" for="email">Your email address</label>
          <input class="input" type="email" id="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" inputmode="email" required aria-describedby="form-hint form-feedback">
          <p class="form-hint" id="form-hint">You&#8217;ll only hear from us when an issue ships. No charge today.</p>
          <button class="btn" id="reserve-submit" type="submit">Reserve Issue 14</button>
          <p class="form-feedback" id="form-feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
        </form>
      </div>
    </section>

  </main>

  <footer class="footer">
    <div class="wrap footer-grid">
      <p class="footer-word">Margin &#8212; an independent quarterly about overlooked places.</p>
      <p class="footer-meta">No cookies &#183; no trackers &#183; this page works offline</p>
    </div>
    <div class="wrap footer-base">
      <p>Issue 14, Low Water &#183; Autumn 2026 &#183; Set in system serif &amp; monospace &#183; artwork drawn in SVG</p>
      <a class="to-top" href="#top">Top &#8593;</a>
    </div>
  </footer>
</body>

glm-5.3/12-frontend-editorial/styles.css

/* ============================================================
   Margin — Issue 14, “Low Water”
   Print-editorial landing page. Local system fonts only.
   ============================================================ */

/* ---------- Tokens ---------- */

:root {
  --paper: #F6F1E7;
  --paper-deep: #EDE4D0;
  --ghost-num: #E7DCC3;
  --ink: #1C1812;
  --ink-soft: #5B5346;
  --hair: rgba(28, 24, 18, 0.25);
  --river: #2C5A50;
  --rust: #8C2D12;

  --serif: Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", "Times New Roman", serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace;

  --text: 1.0625rem;
  --lh: 1.65;
  --measure: 36rem;
  --gap: clamp(4.5rem, 10vw, 8rem);
  --pad: clamp(1.15rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
  --max: 74rem;
}

html.reading-mode {
  --text: 1.25rem;
  --lh: 1.9;
  --measure: 41rem;
  --gap: clamp(5.5rem, 11vw, 9rem);
}

/* ---------- Base ---------- */

*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-x: clip;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: var(--text);
  line-height: var(--lh);
}

p {
  margin: 0;
}

h1, h2, h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 400;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
}

img, svg {
  max-width: 100%;
}

::selection {
  background: var(--river);
  color: var(--paper);
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ink);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.wrap {
  max-width: var(--max);
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-inline: var(--pad);
}

.section {
  margin-top: var(--gap);
  scroll-margin-top: 3rem;
}

/* ---------- Utility ---------- */

.skip {
  position: absolute;
  top: -4rem;
  left: 1rem;
  z-index: 20;
  padding: 0.7rem 1.2rem;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: top 0.2s ease;
}

.skip:focus {
  top: 1rem;
}

.sr-status {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  margin: -1px;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.label,
.gauge-tag,
.byline,
.note,
.kicker,
.meta-issue,
.tagline,
.arc-no,
.arc-meta,
.field-label,
.form-hint,
.form-feedback,
.footer-meta,
.to-top,
.mode-toggle,
.entry-no {
  font-family: var(--mono);
}

/* ---------- Reveal (progressive enhancement) ---------- */

html.js .reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(14px);
  transition: opacity 0.65s ease, transform 0.65s ease;
}

html.js .reveal.is-in {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

/* ---------- Masthead ---------- */

.masthead {
  border-top: 5px solid var(--ink);
  padding-top: 1.4rem;
}

.masthead-top {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.wordmark {
  font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 9vw, 5.2rem);
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.tagline {
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.masthead-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  margin-top: 1.3rem;
  padding-block: 0.8rem;
  border-top: 4px double var(--ink);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
}

.meta-issue {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.mode-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65em;
  padding: 0.5em 1em;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
}

.mode-toggle:hover {
  background: rgba(28, 24, 18, 0.07);
}

.mode-dot {
  width: 0.55em;
  height: 0.55em;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex: none;
}

.mode-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
}

.mode-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] .mode-dot {
  background: var(--paper);
  border-color: var(--paper);
}

/* ---------- Hero ---------- */

.hero {
  display: grid;
  gap: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 4rem);
  margin-top: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
  scroll-margin-top: 3rem;
}

.kicker {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--river);
  margin-bottom: 1.1rem;
}

.hero h1 {
  font-size: clamp(4.1rem, 14vw, 10rem);
  line-height: 0.94;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
}

.hero h1 .t2 {
  font-style: italic;
}

.issue-meta {
  margin-top: 1.4rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  max-width: 34ch;
}

.hero-art {
  max-width: 34rem;
}

.hero-svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

.hero-svg .c-line {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--ink);
  stroke-width: 1.4;
}

.hero-svg .g-ax {
  stroke: var(--ink);
  stroke-width: 1.2;
}

.hero-svg .g-tick {
  stroke: var(--ink);
  stroke-width: 1.2;
}

.hero-svg .g-label {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  fill: var(--ink-soft);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.hero-svg .lwm {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--rust);
  stroke-width: 1.4;
  stroke-dasharray: 7 5;
}

.hero-svg .lwm-label {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  fill: var(--rust);
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
}

.hero-svg .xmark {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--ink);
  stroke-width: 1.2;
}

.hero-svg .cap {
  fill: var(--paper);
  stroke: var(--ink);
  stroke-width: 1.4;
}

.hero-svg .plan {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--ink-soft);
  stroke-width: 1.1;
  stroke-dasharray: 4 3;
}

/* ---------- Contents ---------- */

.contents {
  margin-top: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5rem);
  border-top: 4px double var(--ink);
  padding-top: 1.3rem;
}

.contents .label {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.contents ol {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  counter-reset: contents;
}

.contents li {
  counter-increment: contents;
}

.contents li + li {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.contents a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding-block: 0.35rem;
  font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2.4vw, 1.3rem);
  line-height: 1.35;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-color: rgba(44, 90, 80, 0.4);
  text-underline-offset: 0.3em;
}

.contents a::before {
  content: counter(contents, decimal-leading-zero);
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.75em;
  color: var(--river);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  flex: none;
}

.contents a:hover {
  text-decoration-color: var(--river);
}

.contents .leader {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 1.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted rgba(28, 24, 18, 0.55);
  transform: translateY(-0.3em);
}

.contents .who {
  flex: none;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

/* ---------- Gauge divider (section motif) ---------- */

.gauge {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  margin-bottom: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3rem);
}

.gauge::after {
  content: "";
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  height: 8px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ink);
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    to right,
    rgba(28, 24, 18, 0.4) 0 1px,
    transparent 1px 10px
  );
}

.gauge-tag {
  flex: none;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding-bottom: 3px;
}

/* ---------- Cover story ---------- */

.sec-title {
  font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4.5vw, 2.7rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.cover-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2.2rem;
}

.cover-head h2 {
  font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 8vw, 5rem);
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.cover-head h2 em {
  font-style: italic;
}

.byline {
  margin-top: 1.1rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.lede {
  max-width: 34rem;
  text-align: justify;
  hyphens: auto;
  line-height: 1.7;
  font-size: calc(var(--text) * 1.12);
}

.lede::first-letter {
  float: left;
  font-size: 3em;
  line-height: 0.84;
  padding: 0.05em 0.14em 0 0;
  color: var(--river);
}

.note {
  margin-top: 1.6rem;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.pull {
  margin: 0;
}

.pull p {
  font-size: clamp(1.45rem, 3.5vw, 2rem);
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.pull p::before {
  content: "\201C";
}

.pull p::after {
  content: "\201D";
}

.pull-src {
  margin-top: 0.9rem;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--rust);
}

/* ---------- Story index ---------- */

.index {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.entry {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-block: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.4rem);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ink);
  scroll-margin-top: 3.5rem;
}

.entry:last-child {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
}

.entry-no {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: var(--river);
}

.entry h3 {
  font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 4.5vw, 2.2rem);
  line-height: 1.08;
}

.entry .byline {
  margin-top: 0.55rem;
}

.entry-summary {
  max-width: min(100%, var(--measure));
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  line-height: 1.7;
}

/* ---------- Archive strip ---------- */

.archive {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  display: grid;
  gap: 1.6rem;
}

.archive li {
  border-left: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding-left: 1.1rem;
}

.arc-no {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--river);
}

.arc-title {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

.arc-meta {
  margin-top: 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.st-ok {
  color: var(--river);
}

.st-low {
  color: var(--ink);
}

.st-out {
  color: var(--rust);
}

/* ---------- Subscribe ---------- */

.subscribe {
  position: relative;
}

.ghost {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -0.18em;
  font-size: clamp(13rem, 30vw, 24rem);
  line-height: 0.7;
  color: var(--ghost-num);
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;
}

html.reading-mode .ghost {
  opacity: 0.4;
}

.sub-grid {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  gap: 3rem;
}

.sub-copy h2 {
  font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 6vw, 3.4rem);
  line-height: 1.04;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.sub-para {
  margin-top: 1.4rem;
  max-width: 42ch;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.terms {
  margin: 2rem 0 0;
}

.terms > div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  padding-block: 0.85rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--hair);
}

.terms dt {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--river);
}

.terms dd {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  text-align: right;
}

/* --- Form --- */

.form-title {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
}

.field-label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
}

.input {
  width: 100%;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 0;
  padding: 0.65em 0;
  outline: none;
  transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}

.input:focus {
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 var(--river);
}

.input[aria-invalid="true"] {
  border-bottom-color: var(--rust);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 var(--rust);
}

.input[readonly] {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.form-hint {
  margin-top: 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  max-width: 34ch;
}

.btn {
  margin-top: 1.7rem;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 0.85em 1.5em;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, transform 0.1s ease;
}

.btn:hover {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
}

.btn:active {
  transform: translateY(1px);
}

.btn:disabled {
  background: var(--paper-deep);
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  border-color: rgba(28, 24, 18, 0.35);
  cursor: default;
}

.form-feedback {
  margin-top: 1.2rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  min-height: 3.4em;
  max-width: 40ch;
}

.form-feedback.error {
  color: var(--rust);
}

.form-feedback.ok {
  color: var(--river);
}

/* ---------- Footer ---------- */

.footer {
  margin-top: var(--gap);
  border-top: 4px double var(--ink);
  padding-block: 1.8rem 3rem;
}

.footer-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.6rem 3rem;
}

.footer-word {
  font-style: italic;
  max-width: 44ch;
}

.footer-meta {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.footer-base {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.5rem 3rem;
  margin-top: 2.2rem;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.to-top {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 0.3em;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}

/* ---------- Reading mode ---------- */

html.reading-mode .hero-svg {
  opacity: 0.35;
}

html.reading-mode .lede,
html.reading-mode .entry-summary,
html.reading-mode .sub-para {
  max-width: min(100%, var(--measure));
}

/* ---------- Responsive ---------- */

@media (min-width: 720px) {
  .masthead-top {
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-end;
  }

  .tagline {
    text-align: right;
    margin-top: 0;
  }

  .entry {
    grid-template-columns: 4ch minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr);
    gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  }

  .entry-no {
    padding-top: 0.5rem;
  }

  .archive {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .footer-grid,
  .footer-base {
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 880px) {
  .hero {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 0.85fr);
    align-items: start;
  }

  .hero-art {
    justify-self: end;
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: -2.5rem;
    max-width: none;
  }

  .cover-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
    gap: 2.2rem;
  }

  .cover-head {
    grid-column: 1 / span 7;
  }

  .cover-body {
    grid-column: 3 / span 6;
    margin-top: 1rem;
  }

  .pull {
    grid-column: 10 / span 3;
    grid-row: 1 / span 2;
    align-self: end;
    justify-self: end;
    text-align: right;
    max-width: 18rem;
  }

  .entry:nth-child(2) {
    padding-left: 8%;
  }

  .entry:nth-child(3) {
    padding-left: 16%;
  }

  .sub-grid {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 0.9fr);
    gap: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem);
  }

  .sub-form {
    border-left: 1px solid var(--ink);
    padding-left: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
  }
}

/* Ledger margin line: appears once the page has room to spare. */
@media (min-width: 1180px) {
  body::before {
    content: "";
    position: fixed;
    inset-block: 0;
    left: calc(50% - var(--max) / 2 - 4.5rem);
    width: 0;
    border-left: 2px solid var(--rust);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
}

/* ---------- Motion preferences ---------- */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: auto;
  }

  html.js .reveal {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    transition: none;
  }

  .btn,
  .mode-toggle,
  .input {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* ---------- Print ---------- */

@media print {
  body {
    background: #fff;
  }

  .mode-toggle,
  .sub-form,
  .hero-svg,
  .ghost {
    display: none;
  }

  html.js .reveal {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}

Evaluation 7.75 / 10 graded blind as submission S

Warm editorial page: a 'Low / Water' italic display, an illustrated gauge-staff cover plate, a ruler motif, a staggered contents list and a clean offer card. It is attractive, but the reading-mode toggle becomes nearly invisible once switched on.

Strengths

  • Illustrated gauge plate with role=img and a meaningful caption
  • role=alert errors, status success; focusable archive scroller
  • Reading mode (dark) persists

Weaknesses

  • In reading mode the toggle text is 1.52:1 against its background, so the control to exit is hard to see
  • Pull quote reuses a COPY summary as a quote attributed to Tomás Iriarte
  • Generous empty space in places
Evidence the grader checked
  • contrast.js alt: 'BUTTON.btn-toggle Reading mode · on' 1.52:1
  • email invalid -> role=alert 'That doesn’t look like an email address...'
  • tab order includes UL archive (tabindex)

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

qwen3.8-max/12-frontend-editorial/RESPONSE.md

RESPONSE — Margin, Issue 14 “Low Water”

Files: index.html, styles.css, app.js. No frameworks, no build step, no remote assets, no external fonts, no network requests of any kind (the favicon is an inline data: URI; the subscribe form is preventDefaulted).

Art direction

Concept. The whole page is set as the cover-and-contents spread of a print quarterly, and the single display motif is a river gauge staff — the graded measuring stick left in a river to record its level. It earns its place because Issue 14 is literally about a river at 0.4 m: the motif is the subject.

The gauge appears at four scales:

  1. The cover plate — a hand-built inline SVG: sediment bands stacked by opacity, a low rust sun, a dashed “usual high water” line, and a numbered staff whose waterline pointer sits at 0.4 m. The objects the river “keeps” (a ruled shop ledger, a notched bottle cap, a torn street-plan grid) lie exposed on the bed above the waterline, straight out of the cover essay.
  2. The gauge rule — a CSS-only strip of major/minor tick marks (repeating-linear-gradient) under the sticky masthead and above the colophon, like the printed measurement edge of a broadsheet.
  3. Micro-ticks — the small .ticks dividers framing the pull quote and each archive card.
  4. Typographic echoes — section folios (“№ 02 · Contents”), mono gauge labels, and contents entries numbered 01–04 like staff readings.

Palette & type. Warm newsprint (#f2ecdf), letterpress ink, one river-teal accent, one oxidised-rust mark — no gradients, no glass, no pill buttons. Type is local-only: an old-style serif stack (Iowan/Palatino/Georgia) for display and body, monospace for folios, labels, and gauges — the two-family pairing of print magazines. The masthead title mixes roman (“Low”) with italic teal (“Water”), and the cover plate is framed by a misregistered double rule (two 1-px frames offset by a few pixels), a deliberate nod to a second printing plate laid a hair off. The plate is even rotated −0.6°, like a tipped-in plate.

Composition. Asymmetric by design: a 7/5 cover grid with the art dropped 3.5 rem below the headline; contents rows that step toward the gutter on alternate entries; archive cards with staggered baselines; the subscribe card offset from the offer column. Rules and whitespace do the separating — there are no cards-with-shadows, hero gradients, or testimonial furniture anywhere.

Responsive choices

Mobile-first CSS; the 390 px composition is the base, not a fallback.

  • 390 px: single column, 1.25 rem side margins, headline clamped to 15vw (~4–5.5 rem) so “Low / Water” always fits on two lines. The folio bar becomes a 2-row grid: wordmark + reading-mode toggle on row one, issue line on row two (long tagline hidden). Cover art sits below the cover-story block, so the reading order is: issue → title → standfirst → cover story → plate. Contents rows collapse to marker + body with the genre label tucked underneath. The archive strip becomes a horizontal scroller with scroll-snap-type: x proximity, 78%-wide cards, visible thin scrollbar, and tabindex="0" so keyboard users can scroll it.
  • 640–759 px: archive cards widen to 55% (two visible, implying scroll); button padding grows.
  • ≥760 px: archive becomes a 3-column print spread with staggered top padding and hairline dividers; colophon goes 3-up.
  • ≥900 px: the asymmetric 7/5 cover grid, 3-column contents rows with the alternating gutter step, plate tilt, and the two-column subscribe section switch on.
  • ≥1024 px: the full folio bar (wordmark · tagline · issue · toggle) on one line.

All scaling is clamp()-based, so intermediate widths interpolate instead of jumping. The sticky masthead is paired with scroll-padding-top so anchor jumps never land under it.

Reading mode (functional)

The masthead toggle switches html.reading, which swaps the entire custom-property palette to a warm night-desk theme (bg #16120e, ink #ece2cd), raises the root font size to 112.5%, and loosens body leading to 1.72 — a genuine reading mode, not just a dark filter. Because every colour is a variable (including the SVG paint roles), the illustration re-inks with the page. The state is exposed via aria-pressed plus a visible “on/off” label, persists in localStorage (try/catch-guarded), and is pre-applied by a tiny inline head script so a saved choice never flashes white on load.

Email field (functional, no submission)

novalidate form with custom inline validation:

  • Blur on a non-empty field starts validation; submit always validates.
  • Empty → “Please enter your email address.”; malformed → a correction hint with an example. Errors render in a role="alert" paragraph wired to the input via aria-describedby, and set aria-invalid="true" plus a rust border.
  • Once touched, live re-validation on input clears the error the moment the address becomes valid; typing also clears any stale success message.
  • On success, event.preventDefault() runs (nothing is sent anywhere), the form resets, and a confirmation appears in a polite role="status" live region, explicitly marked “Demo only: nothing left your browser.”
  • A <noscript> note explains that only the form needs JS; the page itself is fully readable without it (reveals are gated behind a .js class the script adds, so no-JS users see all content immediately).

Accessibility

  • Semantics & landmarks: header/main/footer, one h1, sections labelled via aria-labelledby, an ordered list for contents, a skip link, and DOM order identical to visual order at every breakpoint (no order tricks; the mobile stack is the source order).
  • The artwork: the cover SVG is role="img" with a <title> and a rich <desc> (gauge reading, exposed objects, high-water line) referenced by aria-labelledby, and a visible figcaption. Purely decorative marks (tick rules, story numbers, archive numerals, birds) are aria-hidden.
  • Contrast: ink on paper ≈ 13:1; soft ink ≈ 6.2:1; teal accent ≈ 6.1:1; rust is ≈ 4.3:1 and therefore reserved for large text, rules, and graphics. The reading-mode palette is re-tuned (lighter teal/rust on near-black) to hold the same ratios.
  • Keyboard & focus: every control is a real button/input/a; a visible 2-px :focus-visible outline (offset) is themed per mode; the scrollable archive strip is focusable; the toggle’s state is in the accessibility tree via aria-pressed and announced as text.
  • Motion: scroll reveals honor prefers-reduced-motion (both in JS — the observer is skipped — and CSS — transforms/transitions are removed), scroll-behavior: smooth falls back to auto, and the plate tilt is disabled.
  • Forms: labels are real <label for>, autocomplete="email", inputmode="email", errors are programmatic and visual (never colour-only), and feedback goes through live regions instead of focus games.

Margin — Issue 14 copy

The River Keeps Its Receipts — Imani Vale

Along a drought-exposed riverbed, shop ledgers, bottle caps, and vanished street plans surface together. A field essay about civic memory and what infrastructure tries to forget.

Night Bus Atlas — Tomás Iriarte

The unofficial geography drawn by cleaners, nurses, bakers, and drivers while a city's daytime map is asleep.

Concrete Orchards — Meera Das

Residents tend fruit trees in the unfinished floors of a financial district, negotiating shade, ownership, and the patience of roots.

A Language for Empty Pools — Hana Mori

Photographs and short notes from public baths retired after the last swimmer, where tile patterns keep directing bodies that no longer arrive.

Archive: Issue 13 — After the Last Train; Issue 12 — Borrowed Ground; Issue 11 — The Weather Indoors.

qwen3.8-max/12-frontend-editorial/TASK.md

Task 12 — Frontend design: editorial landing page

Build a distinctive responsive landing page for Margin, an independent quarterly journal about overlooked places. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: contemporary print editorial translated thoughtfully to the web. Use typography, rules, whitespace, asymmetric composition, and one strong display motif. It should feel authored rather than like a SaaS template. Avoid generic hero gradients, floating dashboard mockups, pill overload, and fake testimonials.

Content requirements:

  • Current issue: Low Water, Issue 14, Autumn 2026.
  • Cover story: “The River Keeps Its Receipts” by Imani Vale.
  • Supporting stories: “Night Bus Atlas,” “Concrete Orchards,” and “A Language for Empty Pools,” using the summaries in COPY.md.
  • A compact archive strip for Issues 11–13.
  • A clear subscription offer: print + digital, ¥2,400 per issue, cancel anytime.
  • A functional reading-mode control and a functional email field with inline validation/success feedback; no actual submission.
  • Strong mobile composition at 390 px and sensible reading order.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Decorative artwork must be CSS or inline SVG and accessible. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the art direction, responsive choices, and accessibility. Work only in this directory.

qwen3.8-max/12-frontend-editorial/app.js

/* Margin — Issue 14 “Low Water”
   Reading-mode control, scroll reveals, and demo subscribe form.
   Nothing here talks to a network; the form never submits. */

(function () {
  "use strict";

  var root = document.documentElement;
  root.classList.add("js");

  /* ── Reading mode ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
     A single control that re-inks the whole page: night paper palette,
     112.5% type, airier leading. The choice persists in localStorage
     and is pre-applied by an inline head script to avoid a flash. */

  var STORAGE_KEY = "margin:reading-mode";
  var toggle = document.getElementById("reading-toggle");
  var toggleState = document.getElementById("reading-state");

  function store(value) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, value);
    } catch (err) {
      /* private mode or blocked storage — the toggle still works in-session */
    }
  }

  function setReadingMode(on) {
    root.classList.toggle("reading", on);
    if (toggle) {
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on ? "true" : "false");
    }
    if (toggleState) {
      toggleState.textContent = on ? "on" : "off";
    }
    store(on ? "on" : "off");
  }

  if (toggle) {
    var saved = null;
    try {
      saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    } catch (err) {
      saved = null;
    }
    setReadingMode(saved === "on" || root.classList.contains("reading"));

    toggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
      setReadingMode(!root.classList.contains("reading"));
    });
  }

  /* ── Scroll reveals ────────────────────────────────────────────────
     Elements start hidden only when JS is present (.js class). With no
     IntersectionObserver or with reduced-motion preferred, everything
     is shown immediately. */

  var reveals = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".reveal"));
  var reduceMotion =
    window.matchMedia &&
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window && !reduceMotion) {
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add("is-visible");
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.08, rootMargin: "0px 0px -6% 0px" }
    );
    reveals.forEach(function (el) {
      observer.observe(el);
    });
  } else {
    reveals.forEach(function (el) {
      el.classList.add("is-visible");
    });
  }

  /* ── Subscribe form (demo) ─────────────────────────────────────────
     Inline validation on blur/submit, live correction once the field has
     been touched, success via a polite live region. preventDefault means
     no data ever leaves the browser. */

  var form = document.getElementById("subscribe-form");
  var email = document.getElementById("email");
  var errorEl = document.getElementById("email-error");
  var statusEl = document.getElementById("form-status");

  if (form && email && errorEl && statusEl) {
    var EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/;
    var touched = false;

    var setError = function (message) {
      errorEl.textContent = message;
      errorEl.hidden = false;
      email.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
      email.classList.add("is-invalid");
    };

    var clearError = function () {
      errorEl.textContent = "";
      errorEl.hidden = true;
      email.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");
      email.classList.remove("is-invalid");
    };

    var validate = function () {
      var value = email.value.trim();
      if (value === "") {
        setError("Please enter your email address.");
        return false;
      }
      if (!EMAIL_RE.test(value)) {
        setError(
          "That doesn’t look like an email address — please check it " +
            "(for example, name@example.com)."
        );
        return false;
      }
      clearError();
      return true;
    };

    email.addEventListener("blur", function () {
      if (email.value.trim() !== "") {
        touched = true;
        validate();
      }
    });

    email.addEventListener("input", function () {
      statusEl.textContent = "";
      if (touched) {
        validate();
      }
    });

    form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
      event.preventDefault(); /* demo only — nothing is sent anywhere */
      statusEl.textContent = "";
      touched = true;

      if (!validate()) {
        email.focus();
        return;
      }

      statusEl.textContent =
        "You’re on the list for Issue 14 — “Low Water.” It will reach you " +
        "when it ships. (Demo only: nothing left your browser.)";
      form.reset();
      touched = false;
      clearError();
    });
  }
})();

                  <text x="482" y="655">0.5</text>
                  <text x="482" y="760">0.0</text>
                </g>
                <!-- current reading -->
                <path class="art-highlight" d="M520 662 L 520 680 L 496 671 Z"/>
                <text class="reading-label" x="488" y="694" text-anchor="end">0.4 m</text>
              </g>
              <!-- misregistered double frame -->
              <rect class="art-stroke-rule-strong" x="6" y="6" width="628" height="808" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <rect class="art-stroke-rule" x="13" y="17" width="621" height="797" stroke-width="1" opacity=".8"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <figcaption>
            Gauge staff no.&nbsp;14 reads 0.4&nbsp;m — the bed gives back a ledger,
            a bottle cap, and half a street plan.
          </figcaption>
        </figure>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ═══ Contents ════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <section class="features section wrap" id="contents" aria-labelledby="contents-title">
      <div class="section-head reveal">
        <p class="kicker">№ 02 · Contents</p>
        <h2 id="contents-title">In this issue</h2>
      </div>

      <ol class="story-list">
        <li class="story reveal" id="story-river">
          <p class="story-marker" aria-hidden="true">01</p>
          <div class="story-body">
            <h3>The River Keeps Its Receipts</h3>
            <p class="byline">by Imani Vale</p>
            <p class="story-dek">
              Along a drought-exposed riverbed, shop ledgers, bottle caps, and
              vanished street plans surface together. A field essay about civic
              memory and what infrastructure tries to forget.
            </p>
          </div>
          <p class="story-kind">Field essay</p>
        </li>

        <li class="story reveal" id="story-nightbus" style="--i:1">
          <p class="story-marker" aria-hidden="true">02</p>
          <div class="story-body">
            <h3>Night Bus Atlas</h3>
            <p class="byline">by Tomás Iriarte</p>
            <p class="story-dek">
              The unofficial geography drawn by cleaners, nurses, bakers, and
              drivers while a city’s daytime map is asleep.
            </p>
          </div>
          <p class="story-kind">Essay</p>
        </li>

        <li class="story reveal" id="story-orchards" style="--i:2">
          <p class="story-marker" aria-hidden="true">03</p>
          <div class="story-body">
            <h3>Concrete Orchards</h3>
            <p class="byline">by Meera Das</p>
            <p class="story-dek">
              Residents tend fruit trees in the unfinished floors of a financial
              district, negotiating shade, ownership, and the patience of roots.
            </p>
          </div>
          <p class="story-kind">Reportage</p>
        </li>

        <li class="story reveal" id="story-pools" style="--i:3">
          <p class="story-marker" aria-hidden="true">04</p>
          <div class="story-body">
            <h3>A Language for Empty Pools</h3>
            <p class="byline">by Hana Mori</p>
            <p class="story-dek">
              Photographs and short notes from public baths retired after the
              last swimmer, where tile patterns keep directing bodies that no
              longer arrive.
            </p>
          </div>
          <p class="story-kind">Photo essay</p>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </section>

    <!-- ═══ Pull quote ══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <aside class="pull wrap reveal" aria-label="Pull quote from this issue">
      <div class="ticks" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <blockquote>
        <p>
          “The unofficial geography drawn by cleaners, nurses, bakers, and
          drivers while a city’s daytime map is asleep.”
        </p>
        <cite>Tomás Iriarte — “Night Bus Atlas,” Issue 14</cite>
      </blockquote>
      <div class="ticks" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    </aside>

    <!-- ═══ Archive ═════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <section class="archive section wrap" id="archive" aria-labelledby="archive-title">
      <div class="section-head reveal">
        <p class="kicker">№ 03 · Back issues</p>
        <h2 id="archive-title">From the archive</h2>
        <p class="section-note">Recent issues remain in print while stocks last.</p>
      </div>

      <ul class="archive-strip reveal" tabindex="0" aria-label="Archive strip, Issues 11 to 13 — horizontally scrollable on small screens">
        <li class="archive-card">
          <p class="archive-no" aria-hidden="true">13</p>
          <div class="ticks archive-ticks" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <h3>After the Last Train</h3>
          <p class="archive-meta">Issue 13 · Summer 2026</p>
        </li>
        <li class="archive-card">
          <p class="archive-no" aria-hidden="true">12</p>
          <div class="ticks archive-ticks" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <h3>Borrowed Ground</h3>
          <p class="archive-meta">Issue 12 · Spring 2026</p>
        </li>
        <li class="archive-card">
          <p class="archive-no" aria-hidden="true">11</p>
          <div class="ticks archive-ticks" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <h3>The Weather Indoors</h3>
          <p class="archive-meta">Issue 11 · Winter 2025</p>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </section>

    <!-- ═══ Subscribe ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <section class="subscribe section wrap" id="subscribe" aria-labelledby="subscribe-title">
      <div class="subscribe-grid">
        <div class="offer reveal">
          <p class="kicker">№ 04 · Subscribe</p>
          <h2 id="subscribe-title">Four issues a year. Paper and pixels.</h2>
          <p class="offer-copy">
            Margin is independent — no advertisers, no sponsors, no algorithm.
            Just a quarterly dispatch about the places the map forgot.
          </p>
          <p class="price">
            <span class="price-amount">¥2,400</span>
            <span class="price-unit">/ per issue</span>
          </p>
          <ul class="offer-list">
            <li>Print + digital, every issue</li>
            <li>¥2,400 per issue — nothing else to pay</li>
            <li>Cancel anytime</li>
          </ul>
        </div>

        <div class="form-card frame reveal" style="--i:1">
          <form id="subscribe-form" novalidate>
            <h3>Start a subscription</h3>
            <p class="form-intro">
              Leave your email and Issue 14 — <em>Low Water</em> — will reach you
              when it ships.
            </p>
            <label for="email">Email address</label>
            <input id="email" name="email" type="email" inputmode="email"
                   autocomplete="email" spellcheck="false" placeholder="you@example.com"
                   aria-describedby="email-hint email-error" required>
            <p class="hint" id="email-hint">One letter per issue. Nothing else, ever.</p>
            <p class="error" id="email-error" role="alert" hidden></p>
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-solid">Subscribe</button>
            <p class="form-status" id="form-status" role="status"></p>
          </form>
          <noscript>
            <p class="noscript-note">
              This demonstration form’s validation needs JavaScript; the rest of
              the page works without it.
            </p>
          </noscript>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <footer class="colophon">
    <div class="gauge-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="wrap colophon-grid">
      <p class="footer-mark" aria-hidden="true">Margin</p>
      <p>
        An independent quarterly journal about overlooked places.<br>
        Issue 14 — <em>Low Water</em> · Autumn 2026.
      </p>
      <p class="colophon-tech">
        Set in system serif &amp; monospace. Art drawn in SVG.<br>
        No trackers, no network calls, nothing leaves your browser.
      </p>
    </div>
  </footer>

  <script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

qwen3.8-max/12-frontend-editorial/styles.css

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Margin — Issue 14 “Low Water”
   Print-editorial system: paper, ink, one river accent, one rust mark.
   Display motif: the gauge rule (graded tick marks like a river staff).
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

:root {
  --bg: #f2ecdf;            /* warm newsprint */
  --surface: #f9f4e9;       /* raised paper */
  --ink: #211d16;           /* letterpress black-brown */
  --ink-soft: #5c554a;
  --rule: #cdc4b0;
  --rule-strong: #8f8571;
  --accent: #2e5f63;        /* river teal */
  --highlight: #b0512a;     /* oxidised rust */

  --font-serif: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino,
    "Book Antiqua", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --font-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", Menlo, Consolas,
    "Liberation Mono", monospace;
}

/* Reading mode: night desk-lamp palette, larger type, airier leading. */
html.reading {
  --bg: #16120e;
  --surface: #201a14;
  --ink: #ece2cd;
  --ink-soft: #b5a888;
  --rule: #3a3128;
  --rule-strong: #6a5c46;
  --accent: #93c2c0;
  --highlight: #d98a5f;

  font-size: 112.5%;
}

/* ── Reset & base ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  scroll-padding-top: 5.5rem; /* clear the sticky folio bar */
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.62;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

html.reading body {
  line-height: 1.72;
}

h1, h2, h3 {
  font-weight: 400;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.12;
}

p {
  margin: 0;
}

ul, ol {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

img, svg {
  max-width: 100%;
}

::selection {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--bg);
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.wrap {
  width: min(1180px, 100% - 2.5rem);
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.section {
  padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 9vw, 7rem);
}

/* ── Shared typographic parts ─────────────────────────────────────── */

.kicker,
.label,
.folio-issue,
.archive-meta,
.story-kind,
.jump,
.hint,
.error,
.form-status,
.noscript-note,
figcaption,
.colophon-tech,
blockquote cite,
.cover-svg text {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

.kicker,
.label {
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.label {
  color: var(--highlight);
}

.byline {
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.byline .author {
  color: var(--ink);
}

/* The gauge rule — the site's display motif: a printed measuring stick. */
.gauge-rule {
  height: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
  background-image:
    repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--rule-strong) 0 1px, transparent 1px 64px),
    repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--rule) 0 1px, transparent 1px 12.8px);
  background-size: 100% 12px, 100% 6px;
  background-position: left bottom, left bottom;
  background-repeat: repeat-x;
}

.ticks {
  height: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--rule-strong) 0 1px, transparent 1px 8px);
  background-size: 100% 8px;
  background-position: left bottom;
  background-repeat: repeat-x;
}

/* Misregistered double frame — two rules, slightly out of alignment,
   like a second printing plate a hair off. */
.frame {
  position: relative;
}

.frame::before,
.frame::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.frame::before {
  inset: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
}

.frame::after {
  inset: 6px -6px -6px 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  opacity: 0.8;
}

/* Buttons */
.btn,
.btn-toggle {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 0.8rem 1.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}

.btn:hover,
.btn-toggle:hover {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--bg);
}

.btn-solid {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--bg);
}

.btn-solid:hover {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.btn-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  border-color: var(--rule-strong);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.btn-toggle .dot {
  width: 0.6rem;
  height: 0.6rem;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  flex: none;
}

.btn-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.btn-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] .dot {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  left: -999px;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--bg);
  padding: 0.7rem 1.2rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.skip-link:focus {
  left: 0;
}

/* ── Masthead / folio bar ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

.masthead {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 40;
  background: var(--bg);
}

.folio-bar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  grid-template-areas:
    "wordmark toggle"
    "issue    issue";
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem 1rem;
  padding-block: 0.65rem;
}

.wordmark {
  grid-area: wordmark;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: 0.015em;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.wordmark:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.folio-tagline {
  display: none;
  grid-area: tagline;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.folio-issue {
  grid-area: issue;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

#reading-toggle {
  grid-area: toggle;
  justify-self: end;
}

/* ── Cover ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.cover {
  padding-block: clamp(2.75rem, 7vw, 5rem) clamp(3.5rem, 9vw, 6.5rem);
}

.cover-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
}

.display {
  font-size: clamp(4rem, 15vw, 8.5rem);
  line-height: 0.92;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
  margin: 0.35em 0 0.45em;
}

.display .d-line {
  display: block;
}

.display em {
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.standfirst {
  font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 1.6vw, 1.28rem);
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  max-width: 52ch;
}

.cover-story {
  margin-top: 2.75rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
  padding-top: 1.4rem;
  max-width: 54ch;
}

.cover-story-title {
  font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 3.4vw, 2.3rem);
  line-height: 1.1;
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0.25rem;
}

.cover-story-title a {
  color: var(--ink);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
  text-underline-offset: 5px;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.cover-story-title a:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.cover-story .dek {
  margin-top: 0.8rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.jump {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 1.1rem;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: var(--accent);
  text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}

.jump:hover {
  color: var(--highlight);
  border-bottom-color: var(--highlight);
}

.cover-art {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 520px;
  padding-right: 6px;  /* room for the misregistered frame */
  padding-bottom: 6px;
}

.cover-svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

/* SVG paint roles (theme-aware; flip automatically in reading mode) */
.art-ink            { fill: var(--ink); }
.art-accent         { fill: var(--accent); }
.art-highlight      { fill: var(--highlight); }
.art-surface        { fill: var(--surface); }
.art-bg             { fill: var(--bg); }
.art-stroke-ink     { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); }
.art-stroke-accent  { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent); }
.art-stroke-highlight { fill: none; stroke: var(--highlight); }
.art-stroke-bg      { fill: none; stroke: var(--bg); }
.art-stroke-rule    { fill: none; stroke: var(--rule); }
.art-stroke-rule-strong { fill: none; stroke: var(--rule-strong); }

.cover-svg .gauge-label { font-size: 15px; fill: var(--ink-soft); }
.cover-svg .gauge-cap   { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; fill: var(--ink-soft); }
.cover-svg .mark-label  { font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; fill: var(--highlight); }
.cover-svg .reading-label { font-size: 15px; fill: var(--highlight); }

.cover-art figcaption {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  max-width: 46ch;
}

/* ── Contents / story list ────────────────────────────────────────── */

.section-head {
  margin-bottom: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
}

.section-head h2 {
  font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
}

.section-note {
  margin-top: 0.6rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-style: italic;
  max-width: 48ch;
}

.story-list {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.story {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2.75rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-areas:
    "marker body"
    ".      kind";
  column-gap: 1rem;
  row-gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 2rem 0.9rem 1.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  transition: background-color 0.25s ease;
}

.story:hover {
  background: var(--surface);
}

.story-marker {
  grid-area: marker;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  padding-top: 0.4rem;
  transition: color 0.25s ease;
}

.story:hover .story-marker {
  color: var(--highlight);
}

.story-body {
  grid-area: body;
}

.story-body h3 {
  font-size: clamp(1.45rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  line-height: 1.12;
}

.story-body .byline {
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.story-dek {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  max-width: 62ch;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.story-kind {
  grid-area: kind;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.story-kind::before {
  content: "— ";
  color: var(--highlight);
}

/* ── Pull quote ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.pull {
  padding-block: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
}

.pull blockquote {
  margin: 1.75rem 0;
  padding-left: clamp(0.5rem, 6vw, 6rem);
}

.pull blockquote p {
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.6vw, 2.35rem);
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.3;
  max-width: 48ch;
}

.pull blockquote cite {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

/* ── Archive strip ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.archive-strip {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scroll-snap-type: x proximity;
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}

.archive-card {
  flex: 0 0 78%;
  scroll-snap-align: start;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: var(--surface);
  padding: 1.5rem 1.35rem 1.6rem;
  transition: border-color 0.25s ease;
}

.archive-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--rule-strong);
}

.archive-no {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 2.3rem;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.archive-ticks {
  width: 56px;
  margin: 0.9rem 0 1rem;
}

.archive-card h3 {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.archive-meta {
  margin-top: 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

/* ── Subscribe ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.subscribe-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
}

.offer h2 {
  font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
}

.offer-copy {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  max-width: 46ch;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.price {
  margin-top: 1.75rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.7rem;
}

.price-amount {
  font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 3.6rem);
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.price-unit {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.offer-list {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.offer-list li {
  padding: 0.7rem 0 0.7rem 1.6rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  position: relative;
}

.offer-list li::before {
  content: "—";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  color: var(--highlight);
}

.form-card {
  background: var(--surface);
  padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
  margin: 0 6px 6px 0; /* room for the misregistered frame */
}

.form-card h3 {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
}

.form-intro {
  margin-top: 0.6rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  max-width: 40ch;
}

.form-card label {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 1.6rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.form-card input {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.85rem 0.95rem;
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 1.08rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
}

.form-card input::placeholder {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  opacity: 0.65;
}

.form-card input:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

.form-card input.is-invalid {
  border-color: var(--highlight);
}

.form-card input.is-invalid:focus {
  outline-color: var(--highlight);
}

.hint {
  margin-top: 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.error {
  margin-top: 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--highlight);
}

.form-card .btn {
  margin-top: 1.4rem;
}

.form-status {
  margin-top: 1.2rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.form-status:not(:empty) {
  border-left: 2px solid var(--accent);
  padding-left: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.noscript-note {
  margin-top: 1.2rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--highlight);
  padding-left: 0.85rem;
}

/* ── Colophon ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.colophon-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  padding-block: 2.75rem 3.25rem;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.footer-mark {
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1;
}

.colophon-tech {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  line-height: 1.9;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

/* ── Scroll reveals (JS-gated; inert without the .js class) ───────── */

.js .reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(16px);
  transition: opacity 0.7s ease, transform 0.7s ease;
  transition-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 70ms);
}

.js .reveal.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

/* ── Responsive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

@media (min-width: 640px) {
  .archive-card {
    flex-basis: 55%;
  }

  .form-card .btn {
    padding-inline: 2.5rem;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 760px) {
  .wrap {
    width: min(1180px, 100% - 4rem);
  }

  .archive-strip {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    overflow: visible;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
    gap: 0;
    padding-bottom: 0;
  }

  .archive-card {
    border: none;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
    background: transparent;
    padding: 1.75rem 1.6rem 2.25rem;
  }

  .archive-card:last-child {
    border-right: none;
  }

  /* staggered baselines — a print-spread rhythm */
  .archive-card:nth-child(2) { padding-top: 3.25rem; }
  .archive-card:nth-child(3) { padding-top: 4.75rem; }

  .colophon-grid {
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    align-items: start;
    gap: 3rem;
  }

  .colophon-tech {
    text-align: right;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .cover-grid {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 7fr) minmax(0, 5fr);
    align-items: start;
  }

  .cover-art {
    margin-top: 3.5rem;
    transform: rotate(-0.6deg); /* laid slightly off-square, like a tipped-in plate */
  }

  .story {
    grid-template-columns: 4rem minmax(0, 1fr) 11rem;
    grid-template-areas: "marker body kind";
    column-gap: 1.75rem;
    padding: 2.25rem 1.25rem;
  }

  .story-kind {
    text-align: right;
    padding-top: 0.5rem;
  }

  /* asymmetric stair: alternate entries step toward the gutter */
  .story:nth-of-type(even) {
    padding-left: clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
  }

  .subscribe-grid {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(0, 0.95fr);
    align-items: start;
  }

  .form-card {
    margin-top: 2.5rem; /* drop the card below the offer's headline — off-grid */
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .folio-bar {
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto;
    grid-template-areas: "wordmark tagline issue toggle";
    gap: 2rem;
  }

  .folio-tagline {
    display: block;
  }

  .folio-issue {
    justify-self: end;
  }
}

/* ── Reduced motion ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: auto;
  }

  .js .reveal {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    transition: none;
  }

  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }

  .cover-art {
    transform: none !important;
  }
}

Evaluation 7.75 / 10 graded blind as submission B

Bold typographic cover: a huge 'Low / Water' crossed by a datum line, a striated riverbed plate and staggered supporting stories. It is distinctive, but the datum labels collide with text at both widths and much of the page depends on reveal-on-scroll.

Strengths

  • Strong display motif and asymmetric staggered story layout
  • Paper/Night toggle persists and the email flow moves focus to a success heading
  • Summary/details 'read the opening' interaction; footnote-style offer

Weaknesses

  • At 1440 the 'MEAN LOW WATER −2.4 M' label runs through the right-column deck text; at 390 the datum labels sit on top of 'Water'
  • Content is hidden until IntersectionObserver fires (the provided full-page capture is mostly blank)
  • Nav and mode buttons at 10-12px; mode buttons are 22px tall
Evidence the grader checked
  • B-fold.png / B-desktop.png: datum line crosses 'trees in the unfinished floors'
  • B-desktop-full.png shows empty sections until scrolled; my scrolled capture shows them
  • email: empty -> 'Please enter an email address...', valid -> status 'Address noted. Nothing has been sent or charged.', focus H3#signup-done-title

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0
