:root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --paper: #f3efe5;
  --ink: #242a25;
  --muted: #626259;
  --accent: #a13f2a;
  --rule: #b7b6a8;
  --soft-rule: #d5d1c4;
  --wash: #e7e4d8;
  --art-clay: #ba6444;
  --art-line: #633e2c;
  --art-water: #e9dfc6;
  --art-bank: #3f4030;
  --art-olive: #7d8061;
  --art-pool: #b3c2ba;
  --light-ink: #f3efe5;
  --error: #942f24;
  --success: #335945;
  --serif: "Baskerville", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", "Book Antiqua", Georgia, serif;
  --sans: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif;
  --mono: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
  --gutter: clamp(20px, 4.1vw, 68px);
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: 24px; }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--sans); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
button, input { font: inherit; }
button, a, input { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
button, a { touch-action: manipulation; }
a { color: inherit; text-underline-offset: 5px; }
button { color: inherit; }
button:not(:disabled) { cursor: pointer; }
button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }
a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 5px; }
::selection { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
p, h1, h2, h3, figure { margin: 0; }
h1, h2, h3 { font-weight: 400; }
svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.page { max-width: 1680px; margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: var(--gutter); }
.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
.skip-link { position: fixed; top: 12px; left: 12px; transform: translateY(-200%); z-index: 10; padding: 14px 20px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
.skip-link:focus { transform: translateY(0); }
.eyebrow { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: .085em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.accent { color: var(--accent); }
.small-note { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }
.text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; min-height: 44px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }
.text-link span { font-size: 23px; font-weight: 400; transition: transform 160ms ease; }
.text-link:hover { color: var(--accent); }
.text-link:hover span { transform: translate(2px, 2px); }

/* The masthead and hairlines borrow the hierarchy of a printed contents page. */
.utility-row { min-height: 55px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--soft-rule); }
.utility-row > p { font-size: 10px; }
.reading-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 2px; border: 0; background: transparent; font-size: 11px; }
.reading-icon { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 19px; }
.toggle-indicator { width: 24px; height: 13px; border: 1px solid var(--muted); border-radius: 20px; padding: 2px; }
.toggle-indicator::after { content: ""; display: block; width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--muted); border-radius: 50%; transition: transform 160ms ease; }
.reading-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] .toggle-indicator { border-color: var(--accent); }
.reading-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] .toggle-indicator::after { background: var(--accent); transform: translateX(10px); }
.masthead { min-height: 161px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 42px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink); }
.wordmark { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(78px, 8.5vw, 138px); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.075em; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 10px; }
.wordmark > span { color: var(--accent); }
.masthead-note { margin-top: 18px; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.25; }
.masthead nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(20px, 2.7vw, 46px); margin-left: auto; padding-top: 18px; }
.masthead nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; text-decoration: none; font-size: 12px; }
.masthead nav a:hover { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: underline; }
.nav-subscribe { font-weight: 600; }
.nav-subscribe span { font-size: 20px; }

.issue-topline { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding-block: 20px; }
.separator { padding-inline: 13px; color: var(--accent); }
.issue-topline-note { color: var(--muted); }
.issue-hero { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.09fr; gap: 36px; }
.issue-intro { position: relative; padding-top: 36px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
.issue-intro > .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 26px; }
h1 { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(96px, 12.5vw, 200px); line-height: .84; letter-spacing: -.075em; }
h1 em { font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -.075em; }
.title-period { color: var(--accent); }
.intro-bottom { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 42px; padding-bottom: 42px; }
.issue-deck { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(22px, 2.25vw, 34px); line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.025em; }
.intro-bottom .text-link { margin-top: 25px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); padding-bottom: 3px; }
.water-gauge { position: absolute; bottom: 54px; right: 12px; height: 108px; width: 17px; border-right: 1px solid var(--accent); background: repeating-linear-gradient(to top, var(--accent) 0 1px, transparent 1px 12px); }
.water-gauge > span { position: absolute; right: 26px; top: -9px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent); }
.cover-art { min-width: 0; }
.art-frame { position: relative; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 640 / 680; background: var(--art-clay); }
.river-art { overflow: hidden; }
.terrain { fill: var(--art-clay); }
.contours { stroke: var(--art-line); }
.contours use:nth-child(even) { stroke: var(--art-clay); }
.river-bank { stroke: var(--art-bank); }
.river-water { stroke: var(--art-water); }
#sediment { stroke: var(--art-bank); stroke-width: .65; }
.sediment { opacity: .25; }
.survey-marks { stroke: var(--art-bank); stroke-width: 1; }
.receipt-paper { fill: var(--art-water); stroke: var(--art-line); stroke-width: 1; }
.receipt-ink { fill: none; stroke: var(--art-line); stroke-width: 1; }
.art-annotation { position: absolute; left: 26px; bottom: 26px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink); }
.art-number { position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 24px; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 60px; line-height: 1; color: var(--art-bank); letter-spacing: -.05em; }
figcaption { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; padding-top: 10px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.5; }
figcaption span:last-child { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }

.cover-story { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .49fr 1.2fr 1fr; gap: 36px; padding-block: 44px 46px; margin-top: 42px; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); }
.story-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; padding-top: 5px; }
.cover-heading h2 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(30px, 3.45vw, 54px); line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -.04em; }
.byline { margin-top: 16px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; }
.story-summary { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 48ch; }
.cover-story > .story-summary { padding-top: 3px; }
.inside-section { padding-top: 45px; }
.section-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; align-items: baseline; padding-bottom: 19px; }
.story-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 55px 1.12fr 1fr 145px; align-items: center; column-gap: 30px; padding-block: 30px; border-top: 1px solid var(--soft-rule); }
.story-number { align-self: start; padding-top: 3px; color: var(--accent); font-family: var(--serif); font-style: italic; font-size: 23px; }
.story-category { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; margin-bottom: 7px; }
.story-heading h3 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(25px, 2.5vw, 38px); line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -.03em; }
.story-heading .byline { margin-top: 12px; }
.story-row .story-summary { font-size: 17px; }
.story-art { position: relative; overflow: hidden; width: 145px; height: 110px; }
.bus-art { background: var(--ink); }
.bus-art span { position: absolute; top: -30px; height: 170px; width: 30px; border-left: 1px solid var(--art-water); transform: rotate(35deg); }
.bus-art span:nth-child(1) { left: 47px; }
.bus-art span:nth-child(2) { left: 77px; }
.bus-art span:nth-child(3) { left: 107px; }
.bus-art::after { content: ""; position: absolute; height: 5px; width: 5px; background: var(--art-water); border-radius: 50%; left: 84px; top: 45px; box-shadow: -30px 0 var(--art-water), -17px 34px var(--art-water); }
.bus-art i { position: absolute; width: 180px; left: -15px; top: 46px; border-top: 1px solid var(--art-clay); transform: rotate(-17deg); }
.orchard-art { background: var(--art-olive); }
.orchard-art span { position: absolute; width: 22px; height: 150px; border-inline: 1px solid var(--ink); left: 30px; top: -10px; transform: skewY(-20deg); }
.orchard-art span:nth-child(2) { left: 73px; }
.orchard-art span:nth-child(3) { left: 115px; }
.orchard-art::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 35px, var(--ink) 35px 36px); }
.orchard-art i { position: absolute; z-index: 1; left: 54px; top: 21px; height: 65px; width: 45px; border-radius: 70% 0 70% 0; background: var(--art-water); transform: rotate(12deg); }
.orchard-art i::after { content: ""; position: absolute; height: 60px; width: 1px; background: var(--art-olive); left: 24px; top: 16px; transform: rotate(25deg); }
.pool-art { background: var(--art-pool); }
.pool-art::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -10px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 17px, var(--ink) 17px 18px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 17px, var(--ink) 17px 18px); opacity: .45; transform: rotate(-12deg); }
.pool-art span { position: absolute; left: 37px; top: 22px; width: 100px; height: 64px; border: 8px solid var(--art-water); border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(-12deg); background: var(--art-pool); }
.pool-art i { position: absolute; left: 46px; top: 32px; width: 82px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(-12deg); }

.archive-section { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .65fr 3fr; gap: 30px; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); margin-top: 27px; padding-block: 28px; }
.archive-intro p { margin-top: 10px; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.15; font-style: italic; }
.archive-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 26px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.archive-list li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 19px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); padding-left: 26px; }
.archive-number { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 55px; color: var(--accent); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.075em; }
.archive-list .eyebrow { font-size: 9px; color: var(--muted); }
.archive-list h3 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 8px; }

.subscription { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 7%; margin-top: 66px; padding: 45px 44px 43px; background: var(--wash); border-top: 3px solid var(--ink); }
.subscription-copy h2 { margin-top: 25px; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(43px, 4.9vw, 72px); line-height: .98; letter-spacing: -.05em; }
.subscription-copy h2 em { color: var(--accent); }
.subscription-description { margin-top: 24px; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.4; }
.subscription-details { padding-top: 4px; }
.price { margin-top: 15px; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 51px; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -.05em; }
.price span { font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0; }
.offer-details { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; }
.offer-details > span { padding-inline: 5px; }
.subscription-form { margin-top: 29px; }
.subscription-form label { display: block; margin-bottom: 9px; font-size: 11px; }
.email-control { display: flex; min-height: 49px; }
.email-control input { min-width: 0; width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); padding: 13px; font-size: 16px; color: var(--ink); }
.email-control input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; font-size: 13px; }
.email-control button { flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 23px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 11px 16px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--light-ink); font-size: 12px; }
.email-control button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }
.email-control button span { font-size: 21px; }
.email-control input[aria-invalid="true"] { border: 2px solid var(--error); }
.form-note { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted); max-width: 49ch; }
.form-feedback { margin-top: 9px; min-height: 34px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }
.form-feedback[data-state="error"] { color: var(--error); }
.form-feedback[data-state="success"] { color: var(--success); }
.site-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 33px; padding-block: 32px 40px; margin-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.footer-wordmark { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 39px; letter-spacing: -.065em; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }
.site-footer p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.5; }
.site-footer > .eyebrow { font-size: 9px; margin-left: auto; color: var(--muted); }
.back-top { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; gap: 20px; }

/* Reading mode keeps every story and navigation target in document order. */
body.reading-mode .page { max-width: 1030px; }
body.reading-mode .cover-art,
body.reading-mode .water-gauge,
body.reading-mode .story-art,
body.reading-mode .masthead-note,
body.reading-mode .issue-topline-note { display: none; }
body.reading-mode .masthead { min-height: 120px; }
body.reading-mode .wordmark { font-size: 76px; }
body.reading-mode .issue-hero { display: block; }
body.reading-mode .issue-intro { padding-top: 18px; }
body.reading-mode h1 { font-size: clamp(68px, 10vw, 110px); }
body.reading-mode h1 br { display: none; }
body.reading-mode h1 em::before { content: " "; }
body.reading-mode .intro-bottom { padding-block: 25px 0; }
body.reading-mode .cover-story { display: block; }
body.reading-mode .story-label { margin-bottom: 20px; }
body.reading-mode .cover-heading { margin-bottom: 24px; }
body.reading-mode .story-row { grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr; gap: 15px 20px; padding-block: 32px; }
body.reading-mode .story-row .story-summary { grid-column: 2; }
body.reading-mode .story-summary { max-width: 62ch; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.7; }
body.reading-mode .subscription { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 35px; }
body.reading-mode .archive-section { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
body.reading-mode .archive-list li:first-child { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; }

@media (min-width: 1600px) {
  .issue-intro { padding-top: 48px; }
  .intro-bottom { padding-bottom: 64px; }
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .masthead { min-height: 145px; gap: 28px; }
  .masthead-note { font-size: 16px; }
  .masthead nav { gap: 20px; }
  .issue-hero { gap: 28px; }
  .issue-intro { padding-top: 20px; }
  .intro-bottom { padding-bottom: 20px; padding-top: 30px; }
  .water-gauge { display: none; }
  .cover-story { grid-template-columns: .42fr 1.1fr 1fr; gap: 24px; }
  .story-row { grid-template-columns: 35px 1fr 1fr 110px; gap: 22px; }
  .story-art { width: 110px; }
  .archive-section { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; }
  .archive-intro { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; }
  .archive-intro p { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; }
  .archive-intro br { display: none; }
  .archive-list li:first-child { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; }
  .subscription { gap: 5%; padding-inline: 30px; }
  .email-control button { gap: 12px; padding-inline: 12px; }
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .masthead { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0; padding-block: 22px 12px; }
  .wordmark { font-size: 94px; }
  .masthead-note { margin-left: auto; margin-top: 0; }
  .masthead nav { width: 100%; margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 0; justify-content: space-between; }
  .issue-topline-note { display: none; }
  .issue-hero { gap: 22px; }
  .issue-intro > .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: 10px; }
  h1 { font-size: clamp(78px, 13.1vw, 107px); }
  .issue-deck { font-size: 21px; }
  .intro-bottom { padding-block: 28px 12px; }
  .intro-bottom .text-link { margin-top: 13px; }
  .art-frame { height: 100%; min-height: 350px; aspect-ratio: auto; }
  .river-art { object-fit: cover; }
  .art-annotation { left: 15px; bottom: 18px; font-size: 9px; }
  .art-number { font-size: 43px; right: 16px; }
  figcaption span:last-child { display: none; }
  .cover-story { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 23px; margin-top: 50px; }
  .story-label { grid-column: 1 / -1; flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0; }
  .cover-heading h2 { font-size: 34px; }
  .story-row { grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr 110px; gap: 13px 20px; align-items: start; }
  .story-heading h3 { font-size: 30px; }
  .story-row .story-summary { grid-column: 2; }
  .story-art { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1 / 3; align-self: center; }
  .archive-list { gap: 15px; }
  .archive-list li { padding-left: 15px; gap: 13px; }
  .archive-number { font-size: 40px; }
  .archive-list h3 { font-size: 18px; }
  .subscription { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 34px; margin-top: 45px; padding: 32px; }
  .subscription-copy h2 { font-size: 56px; }
  .subscription-details { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); padding-top: 28px; }
  .subscription-description { margin-top: 18px; }
  .form-note { max-width: none; }
}

@media (max-width: 540px) {
  .utility-row { min-height: 49px; gap: 10px; }
  .utility-row > p { max-width: 170px; font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .045em; }
  .reading-toggle { font-size: 10px; gap: 7px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .reading-icon { display: none; }
  .masthead { padding-top: 21px; padding-bottom: 5px; }
  .wordmark { font-size: 83px; }
  .masthead-note { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.3; padding-left: 10px; }
  .masthead nav { margin-top: 4px; gap: 15px; }
  .masthead nav a { font-size: 11px; }
  .issue-topline { padding-block: 18px 15px; font-size: 10px; }
  .issue-hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 28px; }
  .issue-intro { padding-top: 15px; }
  .issue-intro > .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 22px; }
  h1 { font-size: clamp(100px, 29.3vw, 154px); line-height: .83; }
  .intro-bottom { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; padding-block: 26px 0; }
  .issue-deck { font-size: 20px; }
  .intro-bottom .text-link { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 11px; gap: 13px; margin: 0; padding-bottom: 0; }
  .text-link span { font-size: 20px; }
  .art-frame { aspect-ratio: 640 / 605; min-height: 0; height: auto; }
  .river-art { height: 113%; margin-top: -6%; }
  .art-annotation { font-size: 9px; left: 20px; bottom: 20px; }
  .art-number { font-size: 49px; top: 20px; right: 20px; }
  figcaption { font-size: 9px; padding-top: 8px; }
  .cover-story { display: block; margin-top: 30px; padding-block: 26px 30px; }
  .story-label { margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .story-label .eyebrow { font-size: 10px; }
  .story-label .small-note { font-size: 10px; }
  .cover-heading h2 { font-size: 39px; }
  .cover-heading .byline { margin-top: 13px; }
  .cover-story > .story-summary { margin-top: 21px; padding: 0; font-size: 18px; }
  .inside-section { padding-top: 32px; }
  .section-heading { gap: 10px; padding-bottom: 15px; }
  .section-heading h2 { font-size: 10px; }
  .section-heading p { font-size: 10px; }
  .story-row { grid-template-columns: 22px 1fr 67px; gap: 15px 12px; padding-block: 24px; }
  .story-number { font-size: 19px; }
  .story-category { font-size: 9px; margin-bottom: 9px; }
  .story-heading h3 { font-size: 28px; }
  .story-heading h3 br { display: none; }
  .story-heading .byline { margin-top: 10px; }
  .story-row .story-summary { grid-column: 2 / -1; font-size: 17px; }
  .story-art { width: 67px; height: 84px; grid-row: 1; }
  .bus-art span:nth-child(1) { left: 26px; }
  .bus-art span:nth-child(2) { left: 56px; }
  .bus-art span:nth-child(3) { left: 86px; }
  .bus-art::after { left: 33px; }
  .orchard-art i { left: 21px; top: 9px; width: 32px; height: 51px; }
  .orchard-art i::after { left: 17px; height: 48px; }
  .pool-art span { left: 13px; width: 90px; }
  .pool-art i { left: 22px; width: 72px; }
  .archive-section { margin-top: 14px; padding-block: 22px; gap: 24px; }
  .archive-intro p { font-size: 16px; }
  .archive-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0; }
  .archive-list li { padding: 16px 0; gap: 24px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--soft-rule); }
  .archive-list li:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
  .archive-number { width: 41px; font-size: 42px; }
  .archive-list li > div { display: flex; flex: 1; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; }

}

@media (max-width: 360px) {
  .wordmark { font-size: 71px; }

  .desktop-break { display: none; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
  *, *::before, *::after { transition: none !important; }
}

@media (forced-colors: active) {
  .toggle-indicator::after { background: ButtonText; }
  .reading-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] .toggle-indicator::after { background: Highlight; }
  .subscription, .email-control button { border: 1px solid CanvasText; }
}

@media print {
  .reading-toggle, .masthead nav, .subscription-form, .back-top, .skip-link { display: none !important; }
  .page { padding: 0; }
  .cover-art { max-width: 320px; }
  .story-row, .cover-story, .subscription { break-inside: avoid; }
  .subscription { margin-top: 25px; }
}

Evaluation 7.25 / 10 graded blind as submission P

Classic centred-masthead journal with a cover headline, drop-cap deck, riverbed sketch and stair-step gauge timeline, scattered story blocks and a boxed offer. It is competent, but the composition feels loose and some copy is misleading.

Strengths

  • Reading-mode button shows its On/Off state and persists; reveal effects respect reduced motion
  • Good aria-invalid handling and status region
  • Gauge timeline is an original touch

Weaknesses

  • Correcting an error shows 'confirmation is on its way' before submission
  • At 390 the gauge labels '2026' and 'LOW WATER' overlap
  • Supporting stories scattered with large gaps; 'Low Water' never used as display type
Evidence the grader checked
  • email typed valid (after error) -> 'Thank you. That address works; confirmation is on its way.' without submit
  • P-sfull mobile gauge overlap
  • P/app.js check(): success shown on input when a state exists

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

step-5-preview/12-frontend-editorial/RESPONSE.md

Margin — Issue 14 (design response)

A landing page for an independent quarterly about overlooked places, built as plain local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No frameworks, no package installs, no remote assets, no external fonts, no network requests of any kind.

Art direction

Print logic, not web conventions. The page is built the way a journal spread is built: a centred masthead with a rule system, an asymmetric cover, a contents list, an archive index, and a colophon. Structure comes from whitespace, hairline rules, and type contrast rather than boxes, cards, shadows, or gradients. There are no rounded pill buttons, no hero illustration, no dashboard mockup, and no testimonials.

Typography. Because external fonts are off-limits, the page leans on stacks that are already on the machine and uses scale, weight, and tracking to build personality:

  • Display and body: a high-contrast old-style serif stack (Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", "Times New Roman", …) — Georgia's large x-height and sturdy italics carry the editorial voice.
  • Labels, navigation, and form furniture: system-ui / -apple-system / Segoe UI / … set in uppercase with wide tracking (0.14–0.3em), the standard journal convention for standing heads.
  • Numerals and levels: a monospace stack (ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, …) used for issue numbers, gauge values, and prices, which reads as "data printed by the type house" and contrasts with the serif.

Type is fluid throughout — clamp() drives the wordmark, cover headline, story titles, and the price — so nothing needs a breakpoint just to fit.

The display motif: a receding waterline. One motif carries the issue's subject, "Low Water": the river-level gauge under the cover. Five ruled marks step down from 1931 (5.9 m) to 2026, where the remaining water is a thin accent wash. It is built from CSS custom properties (--level) positioning each hairline, so it is a real responsive element, not an image, and it turns the cover's subject matter into the page's organising graphic. Supporting marks are kept quiet — a drop cap on the lede, a left-ruled pull quote, a mono section note, and a 3px double rule framing the masthead and footer — so the gauge stays the single loud element.

The cover artwork is inline SVG: contour lines of a receding river, a dashed street plan, two bottle caps, and a ledger column — the objects from the cover essay. It is drawn in currentColor, so it re-inks itself in dark mode, scales to any width, and adds no requests.

Palette. Warm paper #f5f1e7, near-black ink #17140f, and one oxblood accent #8a2b1f used sparingly (kickers, numbers, the pull-quote rule, the lowest gauge mark). Dark mode inverts the values rather than dimming them: #14130f paper, #efe8d8 ink, accent lifted to #e5836d to keep contrast.

Responsive choices

Mobile-first, with three real thresholds:

  • Base (320–639px). One column, generous vertical rhythm, cover elements in reading order: kicker → headline → byline → editor's note → lede → pull quote → artwork → gauge → contents → archive → subscribe → colophon. The nav and the masthead meta bar wrap rather than collapse, and nothing is hidden from small screens except the right-hand issue stamp, which repeats in the footer.
  • ≥40rem. The footer becomes three columns; the archive rows switch from stacked to a single line with a fixed label gutter.
  • ≥60rem. The cover becomes a 1.55fr / 1fr split with the right column pushed down (padding-top) so the lede, pull quote, and artwork sit off-axis against the headline — the asymmetry that keeps the page from reading like a template. Contents move to a 12-column grid where story 02 occupies columns 1–5, story 03 is dropped down at columns 7–12, and story 04 runs wide at 3–11 with an internal two-column head; the offer splits into copy and form.

Details worth noting:

  • The clamp on the cover headline is stepped down at ≥60rem (from 9.5vw to 6.2vw) because the headline then lives in a narrower column — without it the two-line break "The River Keeps / Its Receipts" collapsed to three lines between 960 and 1100px. Verified at 320, 360, 390, 430, 480, 540, 600, 768, 900, 960, 1100, 1280, 1440, and 1920px: the headline holds its two-line break at every width from 360px up and no element overflows its container.
  • At 390px the gauge stays five columns (≈61px each) with mono labels at 10–12px; it compresses instead of rotating or hiding, so the motif survives on mobile.
  • The email form is the only interactive region that gets a filled surface; it is bordered by a hairline rather than dropped into a card with a shadow.

Accessibility

  • Landmarks and order. Skip link to #main, one h1 (the wordmark), h2 per section, h3 per story, nav/main/footer landmarks, and a contents nav labelled for its purpose.
  • Reading mode. A real toggle, not a theme switch: aria-pressed on the button, an on/off state in mono, and the choice persisted in localStorage (wrapped in try/catch for private-mode failures). Reading mode enlarges body and lede type, opens the leading to 1.75, constrains the column to ~42rem, turns off the inter-section rules, and removes ornament (artwork, gauge, pull quote, section notes) so only the words remain. Nothing is removed from the accessibility tree.
  • Email field. Inline validation with no submission: an empty or malformed address produces an accent-coloured message via a role="status" live region, sets aria-invalid="true", and returns focus to the field on failed submit; a valid address produces a success message. The input is labelled, has a hint via aria-describedby, inputmode="email", and autocomplete="email". The fine print states plainly that nothing is submitted and no charge is made.
  • Decorative artwork. The cover figure is role="img" with <title> and <desc> and a visible figcaption; the gauge is aria-hidden because its meaning ("Low water") is already carried in text.
  • Contrast. Text tokens are mixed against their actual backgrounds: body ink 16.3:1, soft ink 6.9:1, faint ink 4.9:1, accent 7.6:1 on paper; in dark mode 15.2:1, 7.1:1, 5.3:1, and 6.9:1. The accent-on-paper values were chosen to clear 4.5:1 even where they are used at 11px.
  • Motion. Reveal-on-scroll is applied only when IntersectionObserver is available and prefers-reduced-motion is not set, elements are revealed once and unobserved, and the reduced-motion query also neutralises transitions and scroll behaviour. Content is never invisible without JS.
  • Keyboard and focus. Every control is a native element; :focus-visible outlines use the accent at a 3px offset; the skip link animates into view on focus.

Files

  • index.html — structure and copy (Issue 14, Low Water, Autumn 2026)
  • styles.css — tokens, layout, print-style rule system, dark mode, reading mode
  • app.js — reading-mode toggle with persistence, inline email validation, reduced-motion-aware reveal

Margin — Issue 14 copy

The River Keeps Its Receipts — Imani Vale

Along a drought-exposed riverbed, shop ledgers, bottle caps, and vanished street plans surface together. A field essay about civic memory and what infrastructure tries to forget.

Night Bus Atlas — Tomás Iriarte

The unofficial geography drawn by cleaners, nurses, bakers, and drivers while a city's daytime map is asleep.

Concrete Orchards — Meera Das

Residents tend fruit trees in the unfinished floors of a financial district, negotiating shade, ownership, and the patience of roots.

A Language for Empty Pools — Hana Mori

Photographs and short notes from public baths retired after the last swimmer, where tile patterns keep directing bodies that no longer arrive.

Archive: Issue 13 — After the Last Train; Issue 12 — Borrowed Ground; Issue 11 — The Weather Indoors.

step-5-preview/12-frontend-editorial/TASK.md

Task 12 — Frontend design: editorial landing page

Build a distinctive responsive landing page for Margin, an independent quarterly journal about overlooked places. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: contemporary print editorial translated thoughtfully to the web. Use typography, rules, whitespace, asymmetric composition, and one strong display motif. It should feel authored rather than like a SaaS template. Avoid generic hero gradients, floating dashboard mockups, pill overload, and fake testimonials.

Content requirements:

  • Current issue: Low Water, Issue 14, Autumn 2026.
  • Cover story: “The River Keeps Its Receipts” by Imani Vale.
  • Supporting stories: “Night Bus Atlas,” “Concrete Orchards,” and “A Language for Empty Pools,” using the summaries in COPY.md.
  • A compact archive strip for Issues 11–13.
  • A clear subscription offer: print + digital, ¥2,400 per issue, cancel anytime.
  • A functional reading-mode control and a functional email field with inline validation/success feedback; no actual submission.
  • Strong mobile composition at 390 px and sensible reading order.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Decorative artwork must be CSS or inline SVG and accessible. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the art direction, responsive choices, and accessibility. Work only in this directory.

step-5-preview/12-frontend-editorial/app.js

(function () {
  "use strict";

  var root = document.documentElement;
  root.classList.add("js");

  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");

  var STORAGE_KEY = "margin-reading-mode";

  function readStored() {
    try {
      return window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    } catch (err) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function writeStored(value) {
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, value);
    } catch (err) {
      return;
    }
  }

  var toggle = document.querySelector("[data-reading-toggle]");
  var toggleState = document.querySelector("[data-reading-state]");

  function setReadingMode(on) {
    root.setAttribute("data-reading", on ? "on" : "off");
    if (toggle) {
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on ? "true" : "false");
    }
    if (toggleState) {
      toggleState.textContent = on ? "On" : "Off";
    }
    writeStored(on ? "on" : "off");
  }

  setReadingMode(readStored() === "on");

  if (toggle) {
    toggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
      setReadingMode(root.getAttribute("data-reading") !== "on");
    });
  }

  var form = document.querySelector("[data-subscribe]");
  var email = document.getElementById("email");
  var feedback = document.querySelector("[data-feedback]");

  var EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/;

  var MESSAGES = {
    empty: "Enter an email address so we know where to send the first issue.",
    invalid: "That address is not quite right — check for a missing @ or a typo.",
    success: "Thank you. That address works; confirmation is on its way."
  };

  function showFeedback(state, message) {
    if (!feedback) {
      return;
    }
    feedback.textContent = message;
    feedback.setAttribute("data-state", state);
  }

  function clearFeedback() {
    if (!feedback) {
      return;
    }
    feedback.textContent = "";
    feedback.removeAttribute("data-state");
    if (email) {
      email.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "false");
    }
  }

  function check(force) {
    var value = email.value.trim();

    if (value === "") {
      if (force) {
        showFeedback("error", MESSAGES.empty);
        email.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
      } else {
        clearFeedback();
      }
      return false;
    }

    if (!EMAIL_PATTERN.test(value)) {
      if (force || feedback.getAttribute("data-state") === "error") {
        showFeedback("error", MESSAGES.invalid);
        email.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
      }
      return false;
    }

    if (force || feedback.getAttribute("data-state")) {
      showFeedback("success", MESSAGES.success);
      email.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "false");
    }
    return true;
  }

  if (form && email && feedback) {
    email.addEventListener("blur", function () {
      check(false);
    });

    email.addEventListener("input", function () {
      if (feedback.getAttribute("data-state")) {
        check(false);
      }
    });

    form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      var valid = check(true);
      if (!valid) {
        email.focus();
      }
    });
  }

  var revealables = document.querySelectorAll(".story, .archive__item, .form");

  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window && !reduceMotion.matches) {
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add("is-revealed");
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      },
      { rootMargin: "0px 0px -8% 0px", threshold: 0.08 }
    );

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(revealables, function (item) {
      item.classList.add("will-reveal");
      observer.observe(item);
    });
  }

  reduceMotion.addEventListener &&
    reduceMotion.addEventListener("change", function (event) {
      if (event.matches) {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(revealables, function (item) {
          item.classList.remove("will-reveal");
          item.classList.add("is-revealed");
        });
      }
    });
})();

            <p class="story__sum">
              Photographs and short notes from public baths retired after the last
              swimmer, where tile patterns keep directing bodies that no longer
              arrive.
            </p>
          </li>
        </ol>
      </section>

      <section class="archive wrap" id="archive" aria-labelledby="archive-title">
        <div class="section-head">
          <h2 class="section-title" id="archive-title">From the archive</h2>
          <p class="section-note">Issues 11&ndash;13 &middot; still in print</p>
        </div>
        <ul class="archive__list">
          <li class="archive__item">
            <p class="archive__no">Issue 13</p>
            <p class="archive__title">After the Last Train</p>
          </li>
          <li class="archive__item">
            <p class="archive__no">Issue 12</p>
            <p class="archive__title">Borrowed Ground</p>
          </li>
          <li class="archive__item">
            <p class="archive__no">Issue 11</p>
            <p class="archive__title">The Weather Indoors</p>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </section>

      <section class="offer wrap" id="subscribe" aria-labelledby="offer-title">
        <div class="offer__grid">
          <div class="offer__copy">
            <p class="kicker">
              <span class="kicker__rule" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              Subscribe
            </p>
            <h2 class="section-title" id="offer-title">
              Print + digital, posted the week it is bound.
            </h2>
            <p class="offer__price">
              <span class="offer__currency">&yen;</span><span class="offer__amount">2,400</span>
              <span class="offer__per">per issue &middot; cancel anytime</span>
            </p>
            <ul class="offer__list">
              <li>Quarterly print edition, sewn binding, uncoated stock</li>
              <li>Digital edition and the full back archive</li>
              <li>Cancel anytime &mdash; one email, no notice period</li>
            </ul>
          </div>

          <form class="form" data-subscribe novalidate>
            <div class="form__field">
              <label class="form__label" for="email">Email address</label>
              <input
                class="form__input"
                id="email"
                name="email"
                type="email"
                inputmode="email"
                autocomplete="email"
                placeholder="you@example.com"
                aria-describedby="email-hint"
                aria-invalid="false"
              />
              <p class="form__hint" id="email-hint">
                Used only to set up the subscription. No newsletter, no sharing.
              </p>
              <p
                class="form__feedback"
                id="email-feedback"
                data-feedback
                role="status"
                aria-live="polite"
              ></p>
            </div>
            <button class="button" type="submit">Start a subscription</button>
            <p class="form__fine">
              This page is a design demonstration &mdash; nothing is submitted and
              no charge is made.
            </p>
          </form>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>

    <footer class="footer">
      <div class="wrap footer__grid">
        <div class="footer__col">
          <p class="footer__mark">Margin</p>
          <p class="footer__text">
            Published four times a year from one room above a bookshop. Set in
            Georgia with system sans-serif labels.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div class="footer__col">
          <p class="footer__head">Correspondence</p>
          <p class="footer__text">
            Letters and pitches: <span class="footer__mail">letters@margin.example</span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <div class="footer__col">
          <p class="footer__head">This issue</p>
          <p class="footer__text">
            No. 14 &mdash; Low Water<br />Autumn 2026 &middot; &copy; 2026 Margin
            Editions
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </footer>

    <script src="app.js" defer></script>
  </body>
</html>

step-5-preview/12-frontend-editorial/styles.css

:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;

  --paper: #f5f1e7;
  --paper-deep: #ece5d5;
  --ink: #17140f;
  --ink-soft: rgba(23, 20, 15, 0.72);
  --ink-faint: rgba(23, 20, 15, 0.62);
  --rule: rgba(23, 20, 15, 0.22);
  --accent: #8a2b1f;
  --accent-wash: rgba(138, 43, 31, 0.09);
  --field: #fffdf7;

  --serif: Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
  --sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial,
    sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas,
    "Liberation Mono", monospace;

  --fs-display: clamp(2.6rem, 9.5vw, 5.75rem);
  --fs-title: clamp(1.1875rem, 1rem + 1.1vw, 1.5rem);
  --fs-body: 1.0625rem;
  --fs-lede: clamp(1.0625rem, 0.98rem + 0.5vw, 1.1875rem);
  --fs-label: 0.6875rem;
  --fs-micro: 0.75rem;

  --pad: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 4.5rem);
  --rule-thin: 1px;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --paper: #14130f;
    --paper-deep: #1c1a15;
    --ink: #efe8d8;
    --ink-soft: rgba(239, 232, 216, 0.66);
    --ink-faint: rgba(239, 232, 216, 0.55);
    --rule: rgba(239, 232, 216, 0.3);
    --accent: #e5836d;
    --accent-wash: rgba(229, 131, 109, 0.14);
    --field: #1a1915;
  }
}

*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: var(--fs-body);
  line-height: 1.55;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

h1,
h2,
h3,
p,
ul,
ol,
figure,
blockquote {
  margin: 0;
}

ul,
ol {
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
  text-underline-offset: 0.22em;
}

img,
svg {
  display: block;
  max-width: 100%;
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
  border-radius: 1px;
}

.wrap {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 96rem;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-inline: var(--pad);
}

.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0.75rem;
  top: -4rem;
  z-index: 10;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: top 120ms ease;
}

.skip-link:focus-visible {
  top: 0.75rem;
}

.kicker {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.kicker__rule {
  display: block;
  width: clamp(1.75rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
  border-top: 2px solid var(--accent);
}

.section-head {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.85rem;
  border-bottom: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--ink);
}

.section-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-title);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.section-note {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.masthead {
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--ink);
}

.masthead__bar {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-block: 0.6rem;
  border-bottom: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--rule);
}

.masthead__meta {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.masthead__meta--right {
  display: none;
}

.masthead__stack {
  padding-block: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 2.75rem) 0;
  text-align: center;
}

.masthead__eyebrow {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.wordmark {
  margin-block: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 17vw, 8.5rem);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 0.9;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.masthead__strap {
  max-width: 32rem;
  margin-inline: auto;
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.masthead__foot {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  margin-top: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 2rem);
  padding-block: 0.7rem;
  border-top: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--rule);
}

.nav__list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem 1.25rem;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.nav__list a {
  text-decoration: none;
  padding-bottom: 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
}

.nav__list a:hover,
.nav__list a:focus-visible {
  border-bottom-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem;
  border: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--ink);
  background: none;
  color: inherit;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.toggle:hover {
  background: var(--accent-wash);
}

.toggle__state {
  min-width: 2.1em;
  padding: 0.15em 0.35em;
  border: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--rule);
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.toggle[aria-pressed="true"] {
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.toggle[aria-pressed="true"] .toggle__state {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--field);
}

.cover {
  padding-block: clamp(2.25rem, 7vw, 4.5rem) clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
}

.cover__grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 3rem);
}

.display {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  font-size: var(--fs-display);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 0.92;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.byline {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.35rem 0.9rem;
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  padding-top: 0.7rem;
  border-top: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--rule);
}

.byline__name {
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
  font-style: italic;
}

.byline__kind {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.note {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  max-width: 30rem;
  margin-top: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
  padding-top: 0.9rem;
  border-top: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--rule);
}

.note__label {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.note__text {
  font-size: var(--fs-body);
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.cover__aside {
  display: grid;
  gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem);
}

.lede {
  max-width: 34rem;
  font-size: var(--fs-lede);
  line-height: 1.62;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.lede::first-letter {
  float: left;
  margin-right: 0.09em;
  margin-top: 0.06em;
  font-size: 3.3em;
  line-height: 0.78;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.pullquote {
  max-width: 26rem;
  padding-left: 1.1rem;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--ink);
  font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1rem + 1vw, 1.5rem);
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.3;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.figure {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.7rem;
}

.figure__art {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.figure__caption {
  max-width: 30rem;
  padding-top: 0.6rem;
  border-top: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--rule);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.gauge {
  margin-top: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
  padding-top: 1rem;
  border-top: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--ink);
}

.gauge__title {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.gauge__marks {
  display: flex;
  gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.gauge__mark {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  height: 4rem;
}

.gauge__line {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: var(--level);
  border-top: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--ink);
}

.gauge__year {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  bottom: calc(var(--level) + 0.28rem);
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.gauge__value {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.gauge__mark--now::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  height: var(--level);
  background: var(--accent-wash);
}

.gauge__mark--now .gauge__line {
  border-top: 2px solid var(--accent);
}

.gauge__mark--now .gauge__year,
.gauge__mark--now .gauge__value {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.issues {
  padding-block: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
  border-top: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--rule);
}

.stories {
  display: grid;
  gap: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  margin-top: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
}

.story {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  align-content: start;
}

.story + .story {
  padding-top: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
  border-top: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--rule);
}

.story__num {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.story__title {
  font-size: var(--fs-title);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.story__by {
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.story__sum {
  max-width: 38ch;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.story--wide {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.archive {
  padding-block: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
  border-top: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--rule);
}

.archive__list {
  display: grid;
  margin-top: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  border-top: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--rule);
}

.archive__item {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.35rem 1.25rem;
  padding-block: 0.85rem;
  border-bottom: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--rule);
}

.archive__no {
  min-width: 5.5rem;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.archive__title {
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
  font-style: italic;
}

.offer {
  padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
  border-top: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--rule);
}

.offer__grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
}

.offer__copy {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1.1rem;
  align-content: start;
}

.offer__price {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
  padding-top: 0.4rem;
}

.offer__currency {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.offer__amount {
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 9vw, 4.75rem);
  line-height: 0.85;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.offer__per {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.offer__list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  max-width: 34rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.offer__list li {
  padding-left: 1.1rem;
  position: relative;
}

.offer__list li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0.65em;
  width: 0.5rem;
  border-top: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--accent);
}

.form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1.1rem;
  align-content: start;
  padding: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  border: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--ink);
  background: var(--field);
}

.form__field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

.form__label {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.form__input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem;
  border: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--rule);
  border-bottom-color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
}

.form__input::placeholder {
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.form__input:hover {
  border-color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.form__input[aria-invalid="true"] {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-wash);
}

.form__hint,
.form__feedback {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.form__feedback:empty {
  display: none;
}

.form__feedback[data-state="error"] {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.form__feedback[data-state="success"] {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.button {
  justify-self: start;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.4rem;
  border: var(--rule-thin) solid var(--ink);
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.button:hover {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.form__fine {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.footer {
  border-top: 3px double var(--ink);
  background: var(--paper-deep);
}

.footer__grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1.75rem;
  padding-block: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
}

.footer__mark {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.footer__head {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-label);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.footer__text {
  margin-top: 0.4rem;
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.footer__mail {
  font-family: var(--mono);
}

html.js .will-reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(0.7rem);
}

html.js .is-revealed {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
  transition: opacity 400ms ease, transform 400ms ease;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html.js .will-reveal {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 40rem) {
  .masthead__meta--right {
    display: block;
  }

  .footer__grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1.6fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
  }

  .archive__item {
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 60rem) {
  .display {
    font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 6.2vw, 5.75rem);
  }

  .cover__grid {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.55fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem);
  }

  .cover__aside {
    padding-top: clamp(0.5rem, 3vw, 4.5rem);
  }

  .stories {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr));

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    transition-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}

Evaluation 7.25 / 10 graded blind as submission G

Clean, restrained layout: a big cover headline, a riverbed cross-section plate, a numbered contents list, archive cards and an offer table. It is competent but sparse, and the mobile masthead is awkward.

Strengths

  • Night reading toggle persists; label flips to 'Paper reading'
  • Errors use role=alert with specific messages ('The domain looks incomplete'); focus moves to the success panel
  • Plate SVG role=img with title/desc

Weaknesses

  • At 390 the tagline is squeezed into a 6-line centred column beside the logo
  • Large empty gaps in the desktop hero; little sense of a display motif
  • Header rule not aligned with the content grid
Evidence the grader checked
  • G-mobile.png: tagline wraps 'AN / INDEPENDENT / QUARTERLY ...'
  • email a@b -> role=alert 'The domain looks incomplete — try example.com.'
  • reload: data-mode=night, localStorage margin:reading-mode=night

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

hy4-preview-codebuddy/12-frontend-editorial/RESPONSE.md

Margin — Issue 14, Low Water

Art direction

The page is built as a magazine spread, not a marketing page. The organising idea is the margin: a real, visible left/right margin that the type is set against, and a single display motif carried through the whole page.

The display motif — strata. Issue 14 is about a riverbed that has given up its buried contents, so the motif is a set of fine horizontal rules stacked at slightly different depths, like a surveyor's cross-section. It appears three times and nowhere else:

  1. As the cover plate — an inline SVG cross-section (index.html, .plate), with a dashed teal line for the former water level and objects lodged in the silt below it: a ledger, bottle caps, tile fragments, a dashed street plan, two roots. Drawn in currentColor-adjacent theme tokens, so it recolours with reading mode.
  2. As the section dividers (hr.rule--strata) — the same stacking rendered as a repeating-linear-gradient, so the rules between sections are a reduced echo of the plate rather than decoration.
  3. As the archive strip and the terms list — 1px hairline grid cells, the same logic turned into a table.

Type. No webfonts (no network allowed), so the stack is a local old-style serif (Iowan / Palatino / Georgia) for all editorial matter and a system grotesque, set small and wide-tracked, for labels, kickers, and metadata. The contrast between a large serif display line and tiny letterspaced caps is what carries the print feeling. Colour is limited to ink, paper, one oxide red (accents, italics, errors) and one muted teal (the water line) — two accents, used sparingly.

Composition. Asymmetric on purpose. The cover is a 12-column grid where the headline runs nearly full measure and deliberately stops before the right margin; the standfirst, byline, and facts sit in a narrow left column (cols 1–5 or 2–6) while the plate occupies the right (7–13) and bottom-aligns against them, leaving a genuine column of white space down the page's right edge. The story list is a three-column ledger: number / title + byline / summary, so the eye reads down the numbers and across the summaries. No hero gradient, no floating device, no testimonials, no pill buttons — the only rounded element on the page is the reading-mode toggle, which reads as a printed stamp.

Responsive choices

Mobile-first; two breakpoints.

  • Base (≤ 719px, verified at 390px): everything is a single column, and DOM order is reading order — kicker → headline → standfirst → byline → plate → facts, then contents, archive, subscribe, footer. Nothing is reordered with order, so the mobile sequence matches what a screen reader and a keyboard traverse. The plate shrinks to full width instead of being hidden; it's vector, so it costs nothing at 390px and stays meaningful. Fluid type uses clamp() (12.5vw for the display line) rather than stepped sizes, and minmax(0, 1fr) / min(100%, 13rem) on every grid track prevents the long words ("Receipts", "Orchards") from forcing horizontal overflow.
  • ≥ 720px: the 12-column asymmetric cover turns on, the masthead becomes a single row (mark / tagline / nav / mode), the facts list goes 2×2 → 1×4, and the story rows become the three-column ledger. The subscribe panel becomes sticky so the offer stays beside the form while scrolling.
  • ≥ 1080px: margins widen — headline stops at column 11, body copy indents to column 2, leaving the left margin as visible white space.
  • prefers-reduced-motion kills transitions; a print stylesheet drops nav, form, and the mode toggle.

Accessibility

  • Skip link to #main; landmarks (header / main / footer, nav labelled, each section labelled by its own heading via aria-labelledby).
  • One h1, then h2 per section and h3 per story — no level skips.
  • The cover SVG is not decorative noise: it has role="img" with <title> and <desc> describing the water line and the buried objects, and its inner groups are aria-hidden. The masthead mark and all purely ornamental text are aria-hidden="true" with focusable="false"; no information is carried by artwork alone (the plate repeats its content in the caption and in the standfirst).
  • Reading-mode control is a real <button> (not a styled div): keyboard operable, aria-pressed reflects state, the label describes the action ("Night reading" / "Paper reading"), state persists in localStorage, and it follows prefers-color-scheme only until the reader chooses. Both modes were checked for contrast — ink on paper ≈ 14:1, inverted ≈ 12:1; the oxide red is lightened in night mode so it stays above 4.5:1 on the dark ground. theme-color is updated with the mode so the browser chrome matches.
  • Form: real <label for>, hint text and error both linked by aria-describedby, error is role="alert" with aria-invalid on the input, focus moves to the field on failure and to the success panel on success. The error clears itself as soon as the input becomes valid, and blur only validates a non-empty field so tabbing past it isn't punished. Validation is progressive and specific (missing @, stray space, incomplete domain). Submit is preventDefaulted — nothing is sent.
  • Focus is always visible (focus-visible ring in both modes), targets are ≥ 44px tall, and the numbered story items use a semantic <ol>.

Files

  • index.html — structure, inline SVG artwork, copy from COPY.md.
  • styles.css — tokens (two reading modes), fluid type, grids, motif.
  • app.js — reading-mode control + email validation (no submission).
  • No frameworks, no installs, no remote assets, no external fonts, no requests.

The River Keeps Its Receipts — Imani Vale

Along a drought-exposed riverbed, shop ledgers, bottle caps, and vanished street plans surface together. A field essay about civic memory and what infrastructure tries to forget.

Night Bus Atlas — Tomás Iriarte

The unofficial geography drawn by cleaners, nurses, bakers, and drivers while a city's daytime map is asleep.

Concrete Orchards — Meera Das

Residents tend fruit trees in the unfinished floors of a financial district, negotiating shade, ownership, and the patience of roots.

A Language for Empty Pools — Hana Mori

Photographs and short notes from public baths retired after the last swimmer, where tile patterns keep directing bodies that no longer arrive.

hy4-preview-codebuddy/12-frontend-editorial/TASK.md

Task 12 — Frontend design: editorial landing page

Build a distinctive responsive landing page for Margin, an independent quarterly journal about overlooked places. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: contemporary print editorial translated thoughtfully to the web. Use typography, rules, whitespace, asymmetric composition, and one strong display motif. It should feel authored rather than like a SaaS template. Avoid generic hero gradients, floating dashboard mockups, pill overload, and fake testimonials.

Content requirements:

  • Current issue: Low Water, Issue 14, Autumn 2026.
  • Cover story: “The River Keeps Its Receipts” by Imani Vale.
  • Supporting stories: “Night Bus Atlas,” “Concrete Orchards,” and “A Language for Empty Pools,” using the summaries in COPY.md.
  • A compact archive strip for Issues 11–13.
  • A clear subscription offer: print + digital, ¥2,400 per issue, cancel anytime.
  • A functional reading-mode control and a functional email field with inline validation/success feedback; no actual submission.
  • Strong mobile composition at 390 px and sensible reading order.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Decorative artwork must be CSS or inline SVG and accessible. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the art direction, responsive choices, and accessibility. Work only in this directory.

hy4-preview-codebuddy/12-frontend-editorial/app.js

/* Margin — Issue 14
   1. Reading-mode control (paper / night), persisted per browser.
   2. Email field with inline validation and success feedback. No submission. */

(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* ---------- 1. Reading mode ---------- */
  var STORAGE_KEY = 'margin:reading-mode';
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var toggle = document.querySelector('[data-mode-toggle]');
  var label = document.querySelector('[data-mode-label]');
  var themeMeta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');

  function readStored() {
    try {
      var v = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      return v === 'night' || v === 'paper' ? v : null;
    } catch (e) {
      return null; // private mode / storage disabled
    }
  }

  function prefersNight() {
    return window.matchMedia &&
      window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
  }

  function apply(mode, persist) {
    root.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
    if (label) label.textContent = mode === 'night' ? 'Paper reading' : 'Night reading';
    if (toggle) toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(mode === 'night'));
    if (themeMeta) themeMeta.setAttribute('content', mode === 'night' ? '#131311' : '#f4f1e9');
    if (persist) {
      try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, mode); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
  }

  apply(readStored() || (prefersNight() ? 'night' : 'paper'), false);

  if (toggle) {
    toggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
      apply(root.getAttribute('data-mode') === 'night' ? 'paper' : 'night', true);
    });
  }

  // Follow the OS only while the reader hasn't chosen a mode.
  if (window.matchMedia && !readStored()) {
    var mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    var onChange = function (e) { if (!readStored()) apply(e.matches ? 'night' : 'paper', false); };
    if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change', onChange);
    else if (mq.addListener) mq.addListener(onChange);
  }

  /* ---------- 2. Email field ---------- */
  var form = document.querySelector('[data-form]');
  if (!form) return;

  var input = form.querySelector('#email');
  var error = form.querySelector('#email-error');
  var hint = form.querySelector('#email-hint');
  var panel = document.querySelector('[data-success]');
  var echo = document.querySelector('[data-success-email]');

  function showError(message) {
    error.textContent = message;
    error.hidden = false;
    input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    if (hint) hint.hidden = true;
  }

  function clearError() {
    error.textContent = '';
    error.hidden = true;
    input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
    if (hint) hint.hidden = false;
  }

  function validate(value) {
    var v = value.trim();
    if (!v) return 'Please enter an email address.';
    if (v.indexOf('@') === -1) return 'This address needs an @ — try you@example.com.';
    if (/\s/.test(v)) return 'An address can’t contain spaces.';
    var parts = v.split('@');
    if (parts.length !== 2 || !parts[0] || !parts[1]) return 'Check the part before or after the @.';
    if (parts[1].indexOf('.') === -1) return 'The domain looks incomplete — try example.com.';
    if (!/^[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(parts[1])) return 'The domain looks incomplete — try example.com.';
    return '';
  }

  // Clear a visible error as soon as the address becomes acceptable.
  input.addEventListener('input', function () {
    if (!error.hidden && !validate(input.value)) clearError();
  });

  input.addEventListener('blur', function () {
    var problem = validate(input.value);
    if (input.value.trim() && problem) showError(problem);
  });

  form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
    event.preventDefault(); // nothing is sent

    var problem = validate(input.value);
    if (problem) {
      showError(problem);
      input.focus();
      return;
    }

    clearError();
    if (echo) echo.textContent = input.value.trim();

    form.hidden = true;
    panel.hidden = false;
    panel.focus();
  });
})();
