gemini-3.8-flash/12-frontend-editorial/TASK.md

Task 12 — Frontend design: editorial landing page

Build a distinctive responsive landing page for Margin, an independent quarterly journal about overlooked places. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: contemporary print editorial translated thoughtfully to the web. Use typography, rules, whitespace, asymmetric composition, and one strong display motif. It should feel authored rather than like a SaaS template. Avoid generic hero gradients, floating dashboard mockups, pill overload, and fake testimonials.

Content requirements:

  • Current issue: Low Water, Issue 14, Autumn 2026.
  • Cover story: “The River Keeps Its Receipts” by Imani Vale.
  • Supporting stories: “Night Bus Atlas,” “Concrete Orchards,” and “A Language for Empty Pools,” using the summaries in COPY.md.
  • A compact archive strip for Issues 11–13.
  • A clear subscription offer: print + digital, ¥2,400 per issue, cancel anytime.
  • A functional reading-mode control and a functional email field with inline validation/success feedback; no actual submission.
  • Strong mobile composition at 390 px and sensible reading order.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Decorative artwork must be CSS or inline SVG and accessible. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the art direction, responsive choices, and accessibility. Work only in this directory.

gemini-3.8-flash/12-frontend-editorial/app.js

/**
 * MARGIN — Quarterly Journal of Overlooked Places
 * Client-side Editorial Interactions
 * - Theme & Reading Mode Switcher (Local Storage persisted)
 * - Accessible Inline Email Validation & Dispatch Registration
 * - Subscription Tier Selection & Interactive Receipt
 * - Archive Stock Reservation
 */

(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- 1. Reading Mode & Theming Controls ---
  const STORAGE_KEY_THEME = 'margin_theme_preference';
  const STORAGE_KEY_SCALE = 'margin_scale_preference';

  const themeButtons = document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-set]');
  const scaleButtons = document.querySelectorAll('[data-scale-set]');
  const htmlRoot = document.documentElement;

  // Safe localStorage helper
  function safeStorageGet(key) {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(key);
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function safeStorageSet(key, val) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, val);
    } catch (e) {
      // Ignored in private/sandboxed contexts
    }
  }

  function applyTheme(themeName) {
    if (!['newsprint', 'dark', 'linen'].includes(themeName)) {
      themeName = 'newsprint';
    }
    htmlRoot.setAttribute('data-theme', themeName);
    safeStorageSet(STORAGE_KEY_THEME, themeName);

    themeButtons.forEach(btn => {
      const isMatch = btn.getAttribute('data-theme-set') === themeName;
      btn.classList.toggle('is-active', isMatch);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-checked', isMatch ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }

  function applyScale(scaleName) {
    if (!['standard', 'large'].includes(scaleName)) {
      scaleName = 'standard';
    }
    htmlRoot.setAttribute('data-type-scale', scaleName);
    safeStorageSet(STORAGE_KEY_SCALE, scaleName);

    scaleButtons.forEach(btn => {
      const isMatch = btn.getAttribute('data-scale-set') === scaleName;
      btn.classList.toggle('is-active', isMatch);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-checked', isMatch ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }

  // Initialize saved preferences or system defaults
  const savedTheme = safeStorageGet(STORAGE_KEY_THEME);
  if (savedTheme) {
    applyTheme(savedTheme);
  } else if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
    // If user prefers dark mode and has no explicit choice yet
    applyTheme('dark');
  } else {
    applyTheme('newsprint');
  }

  const savedScale = safeStorageGet(STORAGE_KEY_SCALE);
  if (savedScale) {
    applyScale(savedScale);
  } else {
    applyScale('standard');
  }

  // Attach button event listeners
  themeButtons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const targetTheme = btn.getAttribute('data-theme-set');
      applyTheme(targetTheme);
    });
  });

  scaleButtons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const targetScale = btn.getAttribute('data-scale-set');
      applyScale(targetScale);
    });
  });

  // --- 2. Functional Email Field with Inline Validation & Success Feedback ---
  const dispatchForm = document.getElementById('dispatch-form');
  const emailInput = document.getElementById('subscriber-email');
  const feedbackContainer = document.getElementById('email-feedback');
  const submitButton = document.getElementById('btn-submit-email');

  // Common typo dictionary for domain auto-suggestions
  const TYPO_MAP = {
    'gmial.com': 'gmail.com',
    'gmai.com': 'gmail.com',
    'gamil.com': 'gmail.com',
    'yaho.com': 'yahoo.com',
    'hotmial.com': 'hotmail.com',
    'outlok.com': 'outlook.com',
    'prton.me': 'proton.me',
    'prtonmail.com': 'protonmail.com'
  };

  // Standard robust email regex conforming to HTML5 spec
  const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?(?:\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)+$/;

  function validateEmailValue(val) {
    val = (val || '').trim();
    if (!val) {
      return { isValid: false, reason: 'empty', message: 'Please provide an email address to receive the dispatch.' };
    }
    if (!EMAIL_REGEX.test(val)) {
      return { isValid: false, reason: 'format', message: 'Please enter a valid email address (e.g., reader@domain.org).' };
    }

    const domain = val.split('@')[1].toLowerCase();
    if (TYPO_MAP[domain]) {
      const correctedDomain = TYPO_MAP[domain];
      const suggestedEmail = val.split('@')[0] + '@' + correctedDomain;
      return { 
        isValid: true, 
        hasSuggestion: true, 
        suggestion: suggestedEmail, 
        message: `Did you mean ${suggestedEmail}?`
      };
    }

    return { isValid: true };
  }

  function displayError(message, suggestion) {
    emailInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    feedbackContainer.innerHTML = '';

    const errorDiv = document.createElement('div');
    errorDiv.className = 'feedback-msg error';

    const msgSpan = document.createElement('span');
    msgSpan.textContent = message;
    errorDiv.appendChild(msgSpan);

    if (suggestion) {
      const suggestionBtn = document.createElement('button');
      suggestionBtn.type = 'button';
      suggestionBtn.className = 'suggestion-prompt';
      suggestionBtn.textContent = `Click to apply: ${suggestion}`;
      suggestionBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        emailInput.value = suggestion;
        displayError('', null);
        validateAndShowFeedback(false);
        emailInput.focus();
      });
      errorDiv.appendChild(suggestionBtn);
    }

    feedbackContainer.appendChild(errorDiv);
  }

  function displaySuccess(registeredEmail) {
    emailInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
    emailInput.disabled = true;
    if (submitButton) submitButton.disabled = true;

    feedbackContainer.innerHTML = '';

    const successDiv = document.createElement('div');
    successDiv.className = 'feedback-msg success';

    const headSpan = document.createElement('strong');
    headSpan.textContent = '✓ Dispatch Registered for Issue 14 (Autumn 2026)';
    successDiv.appendChild(headSpan);

    const detailSpan = document.createElement('span');
    detailSpan.textContent = `An initial field transmission has been queued for ${registeredEmail}. Dispatches arrive on the 1st and 15th of each month. No algorithmic tracking.`;
    successDiv.appendChild(detailSpan);

    const resetBtn = document.createElement('button');
    resetBtn.type = 'button';
    resetBtn.className = 'reset-link';
    resetBtn.textContent = 'Register a different reader address →';
    resetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      emailInput.disabled = false;
      if (submitButton) submitButton.disabled = false;
      emailInput.value = '';
      emailInput.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      feedbackContainer.innerHTML = '';
      emailInput.focus();
    });
    successDiv.appendChild(resetBtn);

    feedbackContainer.appendChild(successDiv);
  }

  function clearFeedback() {
    emailInput.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
    feedbackContainer.innerHTML = '';
  }

  function validateAndShowFeedback(isSubmitting) {
    const val = emailInput.value;
    const result = validateEmailValue(val);

    if (!result.isValid) {
      if (isSubmitting || val.length > 3) {
        displayError(result.message);
      }
      return false;
    } else {
      if (result.hasSuggestion) {
        displayError(result.message, result.suggestion);
        return true;
      }
      clearFeedback();
      return true;
    }
  }

  if (emailInput && dispatchForm) {
    // Validate on blur
    emailInput.addEventListener('blur', () => {
      if (emailInput.value.trim().length > 0) {
        validateAndShowFeedback(false);
      }
    });

    // Clear error as user corrects it
    emailInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
      if (emailInput.getAttribute('aria-invalid') === 'true') {
        const result = validateEmailValue(emailInput.value);
        if (result.isValid && !result.hasSuggestion) {
          clearFeedback();
        }
      }
    });

    // Form submit interception
    dispatchForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const val = emailInput.value.trim();
      const result = validateEmailValue(val);

      if (!result.isValid) {
        displayError(result.message);
        emailInput.focus();
      } else {
        displaySuccess(val);
      }
    });
  }

  // --- 3. Functional Subscription Offer Interaction ---
  const btnSubscribe = document.getElementById('btn-subscribe');
  const subFeedback = document.getElementById('subscription-feedback');
  const subRadioOptions = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="sub-tier"]');

  if (btnSubscribe && subFeedback) {
    // Update button text on tier change
    subRadioOptions.forEach(radio => {
      radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const isAnnual = radio.value === 'annual';
        const buttonTextEl = btnSubscribe.querySelector('.btn-text');
        if (buttonTextEl) {
          buttonTextEl.textContent = isAnnual 
            ? 'Begin Annual Fellowship (¥9,600 / yr)' 
            : 'Begin Subscription at ¥2,400';
        }
      });
    });

    btnSubscribe.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const selectedTier = document.querySelector('input[name="sub-tier"]:checked');
      const isAnnual = selectedTier && selectedTier.value === 'annual';

      subFeedback.className = 'subscription-feedback is-visible';
      subFeedback.innerHTML = `
        <strong>✓ Order Staged: ${isAnnual ? 'Four-Issue Annual Fellowship (¥9,600 / yr)' : 'Quarterly Rolling Edition (¥2,400)'}</strong><br>
        Your subscription begins with <em>Issue 14: Low Water</em>. 160-page tactile volume on Munken Lynx stock will dispatch via surface mail. Billed on release; modify or cancel anytime without penalties.
      `;
      btnSubscribe.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    });
  }

  // --- 4. Archive Stock Requests ---
  const archiveButtons = document.querySelectorAll('[data-archive-order]');
  archiveButtons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const issueNum = btn.getAttribute('data-archive-order');
      const originalText = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = `✓ Reserved No. ${issueNum}`;
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.classList.add('btn-primary');
      btn.classList.remove('btn-outline');

      setTimeout(() => {
        btn.textContent = `Issue ${issueNum} Reserved`;
      }, 1500);
    });
  });

})();

            </dl>
          </div>

          <div class="marginalia-note">
            <p class="marginalia-text">
              “When the reservoir fell to seventeen percent, the municipal records department had not yet opened its doors, but the 1923 brewery foundations were already dry in the sun.”
            </p>
            <span class="marginalia-source">— Imani Vale, Field Notebook No. 6</span>
          </div>
        </aside>

        <!-- Center Column: Cover Story Typography & Body Excerpt -->
        <article class="cover-story-article">
          <div class="story-kicker">
            <span class="kicker-lead">Cover Feature</span>
            <span class="sep" aria-hidden="true">/</span>
            <span class="kicker-theme">Hydrological Memory</span>
          </div>

          <h2 id="cover-story-heading" class="cover-headline">
            The River Keeps Its Receipts
          </h2>

          <div class="byline-block">
            <span class="byline-author">By Imani Vale</span>
            <span class="byline-rule" aria-hidden="true">—</span>
            <span class="byline-desc">Essay with photographic field plates by the author</span>
          </div>

          <div class="story-lead-body">
            <p class="lede-paragraph">
              Along a drought-exposed riverbed, shop ledgers, bottle caps, and vanished street plans surface together. A field essay about civic memory and what infrastructure tries to forget.
            </p>
            <p class="body-paragraph">
              The summer did not merely dry the gravel; it reversed the direction of municipal archaeology. For seventy years, the reservoir had functioned as a liquid vault, sealing the pre-dam town of Ogano beneath thirty meters of cold silt. In late August, as the intake towers began drinking mud, the water pulled back like a drawn curtain.
            </p>
            <blockquote class="editorial-pullquote">
              <p>“The silt does not bury history; it merely pauses its billing cycle.”</p>
            </blockquote>
            <p class="body-paragraph">
              First came the granite bridge piers, then the warped iron ties of a narrow-gauge timber tramway, and finally the water-logged ledger books from a dry-goods mercantile that went under in the flood of 1934. Ink made from iron gall still held fast against the gray clay, naming debts in copper sen for flour that had fed laborers building the very retaining walls now crumbling above them.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="cover-story-actions">
            <a href="#subscription" class="btn btn-primary">
              <span class="btn-text">Read in Print Issue 14 (¥2,400)</span>

            Receive The Field Dispatch Between Issues
          </h2>
          <p class="dispatch-copy">
            A quiet bulletin sent twice a month containing field notebooks, aerial reconnaissance, coordinates of newly uncovered sites, and contributor marginalia. We do not track open rates, send marketing promotions, or share subscriber data.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="dispatch-form-col">
          <form id="dispatch-form" class="dispatch-form" novalidate aria-label="Field Dispatch email registration">
            <div class="form-group">
              <label for="subscriber-email" class="form-label">
                Reader Email Address <span class="required-indicator" aria-hidden="true">*</span>
              </label>
              <div class="input-action-row">
                <input 
                  type="email" 
                  id="subscriber-email" 
                  name="email" 
                  class="form-input" 
                  placeholder="name@domain.org" 
                  autocomplete="email" 
                  spellcheck="false"
                  required 
                  aria-required="true"
                  aria-describedby="email-feedback"
                >
                <button type="submit" id="btn-submit-email" class="btn btn-primary btn-submit">
                  <span>Register Dispatch</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Inline Validation & Success Feedback Region -->
            <div id="email-feedback" class="feedback-container" role="alert" aria-live="polite">
              <!-- Dynamically populated by app.js: error or success message -->
            </div>

            <div class="form-privacy-note">
              <span>Free fortnightly delivery</span>
              <span class="bullet" aria-hidden="true">·</span>
              <span>One-click unsubscribe in every transmission</span>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

  </main>

  <!-- Editorial Colophon & Site Footer -->
  <footer class="site-footer" role="contentinfo">
    <div class="colophon-grid">
      <div class="colophon-col colophon-masthead">
        <h3 class="colophon-title">M A R G I N</h3>
        <p class="colophon-text">
          An independent quarterly journal founded in 2023. Dedicated to longform reportage, photographic essays, and architectural forensics of overlooked geographies.
        </p>
        <p class="colophon-print-spec">
          Issue 14 “Low Water” set in classical editorial serif and grotesque systems. Printed in offset lithography with vegetable inks on FSC-certified unbleached fibers.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="colophon-col colophon-directory">
        <h4 class="colophon-subtitle">Editorial Directory</h4>
        <ul class="directory-list">
          <li><strong>Editor-in-Chief:</strong> Soren Lindqvist</li>
          <li><strong>Art Direction:</strong> Yael Ben-Ami</li>
          <li><strong>Senior Cartographer:</strong> Nadia Kouassi</li>
          <li><strong>Typography:</strong> Studio Werkstatt (Zurich)</li>
          <li><strong>Issue 14 Lead Author:</strong> Imani Vale</li>
        </ul>
      </div>

      <div class="colophon-col colophon-publishing">
        <h4 class="colophon-subtitle">Publication Schedule</h4>
        <ul class="schedule-list">
          <li><strong>Issue 14 (Low Water):</strong> Autumn 2026 (Current)</li>
          <li><strong>Issue 15 (Sleeper Rail):</strong> Winter 2026/27</li>
          <li><strong>Issue 16 (Salt Flat Acoustics):</strong> Spring 2027</li>
          <li><strong>Issue 17 (Radio Silence):</strong> Summer 2027</li>
        </ul>
      </div>

      <div class="colophon-col colophon-terms">
        <h4 class="colophon-subtitle">Subscription &amp; Inquiries</h4>
        <p class="colophon-terms-text">
          All quarterly subscriptions are priced at ¥2,400 per issue. Cancellations may be requested at any time prior to scheduled dispatch.
        </p>
        <div class="colophon-links">
          <a href="#cover-story" class="back-to-top">Return to Top of Page ↑</a>
        </div>
        <p class="colophon-copyright">
          © 2026 Margin Journal. All essays, photographs, and cartography remain under copyright of their respective authors.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </footer>

  <script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

gemini-3.8-flash/12-frontend-editorial/styles.css

/* ==========================================================================
   MARGIN — Quarterly Journal of Overlooked Places
   Issue 14: Low Water (Autumn 2026)
   Contemporary Print Editorial Styling
   ========================================================================== */

/* --- CSS Variables & Theming System --- */
:root {
  /* System font stacks suited for classical literary typography */
  --font-serif: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", "URW Palladio L", P052, Palatino, "Book Antiqua", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --font-display: "Baskerville", "Big Caslon", "Iowan Old Style", "Times New Roman", serif;
  --font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "SF Mono", "Consolas", "Liberation Mono", Menlo, Monaco, Courier, monospace;

  --scale-factor: 1rem;
  --site-max-width: 1360px;
  --border-radius: 0px; /* Rigorously unrounded print corners */

  /* Default Theme: Newsprint / Broadside Paper */
  --bg-page: #F5F2EB;
  --bg-surface: #EDE8DE;
  --bg-card: #FAF8F3;
  --bg-card-contrast: #E4DDD1;
  --bg-subtle: rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.04);

  --ink-primary: #1C1917;
  --ink-secondary: #47423C;
  --ink-muted: #736C62;
  --ink-faint: #9E9689;

  --border-color: #D3CBBC;
  --border-dark: #1C1917;
  --border-faint: rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.12);

  --accent: #A83622; /* Editorial iron silt rust */
  --accent-hover: #862B1B;
  --accent-faint: rgba(168, 54, 34, 0.10);
  --accent-contrast: #F5F2EB;

  --success-bg: #E8F0E6;
  --success-ink: #264A24;
  --success-border: #7B9B78;

  --error-bg: #FAECE9;
  --error-ink: #8A2617;
  --error-border: #DFA095;

  --shadow-editorial: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
}

/* Theme: Archival Charcoal (Night Reading) */
[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg-page: #131416;
  --bg-surface: #1B1D20;
  --bg-card: #22252A;
  --bg-card-contrast: #2D3137;
  --bg-subtle: rgba(235, 230, 220, 0.05);

  --ink-primary: #EBE5DB;
  --ink-secondary: #C4BEB3;
  --ink-muted: #948F85;
  --ink-faint: #635F57;

  --border-color: #383C44;
  --border-dark: #EBE5DB;
  --border-faint: rgba(235, 230, 220, 0.14);

  --accent: #D69E58; /* Archival brass / warm ochre */
  --accent-hover: #E3AF6D;
  --accent-faint: rgba(214, 158, 88, 0.15);
  --accent-contrast: #131416;

  --success-bg: #1A261C;
  --success-ink: #A3D4A0;
  --success-border: #3A5C3D;

  --error-bg: #2B1614;
  --error-ink: #F0A59B;
  --error-border: #733026;

  --shadow-editorial: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}

/* Theme: Raw Linen (Subdued Earth / Riverbed) */
[data-theme="linen"] {
  --bg-page: #ECE6D8;
  --bg-surface: #E2DAC9;
  --bg-card: #F2ECE0;
  --bg-card-contrast: #D7CDBC;
  --bg-subtle: rgba(43, 38, 33, 0.04);

  --ink-primary: #26221D;
  --ink-secondary: #4F483F;
  --ink-muted: #797164;
  --ink-faint: #A59C8D;

  --border-color: #CEC3AF;
  --border-dark: #26221D;
  --border-faint: rgba(43, 38, 33, 0.12);

  --accent: #49634C; /* Dried river reed green */
  --accent-hover: #374E3A;
  --accent-faint: rgba(73, 99, 76, 0.12);
  --accent-contrast: #ECE6D8;

  --success-bg: #E3EBE0;
  --success-ink: #284725;
  --success-border: #7B9B78;

  --error-bg: #F5EAE6;
  --error-ink: #8A2617;
  --error-border: #DFA095;
}

/* Scaled Typography Mode */
[data-type-scale="large"] {
  --scale-factor: 1.15rem;
}

/* --- Global Reset & Foundation --- */
*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html {
  font-size: var(--scale-factor);
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  text-size-adjust: 100%;
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
}

body {
  background-color: var(--bg-page);
  color: var(--ink-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.62;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  transition: background-color 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease;
}

/* Accessible Skip Navigation Link */
.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  top: -100px;
  left: 1rem;
  background: var(--ink-primary);
  color: var(--bg-page);
  padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  z-index: 9999;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: top 0.2s ease;
}

.skip-link:focus {
  top: 1rem;
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
}

/* Global Selection */
::selection {
  background-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-contrast);
}

/* Global Focus Styles */
:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* --- Top Running Folio Bar --- */
.site-header {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
  background-color: var(--bg-page);
  width: 100%;
}

.top-folio {
  max-width: var(--site-max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0.65rem 1.5rem;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.folio-col {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.folio-journal {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}

.folio-rule, .bullet {
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

/* Reading Controls Toolbar */
.reading-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.25rem;
}

.control-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
}

.control-label {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.control-buttons {
  display: inline-flex;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}

.ctrl-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  padding: 0.28rem 0.6rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
  min-height: 28px;
}

.ctrl-btn:last-child {
  border-right: none;
}

.ctrl-btn:hover {
  background-color: var(--bg-card-contrast);
  color: var(--ink-primary);
}

.ctrl-btn.is-active,
.ctrl-btn[aria-checked="true"] {
  background-color: var(--ink-primary);
  color: var(--bg-page);
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* --- Editorial Masthead --- */
.masthead-wrapper {
  max-width: var(--site-max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 2.2rem 1.5rem 1.2rem;
}

.masthead-inner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr 240px;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 2rem;
  padding-bottom: 2rem;
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--border-dark);
}

.masthead-meta-left,
.masthead-meta-right {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

.masthead-meta-right {
  text-align: right;
}

.meta-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.15rem;
}

.meta-label {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.meta-value {
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
}

.accent-text {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.price-tag {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.masthead-title-block {
  text-align: center;
}

.journal-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 7.5vw, 6.2rem);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 0.95;
  letter-spacing: 0.28em;
  text-indent: 0.28em; /* Offset for aesthetic balance */
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
}

.journal-tagline {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 1.3vw, 1.15rem);
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
  max-width: 620px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

/* Quick Issue Navigation */
.issue-nav {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding-top: 0.8rem;
}

.nav-links {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1.75rem;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.nav-links a {
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.2rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}

.nav-num {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.nav-links a:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
  border-bottom-color: var(--accent);
}

/* --- Main Content Grid Container --- */
.site-main {
  max-width: var(--site-max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 1.5rem 4rem;
}

/* --- Section 01: Cover Story Feature --- */
.section-cover-feature {
  padding: 2.5rem 0 3.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.section-badge-bar {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.badge-motif {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Asymmetric 12-Column Grid on Desktop */
.cover-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 240px 1.4fr 1.1fr;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  align-items: start;
}

/* Left Rail: Context & Marginalia */
.cover-rail-left {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2rem;
}

.rail-box {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  padding: 1.25rem;
}

.rail-eyebrow {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--accent);
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
}

.rail-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.field-specs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.field-specs dt {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.field-specs dd {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}

.mono-stat {
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 0.95rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
}

.sub-stat {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.marginalia-note {
  border-left: 2px solid var(--accent);
  padding-left: 1rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.marginalia-text {
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.marginalia-source {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

/* Center Column: Cover Story Article */
.cover-story-article {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.story-kicker {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--accent);
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.cover-headline {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 4.2vw, 3.8rem);
  line-height: 1.08;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.byline-block {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  padding-bottom: 1.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.byline-author {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
}

.byline-desc {
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.story-lead-body {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
}

/* Traditional Editorial Drop-Cap */
.lede-paragraph::first-letter {
  float: left;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 3.8rem;
  line-height: 0.8;
  padding-top: 0.2rem;
  padding-right: 0.65rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.1rem;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.body-paragraph {
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
}

.editorial-pullquote {
  margin: 2rem 0;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.75rem;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
}

.cover-story-actions {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.action-note {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

/* Right Rail: Display Motif Card */
.cover-rail-right {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.display-motif-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  padding: 1rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-editorial);
}

.motif-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.motif-fig {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.motif-title-text {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.svg-container {
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--bg-page);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-faint);
  display: block;
}

.editorial-motif-svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

/* Display Motif SVG Interior Styling via CSS */
.svg-frame {
  fill: var(--bg-surface);
  stroke: var(--border-dark);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}

.svg-frame-inner {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--border-color);
  stroke-width: 0.75;
}

.svg-crosshair {
  stroke: var(--ink-muted);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.svg-scale-axis {
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}

.svg-tick {
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.svg-tick.major {
  stroke-width: 2;
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
}

.svg-tick.major-accent {
  stroke-width: 2.5;
  stroke: var(--accent);
}

.svg-label-mono {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  fill: var(--ink-muted);
}

.svg-label-mono.text-right {
  text-anchor: end;
}

.svg-label-mono.accent-svg {
  fill: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.svg-hatch-line {
  stroke: var(--ink-faint);
  stroke-width: 0.75;
}

.svg-clay-line {
  stroke: var(--ink-muted);
  stroke-width: 0.65;
}

.svg-dot {
  fill: var(--ink-muted);
}

.svg-line-water-normal {
  stroke: var(--ink-muted);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}

.svg-text-caption {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  fill: var(--ink-muted);
}

.svg-arrowhead {
  fill: var(--ink-muted);
}

.svg-line-water-low {
  stroke: var(--accent);
  stroke-width: 2;
}

.svg-line-water-low-sub {
  stroke: var(--accent);
  stroke-width: 0.75;
}

.svg-datum-tag-bg {
  fill: var(--accent);
}

.svg-datum-tag-text {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  fill: var(--accent-contrast);
}

.svg-strata-water-layer {
  fill: var(--accent-faint);
}

.svg-contour-line {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--ink-secondary);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.svg-contour-line-heavy {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
  stroke-width: 2;
}

.svg-contour-faint {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--ink-faint);
  stroke-width: 0.5;
  stroke-dasharray: 2 4;
}

.svg-stone-block {
  fill: var(--bg-card-contrast);
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
  stroke-width: 1.25;
}

.svg-mortar-line {
  stroke: var(--ink-secondary);
  stroke-width: 0.75;
}

.svg-callout-line {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--accent);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.svg-callout-dot {
  fill: var(--accent);
}

.svg-callout-title {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  fill: var(--accent);
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.svg-callout-title.text-right,
.svg-callout-desc.text-right {
  text-anchor: end;
}

.svg-callout-desc {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  fill: var(--ink-secondary);
}

.svg-rail-tie {
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
}

.svg-rail-track {
  stroke: var(--accent);
}

.svg-box-top {
  fill: var(--bg-card-contrast);
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.svg-box-side {
  fill: var(--border-color);
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.svg-box-front {
  fill: var(--bg-surface);
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.svg-cartouche-bg {
  fill: var(--bg-page);
  stroke: var(--border-color);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.svg-cartouche-lead {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 8px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  fill: var(--ink-primary);
}

.svg-cartouche-sub,
.svg-cartouche-date {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 7px;
  fill: var(--ink-muted);
}

.svg-north-arrow {
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
  stroke-width: 1.25;
  fill: none;
}

.svg-north-text {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 8px;
  font-weight: 700;
  fill: var(--ink-primary);
}

.motif-footer {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  padding-top: 0.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.motif-caption {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
}

/* --- Section 02: Supporting Dispatches --- */
.section-supporting {
  padding: 3.5rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.section-header-band {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-dark);
}

.band-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.section-index {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.section-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 2.8vw, 2.2rem);
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
}

.band-context {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.supporting-triptych {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 1.75rem;
}

.dispatch-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  padding: 1.5rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}

.dispatch-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-dark);
}

.dispatch-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.dispatch-serial {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.dispatch-category {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.story-mini-motif {
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  background: var(--bg-page);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-faint);
}

.mini-motif-svg {
  display: block;
}

/* Mini motif SVGs */
.svg-card-bg {
  fill: var(--bg-surface);
}

.svg-route-line.route-primary {
  stroke: var(--accent);
  stroke-width: 2;
  fill: none;
}

.svg-route-line.route-secondary {
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
  fill: none;
}

.svg-route-line.route-tertiary {
  stroke: var(--ink-faint);
  stroke-width: 1.2;
  fill: none;
}

.svg-bus-stop {
  fill: var(--bg-page);
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}

.svg-bus-stop.accent {
  fill: var(--accent);
  stroke: var(--accent);
}

.svg-bus-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  fill: var(--ink-secondary);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.svg-concrete-column {
  fill: var(--bg-card-contrast);
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.svg-concrete-slab {
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
}

.svg-tree-trunk {
  stroke: var(--accent);
  stroke-width: 2.2;
  fill: none;
}

.svg-tree-roots {
  stroke: var(--ink-muted);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
  fill: none;
}

.svg-slab-tag {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  font-weight: 700;
  fill: var(--accent);
}

.svg-slab-sub {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 7px;
  fill: var(--ink-muted);
}

.svg-iso-tile {
  fill: var(--bg-card);
  stroke: var(--ink-primary);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.svg-watermark-line {
  stroke: var(--accent);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}

.svg-tile-text {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  fill: var(--accent);
}

.dispatch-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
}

.dispatch-byline {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.dispatch-synopsis {
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.dispatch-footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding-top: 0.75rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.dispatch-arrow {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* --- Section 03: Compact Archive Strip --- */
.section-archive {
  padding: 3.5rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.archive-header-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
}

.archive-intro {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.archive-section-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 2.4vw, 1.85rem);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.archive-subtext {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.archive-strip-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.archive-item {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  padding: 1.25rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-top: 4px solid var(--ink-primary);
}

.archive-item:nth-child(2) {
  border-top-color: var(--accent);
}

.archive-item:nth-child(3) {
  border-top-color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.archive-spine {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.spine-num {
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}

.spine-season {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.archive-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.25;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.archive-desc {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.archive-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  padding-top: 0.65rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-color);
}

.archive-price {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
}

.archive-status {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.archive-status.low-stock {
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* --- Section 04: Subscription Offer --- */
.section-subscription {
  padding: 3.5rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.subscription-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-editorial);
}

/* Tipped-in Perforation Line */
.card-perforation {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 58%;
  width: 1px;
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    transparent,
    transparent 4px,
    var(--border-color) 4px,
    var(--border-color) 8px
  );
}

.card-interior-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 58% 42%;
}

.offer-proposition {
  padding: 2.75rem;
}

.offer-tag {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--accent);
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.offer-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.2vw, 2.5rem);
  line-height: 1.15;
  font-weight: 400;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.offer-body {
  font-size: 0.96rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
}

.offer-specs {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
}

.offer-specs li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.check-mark {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

/* Order Box Column */
.offer-order-box {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  padding: 2.75rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.order-box-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.order-currency-badge {
  background: var(--bg-card-contrast);
  padding: 0.2rem 0.45rem;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.price-display {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.currency-symbol {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 1.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.amount {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 3.5rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
}

.frequency {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.price-clause {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.price-clause em {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.edition-selection {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.radio-option {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease;
}

.radio-option:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-dark);
}

.radio-option input[type="radio"] {
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
  accent-color: var(--accent);
}

.guarantee-terms {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  text-align: center;
}

/* Subscription Simulated Feedback Notice */
.subscription-feedback {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  border-radius: var(--border-radius);
  display: none;
}

.subscription-feedback.is-visible {
  display: block;
  background: var(--success-bg);
  color: var(--success-ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--success-border);
}

/* --- Section 05: Field Gazette Signup --- */
.section-dispatch-signup {
  padding: 3.5rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.dispatch-container {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 3rem;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
  padding: 2.75rem;
}

.dispatch-eyebrow {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--accent);
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.dispatch-heading {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 2.8vw, 2.2rem);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.dispatch-copy {
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
}

.dispatch-form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.form-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.form-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.required-indicator {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.input-action-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
  width: 100%;
}

.form-input {
  flex: 1;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
  border-right: none;
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
  min-height: 48px;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.form-input:focus {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: -1px;
}

.form-input[aria-invalid="true"] {
  border-color: var(--error-ink);
  background-color: var(--error-bg);
}

.form-input[aria-invalid="false"] {
  border-color: var(--success-ink);
}

.btn-submit {
  white-space: nowrap;
  min-height: 48px;
  border-left: none;
}

/* Feedback Alert Area */
.feedback-container {
  min-height: 1.5rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.feedback-msg {
  padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-in;
}

.feedback-msg.error {
  background-color: var(--error-bg);
  color: var(--error-ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--error-border);
}

.feedback-msg.success {
  background-color: var(--success-bg);
  color: var(--success-ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--success-border);
}

.feedback-msg .suggestion-prompt {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  text-decoration: underline;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: inherit;
  padding: 0;
  text-align: left;
}

.feedback-msg .reset-link {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-decoration: underline;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: inherit;
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  text-align: left;
}

.form-privacy-note {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

/* --- Common Buttons --- */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 0.85rem 1.4rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
  min-height: 44px;
}

.btn-primary {
  background-color: var(--ink-primary);
  color: var(--bg-page);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink-primary);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  background-color: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-contrast);
}

.btn-outline {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: var(--ink-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
}

.btn-outline:hover {
  background-color: var(--ink-primary);
  color: var(--bg-page);
}

.btn-block {
  width: 100%;
}

.btn-arrow {
  transition: transform 0.15s ease;
}

.btn:hover .btn-arrow {
  transform: translateX(3px);
}

/* --- Editorial Colophon & Footer --- */
.site-footer {
  border-top: 3px double var(--border-dark);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  padding: 3.5rem 1.5rem 4rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.colophon-grid {
  max-width: var(--site-max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1.2fr;
  gap: 2.5rem;
}

.colophon-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.25em;
  font-weight: 400;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.colophon-subtitle {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--accent);
  margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
}

.colophon-text,
.colophon-terms-text {
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.colophon-print-spec {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.directory-list,
.schedule-list {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
}

.directory-list strong,
.schedule-list strong {
  color: var(--ink-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.colophon-links {
  margin: 1rem 0;
}

.back-to-top {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.back-to-top:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.colophon-copyright {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

/* --- Responsive Media Queries --- */

/* Medium Screens (Tablets / Laptops <= 1024px) */
@media screen and (max-width: 1024px) {
  .masthead-inner {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    text-align: center;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }

  .masthead-meta-left,
  .masthead-meta-right {
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 1.25rem;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .cover-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
  }

  .cover-rail-left {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }

  .supporting-triptych {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }

  .archive-strip-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .card-interior-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .card-perforation {
    display: none;
  }

  .offer-order-box {
    border-left: none;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  }

  .dispatch-container {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
  }

  .colophon-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
  }
}

/* Mobile Screens (<= 768px and specifically 390px viewport target) */
@media screen and (max-width: 768px) {
  .top-folio {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
  }

  .folio-controls {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 0.4rem;
    border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-color);
  }

  .reading-controls {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .masthead-wrapper {
    padding: 1.5rem 1rem 1rem;
  }

  .journal-title {
    font-size: 2.75rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-indent: 0.16em;
  }

  .nav-links {
    gap: 0.75rem;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    overflow-x: auto;
    padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }

  .site-main {
    padding: 0 1rem 3rem;
  }

  .section-cover-feature {
    padding: 1.75rem 0 2.5rem;
  }

  .cover-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 1.75rem;
  }

  .cover-rail-left {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 1rem;
  }

  .cover-headline {
    font-size: 2.15rem;
    line-height: 1.12;
  }

  .editorial-pullquote {
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  }

  .supporting-triptych {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .offer-proposition,
  .offer-order-box {
    padding: 1.5rem 1.25rem;
  }

  .dispatch-container {
    padding: 1.5rem 1.25rem;
  }

  .input-action-row {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .form-input {
    border-right: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
    width: 100%;
  }

  .btn-submit {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .colophon-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
  }

  .site-footer {
    padding: 2.5rem 1rem 3rem;
  }
}

/* Extreme Mobile Precision: 390px (e.g. iPhone standard width) */
@media screen and (max-width: 420px) {
  .journal-title {
    font-size: 2.3rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-indent: 0.12em;
  }

  .journal-tagline {
    font-size: 0.88rem;
  }

  .meta-item {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
  }

  .cover-headline {
    font-size: 1.95rem;
  }

  .amount {
    font-size: 2.85rem;
  }

  .ctrl-btn {
    padding: 0.25rem 0.45rem;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
  }
}

/* Print Stylesheet */
@media print {
  body {
    background: #fff !important;
    color: #000 !important;
  }

  .top-folio,
  .reading-controls,
  .issue-nav,
  .cover-story-actions,
  .archive-action,
  .section-dispatch-signup,
  .back-to-top {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .cover-grid {
    display: block;
  }

  .display-motif-card,
  .dispatch-card,
  .archive-item,
  .subscription-card {
    page-break-inside: avoid;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border: 1px solid #000 !important;
  }
}

/* Accessibility: Reduced Motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-3px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
